text.body:
<1 >
prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ | bhūparīkṣā vidhiḥ | ādau bhūparīkṣā vidhiḥ ucyate | śraddhāvān āstiko bhaktaḥ dhanadhānyau samedhitaḥ| mahotsāhaḥ śuciḥ dakṣaḥ kṛtajño lobhavarjitaḥ| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāpyanulomajaḥ| ityādyuktaiḥ samastaguṇaiḥ sametaḥ yajamānaḥ pāñcarātravidaṃ śāntaṃ siddhānteṣu kṛtaśramam| bhagavadvaṃśajaṃ śuddhaṃ alolupamadāṃbhikam| apāpamṛjumavyādhimadṛṣṭaparamāstikam| ityādyukta lakṣaṇaṃ ācāryaṃ prathamaṃ varayet| tataḥ ācāryo yajamānaśca daivajñena saha śubhe dine grāmādisthāpanāya ādau nimittāni parīkṣya| śubhe nimitte grāmādīn ārabheta| tadarthaṃ rathakāreṇa saha ācāryaḥ bhuvaṃ parīkṣeta| atha bhūmi lakṣaṇam ucyate supadmā, bhadrakā, pūrṇā,dhūmrā ca iti bhūmi ścaturvidhā| supadmā caṃpakāgaru kharjūra kadaṃba tilakārjuna kramuka nārikela kuśa kāśa kamala kuvalayayutā prāgudakpravaṇā śubhatoyāvṛtā| bhadrakānadīsāgara pāśrvasthā tīrthāyatanam āśritā kṣīravṛkṣa phalavṛkṣasamākulā udyānopavanopetā latāgulma yajña vṛkṣa kuśakāśavrīhi kṣetraiḥ adhaḥ jalena ca upetā| pūrṇākuluttha kaṃku niṣpāva kodrava śyāmākānvitā āprabhūtodaka giri pāśrvaṃ giriśikharaṃ vā āśritā| dhūmrāyavaveṇusnuhiśleṣmātaka vibhītakārkasaṃkīrṇaṃ kaṭhina śarkarānvitā vāyasa śyenagṛdhra gomāyuvṛka saṃkulā ūṣarānvitā| supadmā śāntidā| bhadrakā sukhadā| pūrṇā puṣṭidā| dhūmrā kṣayadā| bhūmim evaṃ vidhāṃ jñātvā| tāṃ daṇḍamānena vistārāyāmayoḥ sadṛśaṃ jānudaghnaṃ khātvā| punaḥ tābhireva mṛdbhiḥ pūrite samādhike uttamām| same madhyamām| nyūne adhamām jñātvā | adhamāṃ varjayitvā| anyayoḥ śālimudga yavādīnāṃ bījānyuptvā parīkṣeta | trirātrābhyantare yadyaṅkurāḥ samudbhūtāḥtadā uttamā | pañcarātrābhyantare cet madhyamā, sapta rātrābhyaṃtare cet adhamā| aṅkureṣu aprarūḍheṣvapi adhamaiva| adhamāṃ varjayet | anye gṛhṇīyāt| kuśapalāśa hariṇāḥ yatra vidyaṃte sā adhamā api uttamā | madhureṇa rasena yuktā uttamā| kaṭukā madhyamā| āmlādyanya rasā adhamā| śvetā uttamā| pīta lohitā madhyamā| kṛṣṇā adhamā| saṃyak evaṃ vicārya pāñcarātravit ācāryaḥ yajamānena rathakāreṇa ca sākam,vāstusīmani nṛttagītavādya maṃgalapāṭha pūrṇakumbha dīpadhvaja chatrasamanvitam savedādhyayanaṃ svastivācanena saha pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya| sarvāsvapi dikṣu vidikṣu ca prāgādi piśācādīnāṃ pāyasaiḥ brahmasthānāṃtaṃ balikarma kuryāt | bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ nāgāśca asurāḥ rākṣasāḥ grahāḥ| sarve te vyapagacchantu balituṣṭāḥ yathā tatham| devānāṃ ca dvijānāṃ ca sthānaṃ samyak karomyaham| vāsudevasya devasya sarva bhūtātmakasya ca iti maṃtraṃ udīrayan, astra mantreṇa saṃsiddhān siddhārthān sarvataḥ vikīrya| yathāvidhibaliṃdatvā| tatrasūtrāṇi nipātya| sūtrasaṃdhiṣu śaṃkūn saṃsthāpya| tataḥ yathāvidhi vāstupūjāṃ kuryāt| adhomukhaṃ prākchirasaṃ koṇaprasārita pāṇi pādam vāstu puruṣaṃ vilikhya āvāhya abhyarcya| vāstupuruṣasya dakṣiṇataḥ agni kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vā vidhivat saṃskṛtam agniṃ dīpayitvā| tasmin tamāvāhya pañcopaniṣadā ghṛtena āhutīnāṃ sahasraṃ śataṃ vā apāmārga śamīkhādirāṇāṃ samidbhiśca tāvat hutvā|agniṃ yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācānām pūrvoktābhiḥ samidbhiḥ pūrvokta saṃkhyayā svayaṃ hutvā| tataḥ mūlamaṃtrābhyāṃ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ vāstunāthamaṃtreṇa caruṇā āhutīnāṃ śataṃ ca hutvā| pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā| agnisthaṃ udvāsya| aṣṭāsu dikṣu indrādīnāṃ svasvamantreṇa baliṃdadyāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ bhūparīkṣā vidhiḥ nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ dānapālanayormadhye dānāt śreyonupālanam| dānāt svargamavāpnoti pālanādacyutaṃ padam| svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharām| ṣaṣṭivarṣa sahasrāṇi viṣṭayā jāyate kṛmiḥ| svadattāt dvigunaṃpuṇyaṃ paradattānupālanam| paradattā’pahāreṇa svadattaṃ niṣpalaṃ bhavet| ekaiva bhaginī loke sarveṣāmeva bhūbhujām | na bhojyā na kadā grāhyā viṣṇudattā vasuṃdharā |
<2 >
dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ | karṣaṇam | atha karṣaṇavidhiḥ ucyate | evaṃ grāmādi kalpayitvā, tanmadhye mandiranirmāṇārthaṃ pūrvoktāṃ bhūṃmi praveśa balipūrvakamāsādya tāṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya,yakṣāḥ piśācāḥ nāgāśca ye’tra tiṣṭhanti sarvadā|sarve prayāṃtu te’nyatra viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ karomyaham|iti maṃtreṇa astramaṃtrasaṃsiddhān siddhārthān sarvataḥ dikṣu vikīrya, pūrvavat vāstu pūjāṃ homaṃ cabalyantam kṛtvā| anantaram ācāryaḥ vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā halena bhūmiṃvilikhet|yajamānaḥ brāhmaṇaścet anaṅvāhau gauravarṇau|yadikṣatriyaḥ lohitau| yadi vaiśyaḥpītau| yadi śūdraḥ mecakau| uktavarṇānāṃ alābhe kapilau gaurau raktau vā| tau mahāntaubalaśālinau vṛṣabhau kṣālayitvā| khuraśṛṅgādīni kanakamayaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣayet |brāhmaṇo yajamānaḥ cet yugaṃ halaṃ ca pālāśam, kṣatriyaḥ yadi naiyagrodham, yadi vaiśyaḥplākṣam, sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ naiyagrodha paippale vā syātām|sarveṣāṃ kauśikaḥ sauvarṇā yoktraṃ rājataṃtāmraṃ vā|kuśāḥ, dhanujryā, vīraṇyaḥ, kāśāśca yathāvarṇam kramāt rajjuḥ| halabhūtamadhyauekayonike|sarvaṃ evaṃ kṛtvā| tataḥ snātaḥ navāṃbaradharaḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaḥ ācāryaḥ pādauprakṣālya| ācamya| prāṇānāyamya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā| brāhmaṇaiḥ anujñātaḥ mantrajñaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥsaha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| tajjalena sarvaṃ dravyajātaṃ ātmānaṃ ca prokṣya| mūlamantreṇavṛṣaskandhe yugaṃ saṃyojya| tenaiva mantreṇa halaṃ yuge saṃyojya| sumuhūrte bherī paṭaha śaṅkhādivādyaghoṣapurassaraṃ śākuna sūktādi vedaghoṣasahitaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ guruḥ hṛdayakamale nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyan|pālāśādi daṇḍaṃ pravahaṇaṃ kṛtvā| tataḥ todanaṃ ādāya| huṃphaḍādinā āpīḍya| prāṅmukhaḥmūlavidyayā prathamaṃ karṣayet| pauruṣeṇa sūktena dvitīyaṃ, viṣṇusūktena tṛtīyaṃ, viṣṇu gāya rtyāturīyam, nārāyaṇānuvākena pañcamam, pañcopaniṣanmaṃtraiḥ ṣaṣṭam, bhūsūktena saptamam karṣaṇam| sarvaṃ prādakṣiṇya krameṇa| dakṣiṇottarataśca evaṃ karṣayet| tatkāle nimittāni parīkṣet|ācāryasyamanastuṣṭiḥ mandira yajamānayoḥ śarmaṇe bhavet | tadviparyayaśca asukhāya|anaḍuhoḥ śayane, yoktrādibhedane, vyatyāsabhramaṇe, anyanimittodaye ca sarva doṣaśāntyarthaṃpañcopaniṣadā sarpiṣā śatamāhutīnāṃ juhuyāt| tataḥ ācāryaḥ yajamānaśca brāhmaṇāntoṣayitvā|tāṃ bhuvaṃ mahatāyatnena samīkṛtya, pṛthak pṛthak ālavālāni jalakulyāyutānikārayitvā| toyena āsicya| tatra śālī mudga yavādi bījāni vāpayet| tadabhivṛddhyarthaṃpratidinaṃ mahatājalena saṃsicya| paripākāvasānikaṃ rakṣet|tataḥ phalāni pakvāni lūtvā|phalarahitaṃ kṣetraṃ gāḥ samānīya cārayet| sasya bhūriphale taddhāma dīrghakālaṃ bhaviṣyati|alpe tu alpataraṃ kālam| hareḥ sannidhānaṃ ca pūrvavadeva| phalahīneprakṣīṇadhanadhānyakam|tatra sahasraṃ śataṃ vā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaśca go dhanādidakṣiṇān vitīrya| pañcagavyena pañcopaniṣadā tatkṣetraṃ saṃprokṣya| kuddālaiḥ khanitraiḥ vā, yāvaṃbaḥtāvat bhūmiṃ khanet| yāvat prathamāvaraṇa vistāraḥ tāvat daṇḍamātraṃ vā kṣetradoṣānurūpyeṇa,mandirocchrāyānuguṇyena vā, bhūtale khanyamāne ;bhasmāṅgāra tuṣaduṣṭa satvakrimi kīṭādidarśane ghṛtādinā śānti homaṃ kṛtvā;brāhmaṇebhyaḥ yathāśakti suvarṇādi dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt|ratnādi darśane dhāma sadāsamṛddhaṃ bhavet|khātāt bahiḥ caturaśre sthaṇḍile agniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya,mūlamantreṇa ājyena nṛsūktena caruṇā guggulu tila nīvāraiḥ mūlamantreṇa ca khātahomaṃ kṛtvā|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā prokṣya| śālīn khāte prakṣipya|tadupari vastrasūtrādi veṣṭitānlohamayān mṛṇmayān vā kumbhān nava saṃsthāpya|ādhāraśaktiṃ sauvarṇīṃ madhyakumbhenikṣipya|prācyāṃ bījāni āgneyyāṃ sarvalohāni, dakṣiṇe sarvadhātūn, naiṝte puṇyatīrthamṛdam,vāruṇe madhu, vāyavīye sarpiḥ, uttarasyāṃ diśi ratnāni, aiśāne śailamṛttikāṃ ca nikṣipya|punaśca madhye śālikṣetra mṛdam āśoṣya hradasaṃbhūtāṃ mṛdam valmīkamṛdam utpalakandāni caprāṅmukhaḥ sthitvā nikṣipya| tatra lohāni ratnāni darbhakūrcaṃ ca nikṣipya śarāveṇapidāya|madhyakumbhasya upari anya kuṃbham nidhāya, tasmin sauvarṇaṃ kūrmakālāgniṃnikṣipya|tasya upari kumbhaṃ anyaṃ nidhāya|tasmin sauvarṇīṃ anantākṛtiṃ nikṣipya| tadupari ca anyaṃ kumbhaṃ tasmin sauvarṇīṃ vasudhāṃtadupari ca anyaṃ kuṃbhaṃ tasmin sauvarṇe aṃbujaṃ ca nikṣipya|sarvān gandhodakenasaṃpūrya|puṇyābhiḥ khāta mṛdbhiḥ aduṣṭābhiḥ vālukābhiśca pūrayitvā| jalaiḥ khāta bhūtalaṃsaṃpūrya| hastipādaiḥ dhṛḍīkṛtya|punaḥ jalena paripūrayet| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ karṣaṇavidhiḥ nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<3 >
tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ | bālālaya pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ | atha bālālaya pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate | ārabhyamāna prāsādasya indreśānāṃ’tare someśayoḥindrāgnyoḥ yamanaiṝtyoḥ niṝti varuṇayoḥ varuṇa vāyvoḥ vāyusomayoḥ vā antaresvābhimate deśe bālālayaṃ prakalpayet| tatra saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ tribhiḥ vā hastaiḥ bālālayaṃkalpayet|mūlamandirasya valajaṃ yasyāṃ diśi tasyāmeva bālālayasyāpi nidadhyāt|lohajaṃ śailajaṃ dārujaṃ vā caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakra gadāpadmadharaṃ utsedhatohrāse pañcāṅkulaṃ vṛddhautrayo viṃśatyaṅgulaṃ yajamāna sukhāvaha mānānuguṇaṃ vā bālabimbaṃ kāryam|mūlālayasthāpyeṣu matsyādyavatāreṣu bālabimbaṃ vā tathārūpaṃ, viśvarūpe tu caturbhujaṃ,sthityāsana śayaneṣu ca tathaiva bālabimbaṃ kārayitvā|tadaṅkurārpaṇapūrvakaṃ jale adhivāsya|kumbhasthāpanādhivāsa homādi kṛtvā| bālagehasya madhye divyeṃśe vāhastamātrasamucchritāṃ mekhalātrayayutāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā| prabhāte sumuhūrte śaktinyāsacaturthasnapana varjam tasyāṃ devaṃ yathāvidhi saṃsthāpya| saṃprokṣya| mantrān vinyasya saṃpūjayet|tataḥ āmūladhāmaprārambhāt āsamāpteḥ hare vibho| pūjāṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan asmin tvaṃ bāla mandire| śamayan mūladhiṣṇyasya vighnakṛddaitya saṃhitam| iti mantreṇa prārthya|vijñāpya praṇamya|caṇḍapracaṇḍa kṣetrapāla khageśān dvāre indrādilokapālān tattaddikṣu īśāna bhāge seneśaṃ naiṝte gaṇeśaṃ ca aśarīriṇaḥ sarvān etānbālamandirasya paritaḥ hastamātrātu mekhalātrayayutāsu vṛttāsu caturaśrāsu vā vedikāsusthaṇḍile vā tādṛśe saṃpūjya|sarvān kumudādigaṇān mahāpīṭhe abhyarcya| guruḥ evaṃbālālayaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya| ante dhvajārohaṇapūrvakaṃ puṣpayāgāvasānikaṃ utsavaṃ athavāekāhotsavaṃ kuryāt| bālabimbaṃ lohajaṃ cet tenaiva sakalaṃ nityādi karmakuryāt| utsavārthaṃna cet bimbaṃ bālenaiva kuryāt| bālabimbaṃ śilādārujamayaṃ cet dārusaṃgraha śilāsaṃgrahapūrvakaṃ bālabimbaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayet|ālaya nirmāṇa vidhiḥpaścāt rathakāraḥ sthapatibhiḥ saha mandiranirmāṇamārabheta| tatra mukhya madhyamādhamasañcitāsañcitopasañcita kalpana bhedaṃ śileṣṭakādārvādiṣu garbhādi doṣa lakṣaṇānidevatāntarālayagatatvādi doṣān ca samyak jñātvā mūlamandiraṃ kalpayet |khātabhūtale jalena samatāṃ vīkṣya prakṛtiṃ kṣitau vinyasya| śāstra cakṣuṣā prathamāṃphalakāmādāya | sudhayā tāṃ dṛḍhīkṛtya| jalena samatāṃ vīkṣya | tasyopari upapīṭhaṃ tadupariadhiṣṭhānaṃ upapīṭhenavinā adhiṣṭhānaṃ vā parikalpya | adhiṣṭhānaṃ vā yadvā pūrvamadhiṣṭhānaṃ tadupariupānahaṃ tadupari pādaṃ tataḥ prastaraṃ paścāt grīvāṃ tadanu śikharaṃ evaṃ yathākramaṃ ekatalakalpane yathāvatsthūpi evaṃ kuryāt | dvitala kalpane tu adhiṣṭhāna caraṇa prastarakūṭaśālāsaṃsthāna pañjara prastara vedikāgrīva śikharāṇi evaṃ krameṇa tritalādi ādvādaśa talamevameva|tataḥ adhikeṣu upānajagatī kumudapaṭṭikā kaṇṭhapaṭṭikā mahatīpaṭṭikā vājana vedikācaraṇatalottara haṃsamālā kapota pratiprativedikā kaṇṭhaśikharāṇi iti evaṃ aṣṭādaśā’kalpanamiti yāvatsthūpi yajamānānuguṇyena vā kuryāt| pūrvamevaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvidhi paṭādaunirmāya anantaraṃ mandira nirmāṇaṃ ca kuryāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃbālālayapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ nāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<4 >
caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ | prathameṣṭakā vidhiḥ | atha prathameṣṭakā vidhiḥ ucyate | ādau tāvat ācāryaḥ śāstroktavartmanā prācīparīkṣya|prācyādi vibhāgena dvārāṇikalpayitvā| caturviṃśatyaṅgulāyataṃ dvādaśāṅgulāyataṃ vā aṅguṣṭapariṇāhaṃ śubhaṃ ṛjuṃ kṣīravṛkṣajaṃśaṅkuṃsamānīya| prāsādasthāna madhyabhāge mūlamantreṇa saṃsthāpya| śaṅkudviguṇamānena paritaḥmaṇḍalānte pūrvāparāṅgayoḥ chāyāmālokya| chāyāntarmaṇḍalānte pūrvataḥ paścimataḥ bindudvayaṃvilikhya| tayoḥ madhyataḥ pūrvabindumārabhya aparabinduparyantaṃ sūtramāpātya|tayorantaraṃ yathākacchapānana pucchavat bhavet tathā vidhāya| tadanvevameva uttarataḥ dakṣiṇataśca kṛtvā| evaṃcatasṛṣu dikṣu ca tri pañca saptahastaṃ yathābhimataṃadhikaṃ vā sūtraṃ nipātya|diksūtrabhramaṇenaivayathā caturaśraṃ bhavet tathāsamālikhya| dikṣu aṣṭāsu yathānyāyaṃ śaṅkūn saṃsthāpayet|śaṅkusthāpanavelāyāṃ nimittāni parīkṣet| śubhāni cet śubhaṃ phalaṃ|viparītāni cetśāntimācaret|sthitāsana śayana yāna viśvarūpa biṃbānuguṇyena caturaśra vṛtta vṛttāyata caturaśrāyata bhedānjñātvā| yajamānaḥ bhuktikāmaścet yugmaiḥhastaiḥ, mokṣārthī yadi ayugmaiḥ ekahastamārabhyadaśahasta paryantaṃ yathābhimataṃ prāsādaṃ dvādaśāṅgulāntaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ mānayitvā|tatravimānaṃ ca nirmāya prathameṣṭakāṃ ārabhet| iṣṭakā śilā kāṣṭa mṛṇmayabhedenatrividhā|vimāne śailaje śilayā, kāṣṭhaje kāṣṭhena, pakveṣṭhakāmaye supakveṣṭakayā, āmeṣṭakāmayeca āmeṣṭakayā, śailākāṣṭamaye śilākāṣṭhamaye ca śilayā, iṣṭakākāṣṭhamaye dhāmnīṣṭakayā caprathameṣṭakayā kāryā| pratimārthaṃ śilāsaṃgraha kalpena śilāṃ saṃgṛhya |tāsu pulliṅgādiparīkṣāṃkṛtvā| pulliṅgaśilayā pādādi sthūpyantaṃ, strīśilayā prathameṣṭakāṃ,napuṃsakaśilayā mūrdheṣṭakāṃca kuryāt|dārviṣṭakāḥapi pratimā dārusaṃgrahavat grāhyāḥ| viparītakaraṇe mahān doṣaḥ|rājarāṣṭrakṣayaśca| chede kāṃsya ghaṇṭādhvaniḥ mūrdhni, madhye kāṃsyadhvaniḥ, mūle tāladhvaniḥyasyāṃ sā puṃśilā|tasmāt kiṃcidūnadhvaniḥ strī śilā| nādahīnā napuṃsakaśilābhavati|atha mṛṇmayeṣṭakāvidhiḥ pūrvamācāryaḥ rathakāranirdiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ samāsādyaṃtatrapuṇyāha pūrvakaṃagniṃpratiṣṭhāpya| jvalite asmin mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ ājyena caruṇāpuruṣasūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ samidbhiḥ aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyakābhiḥ bhūyopi ca mūlamantreṇa hutvā|caruṇā viṣṇu pāriṣadān uddiśya, kṣetrapālāya, bhūtebhyaḥ, vāstunāthāya,devebhyaḥ,ṛṣibhyaḥ,devagaṇāya iti ca ājyena svāhāntābhiḥ bhūrādi saptavyāhṛtibhiśca hutvā|pūrṇāhutiṃ ca hutvā | pūrvādiṣu catasṛṣu dikṣu ‘‘viṣṇu pārṣadebhyaḥ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ vāstunāthāyakṣetrapālāya’‘ iti namontaiḥ etaiḥ mantraiḥ caruṇā baliṃ ca kṛtvā| agnimudvāsya| kulālenaiṣṭakāḥ kārayet| tāsvapi ca ṛjuḥ yugmā rekhā yasyāṃ sā puruṣeṣṭakā prathamā| tiraścīnāyugmā rekhā yasyāṃ sā strīṣṭakā dvitīyā | nīrekhā pāśrvayoḥ vakrarekhā vā napuṃsakeṣṭakātṛtīyā| prāsādādikaraṇe prathamā | pīṭhādikaraṇe dvitīyā| prāsāda garbhādhānādi karaṇetṛtīyā | tadāyāmastu hastamānaḥ cet uttamaḥ| aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmaḥ madhyamaḥ |ṣoḍaśāṅgulāyāmaḥ adhamaḥ| āyāmārdhena vistāraḥ| vistārārdhena ghanam | āyāmasamavistārāsyāt ācchādaneṣṭakā | idaṃ mahāmānamprāsādatulyaḥ vistāraḥ|tadviguṇaḥāyāmaha idam alpamānam| evamiṣṭakāḥ kārayitvā|tāḥ pakvāḥ śubhāḥdṛḍhāḥsaṃpādayet| devālaye catasraḥ prathameṣṭakāḥ| manuṣyālaye pañca pakveṣṭakāmaye dhāmni pakvāprathameṣṭakā ityādi vedyam| tataḥ maṇḍapaṃ prapāṃ vā kalpayitvā| vitānādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya|tanmadhye saptatālāyatāṃ hastamātrasamucchritāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā| mṛtsaṃgrahaṇapūrvakaṃaṅgurān arpayitvā| tataḥ vedikāmadhye śālīnāṃ bhāracatuṣṭayena tadupari tadardhena taṇḍulānāṃtasyopari tadardhena tilānāṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| antarāntarayogena āhataiḥ vāsobhiḥācchādya| tadupari salakṣaṇān sūtravastrādiveṣṭitān saratnahemakūrca pippaladalān kumbhānnava vinyasya| tadvedikottarabhāge pūrvavat dhānyapīṭhaṃ parikalpya| iṣṭakādhivāsārthaṃdarbhānāstīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| snapanārthaṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇayuktān nava kalaśān dhānyapīṭhesaṃsthāpya| brahmādi īśānāntaṃ ghṛtakṣīra dadhiguḍa pañcagavya phalarasa gandhaloha madhubhiḥsaṃpūrya| vastreṇa āveṣṭya| krameṇa paravāsudeva puruṣa satyācyuta ananta keśava nārāyaṇamādhava govindān āvāhyaabhyarcya| catasraḥ strīliṅgeṣṭakāḥ samādāya| puṇyāhapurassaraṃvāsudevādīn āvāhyaabhyarcya| pīṭhe saṃsthāpya| payovratasāmnā payasā, madhuvāteti guḍena,yāḥphalinīriti phalavāriṇā, hiraṇyagarbha mantreṇalohavāriṇā,dadhikrāviṇṇetidadhnā,pañcavāruṇiketi pañcagavyena,gandhadvāreti gandhāṃbunā, madhuvātetimadhunā, ghṛtasnāte tisāmnā ghṛtena ca abhiṣicya| pṛthak pṛthak iṣṭakāḥ sadarbhena vastrayugmenasaṃveṣṭya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| iṣṭakāḥśayaneadhivāsya pūrvādidvāreṣu toraṇa kumbhānsaṃsthāpya| tattaddaivatāni āvāhyaabhyarcya| pūrvasthāpita madhyakumbhe paramātmānaṃupakumbhāṣṭake viṣṇvādīn āvāhya abhyarcya| pāyasaguḍodanāni nivedya| tasya pūrve uttarevā kuṇḍau sthaṇḍile vā agnimānīya| samidājya carubhiḥ yathāvidhi ca punaḥ samidājyatila puṣpaiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ ca nṛsūktena caruṇā ca hutvā| saṃpātājyaṃ pātrāntaresaṃgṛhya|tena iṣṭakāḥ sparśamantreṇa saṃspṛśet|pratisaraḥatha pratisarabandha karmakariṣye iti saṃkalpya| pratisaraṃ puṇyāhajalena prokṣya|hemamayaiḥkārpāsamayaiḥ vā pratisaraiḥastra mantreṇa saṃbadhya| ‘oṃ hrīṃ svaṃ svapnādhipataye svāhā itimantreṇa sarpiṣā aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| tataḥ ācāryaḥ yajamānena saha darbhaśayyāyāṃsvapnārthaṃ śayīta| svapne śubhe śubhaṃ phalam| aśubhe śānti homaṃ kṛtvā| vibhātāyāṃ vibhāvaryāṃśubhe muhūrte ṛtvigbhiḥ saha iṣṭakāḥ samādāya| dhāmapradakṣiṇī kṛtya| antaḥ praviśya| klṛptadvāradeśasya dakṣiṇataḥ pādamūle vedaghoṣaiḥ vādyaghoṣaiḥ ca saha nikṣipet| prādakṣiṇyena indrādisomāntaṃ iṣṭakāḥ mūlamantreṇa śriyaḥmandire śrī sūktena nidadhyāt| dakṣiṇa paścimayoḥ mūlaṃpūrvottarayoḥ agraṃ ca kuryāt|upānat viṣamo yathā na bhavet tathā nidadhyāt| sarvaṃ karmāpuṇyāhapurassaraṃ nidadhyāt| tadā yajamānaḥ gurave vastrābharaṇapūrvāṃ śataniṣphaparimitāṃdakṣiṇāṃ tadardhaṃ ṛtvigbhyaḥ tadardhaṃ paricārakebhyaśca dadyāt| iti prathameṣṭakā vidhiḥ nāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<5>
pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ | garbhanyāsaḥ | atha garbhanyāsavidhiḥ ucyate | pūrvavat samadhyavedikaṃ kalpayitvā| madhyavedikāṃ gomayena upalipya| tasyāṃbhāracatuṣṭayaparimitayā vrīhyā tadupari tadardhena taṇḍulena tadupari tadardhenatilena caantarāntarayogena vastrācchādana sahitaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| madhye vastraratnaloha kūrcapippaladalapidhānaṃ mahākumbhaṃ paritaḥ tāmrajān aṣṭau kumbhān ca saṃsthāpya| gandhodakaiḥāpūrya| madhyakumbhe śaṅkha cakra gadākhaḍga śārṅga musalāni sauvarṇāni nidāya| tasmin’‘oṃhrīṃ vasudhāyainamaḥ’‘ āgaccha āgaccha iti vasudhāṃ āvāhya| gandhādibhiḥ abhyarcya|kumbheṣuaṣṭāsu ca indrādīn āvāhya| abhyarcya| parvata hrada puṇyatīrtha valmīkakarkaṭāśayana nadī vṛṣa vṛṣāṇāgra dantīdanta payonidhi hala saṃsthitāḥ mṛttikāḥ daśa cakumudāravinda kaśerūtpala nīlotpalānāṃ pañca kandān manaśśilā haritālāñjana śyāmasīsa saurāṣṭra rocana gairika pāradān saptadhātūn, vajra vaidūrya mauktika sphaṭika puṣyarāgacandrakānta mahānīla padmarāga śaṅkābhidhānāni navaratnāni, śāli nīvāra kaṅgu priyaṅgu tilamāṣa mudga yava vaiṇavāni nava bījāni hiraṇya rajata tāmrāyasa trapu sīsa sauvarṇa kūrma śaṅkacakrāṇi navaitāni ca saṃgṛhṇīyāt| sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmramāyasaṃ vā garbhapātraṃ alābhe dārujaṃvā ṣoḍaśāṅgulāyataṃ dvādaśāṣṭa caturaṅgulānyatama vistāraṃ tadardhocchrāyaṃ padacatuṣṭayena upetaṃtattritayena vā sāpidhānaṃ vṛttaṃ caturardhaṃ vā tanmadhya gartānāṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥnavabhirvā kārayitvā|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| pañcagavyena prakṣālya| vedikā saṃsthita navakumbha jalaiḥvedādinā abhiṣicya| tasyāmeva vedikāyāṃ pūrvavat sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayitvā| sadarbhavastreṇatadbhājanaṃ āveṣṭya vedikā madhye nidadhyāt| ṣoḍaśasu tadgarteṣu suvarṇādīni samudramṛdantānidravyāṇi, tadabhāve kevalaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā vinyaset| navagarta vidhāne tu navasugarteṣu ca samudrikamṛdaṃ pūrvaṃ āpātya| prācīna garte parvatamṛdutpalakanda manaśśilā vajraśāli hiraṇyāni,dakṣiṇe tīrthamṛda kanda haritāla vaidūrya nīvāra rājatāni, paścime nadīmṛtmaratakanīlotpalakandāñjanakaṅgu tāmrāṇi, uttare hradamṛtkaśeru kanda puṣyarāga priyaṅgvayāṃsi,āgneyekulīrāśaya mṛtsīsa sphaṭikamāṣatrapūṇi, naiṝte valmīkamṛtsaurāṣṭra mauktikatilakāṃsyāni, mārute halamṛttikā rocanācandrakānta mudga sauvarṇa kūrmapratikṛtīḥ, aiśānedantidantamṛttikā mahānīlagairika veṇudhānya sauvarṇa śaṅkhān, brahmapade vṛṣaviṣāṇāgramṛttikā padmakanda padmarāga pāradayava sauvarṇa cakrāṇi ca mūlamantreṇa vinyasya| tatpadmaṃviṣṇugāya rtyā abhyarcya| kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā agniṃ vidhivat upasamidhya| samidbhiḥsarpiṣā ca viṣṇuṣaḍakṣareṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| pātrāntare saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya| caruṇānṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥhutvā| anantaraṃ tilājyamiśra caruṇā ‘indrādi lokapālebhyaḥ,bhuvanebhyaḥ, parvatebhyaḥ, samudrebhyaḥ, ādityebhyaḥ, vasubhyaḥ, marudbhyaḥṛṣibhyaḥ, vedebhyaḥ,sarvaśāstrebhyaḥ purāṇebhyaḥ, pātālebhyaḥ, digbhyaḥ,nāgebhyaḥ, gaṇebhyaḥ, sarvabhūtebhyaḥ,narendrebhyaḥ, nakṣatrebhyaḥ, sarvebhyaḥ grahebhyaḥ itipraṇavādi svāhāntaṃ hutvā| pūrvagṛhītasaṃpātājyena garbhabhājanaṃ’‘oṃ dhīṃ namaḥ parāya lohitavarṇāya sparśatanmātrātmane’‘ itisaṃsicya| pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā| rajanyāṃ sumuhūrte saveda vādyaghoṣaṃ tadbhājanamādāya| devāgāraṃpradakṣiṇī kṛtya| garbhageham praviśya| dvārasya antarmukhasya dakṣiṇa pāśrvaṃ tribhāgī kṛtya|bhāgadvayaṃ visṛjya| dvāranikaṭasyekabhāge pādapāśrve devānāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ brāhmaṇaḥyajamānaścet,rājā cet kumudopari, vaiśyaḥ yadi kumudādhaḥ, śūdraḥ yadi jagatau garbhanyāsaṃ kuryāt|uktaviparyayanyāse mahān doṣaḥ bhavati| tasmāt sthānabhraṃśaṃ na kārayet|tadā ācāryaḥ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ saparvata dvīpa samudradiggajaṃ śeṣaphaṇīndra phaṇāmaṇḍalasthitaṃdhyātvā| dvibhujaṃ śyāmāṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitāṃ ṛtusnātāṃ vasudhāṃ ātmānamapisarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ keśavaṃ dhyātvā|garbhabhājana sthānagartaṃ gomūtreṇa anulipya|sarvabhūtadhare kānte parvatastana maṇḍite|samudraparidhānīye devī garbhaṃ samāśraya| ‘‘iti mantreṇa tasmin garte garbhabhājanam vinyasya| vidhānena pidhāya|sudhayā dhṛḍhīkṛtya| samantataḥ rakṣāṃ kuryāt| tadā garbhasya skhalane durnimitte ca pūrvavatprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt| garbha nyāsam akṛtvā grāmaṃ prāsādaṃ vā kuryāt yadi, tadā nacirādevaubhaukṣayaṃ yāyātām|tadānīṃ yajamānaḥ gurave pūrvokta saṃkhyayā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| iti garbhanyāsa vidhiḥnāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<6 >
ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ | mūrdheṣṭakāvidhiḥ ucyate | pūrve maṇḍapaṃ prapāṃ vā madhye vedikādvayena saha kalpayitvā| madhyavedikāyāṃ pūrvavat vrīhiśāli taṇḍula tilaiḥ savastrācchādanaṃ staṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| tasmin pūrvokta lakṣaṇayutānnavakumbān puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ saṃsthāpya| iṣṭakādhivāsārthaṃ dvitīya vedikāyāṃ ca sthaṇḍilaṃpūrvavat kṛtvā| darbhān āstīrya| mūrdheṣṭakā śuddhyarthaṃ snapanakarmakariṣye| iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| tatra navakalaśān salakṣaṇān saṃsthāpya| tān ca pūrvoktaviśeṣeṇaviśiṣṭān vidhāya|brahmādi īśānāntaṃ pūrvavat ghṛtādi dravyaiḥ āpūrya| teṣu pūrvavattadadhidaivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya| napuṃsakeṣṭakāḥ catasraḥ saṃgṛhya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya| teṣu vāsudevādīn āvāhya abhyarcya| pīṭhe saṃsthāpya| navakalaśaiḥ tattanmantreṇa tāḥkrameṇa pṛthak abhiṣicya| sadarbha nava vāsobhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak saṃveṣṭya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya|pūrvakṛta dvitīyavedikā sthaṇḍilopari tāḥ śāyayitvā|pūrvavat dvāratoraṇa kumbhānsaṃsthāpya|tattaddaivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya|madhyavedikākumbheṣu madhye paramātmānaṃupakumbhāṣṭake viṣṇvādīn āvāhya abhyarcya|pāyasānnaṃ nivedya|vedikāyāṃ catasṛṣu dikṣuadhivāsahomaṃ dhāmnaḥ aṣṭasu dikṣu śānti homaṃ ca kṛtvā|saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya|tenasparśamantreṇa tāḥ spṛṣṭvā|pūrvavat saṃkalpādi pūrvasūtraiḥ pratisaraṃ badhnīyāt|tataḥpañcaviṃśatikalaśasnapana karmakariṣye|iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya|pūrvāyatāni daśaudakāyatāni tāvanti sūtrāni nipātayet|tadākṛte ekottarāśīti padāni bhavanti|teṣumadhyapada navake kumbha navakaṃ tatparitaḥ dvedve paṅktiṃ vīdhyarthaṃ parimājrya| tadbahiḥpūrvādisomāntaṃ dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi āgneyādīśānāntaṃ ekaikaṃ kumbhānāṃ vrīhi taṇḍulatilakṛtasthaṇḍilopari vinyasya| madhyakumbhanavakaṃ ghṛtoṣṇodaka navaratna phalasaptalohamārjana gandhākṣata yavaiḥbrahmādīśānāntaṃ krameṇa āpūrya|pūrvādi diksthamadhya kumbhāncaturaḥ krameṇa pādya arghya ācamana paṃcagavyaiḥ āgneyādi koṇasthitāncaturaḥ dadhikṣīra madhukaṣāyaiḥ pāśrvasthita kumbhāṣṭakaṃ śuddhodakena ca āpūrya|pūrvokta viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭān ādhāya|dravyakumbheṣu paravāsudevādi dāmodarāntān śuddhodaka kumbheṣu nārāyaṇaṃ caāvāhya|abhyarcya| tataḥ yajamānaḥ ācāryaḥ snātvā vastrāṅgulīyakādibhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣitaḥupoṣitaḥ| tatra darbhān āstīrya| paramapuruṣaṃ dhyāyan śāyīta|śvabhūte sumuhūrte kṛtakṛtyaḥguruḥ iṣṭakāḥ pañcaviṃśatikalaśaiḥ mūlamantreṇa mahākumbhatoyena ca snāpayitvāabhyarcya|mūlena jalaiḥ vāsobhiḥ veṣṭayitvā| sarvālaṅkṛtānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ mūdhrni vinyasya|savedavādyaghoṣaṃ dhāmapradakṣiṇī kṛtya|vimānoparitale iṣṭakāḥ āropya| puṇyāhaṃvācayitvā|ācāryaḥ bhūṣaṇadāsīdāsa vāhana chatra cāmarapādukādīn mahādakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyāt|rathakāraṃ ca tathā vastrānnadhanadānyādibhiḥ toṣayet|atra sthūpikākīla vidhiḥ ucyate |sauvarṇa rājataṃ tāmraṃ vā dārujaṃ vā vakra kalpayet | vṛttāyate caturaśrāyate ca vimānesthūpikākīlāni yugmāni syuḥ;itareṣu vimāneṣuayugmāni|viṃśati yāvatyugmāni;ekonaviṃśatiṃ yāvatayugmāni caturaśra ṣaḍaśrāṣṭāśra vṛtteṣu dhāmasu pidhāya|dvāratoraṇakumbhān pratyekaṃ navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ ācchādya|pālikādhi devatāḥ somakumbhaṃ capunaḥ api saṃpūjya| pāyasānnaṃ śuddhānnam vā nivedya| tataḥ kuṇḍa sthaṇḍilaṃ vā vidhivatagnipratiṣṭhādi daśamaḥ paricchedaḥ | pratiṣṭhā upakaraṇa vidhiḥ | atha tāvat pratiṣṭhā upakaraṇa vidhiḥ ucyate| tatra kuṇḍa lakṣaṇam prāsādasya agrabhāge prathamadvitīya tṛtīyāvaraṇeṣu yogyāvakāśeṣu eteṣuaṣṭāsu āśāsu abhimate deśe daśabhiḥhastaiḥ vistīrṇāyāmayutam caturdikṣu catudrvāramaṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvā| tanmadhye mānāṃtarāṅgula vaśena pañcahastāyāmavistārāṃekahastocchritām caturaśrāṃ vedimiṣṭakayā tataḥtālamānāṃ caturaṅgulavistārāṃ sātvikīṃ prathama mekhalāṃ, tatparitaḥ aṣṭāṅgulamānāṃ caturaṅgulavistārāṃ rājasīṃ dvitīya mekhalāṃ, tatparitaḥ caturaṅgulamunnatāṃ tāvat vistārāṃ tāmasīṃtṛtīya kuryāt| tasyāḥ naiṝte śaṅkuṃsaṃsthāpya| bhuvanasaṃkhyāṅgula vaśena sūtraṃ paribhrāmya| vṛttaṃ kṛtvā| vṛttaṃ caturviṃśatyaṅgula vaśena ṣoḍhā vibhajya|śaṅkuṃ nidhāya| pūrva paścima śaṅkubhyāṃ sūtraṃ nipātayet| evameva sūtranipāte kṛte,aṣṭāṅgulanirantaraṃ ṣaḍaśra kuṇḍaṃ bhavati|tathā viṃśatyaṅgulaṃ prakṛtiṃ khātvā| khātabhūtalāt dvyaṅgulaṃhitvā| kuṇḍa vaśena mekhalātrayaṃ kuryāt| tasmāt paścime tālatrayāt bahiḥ śaṅkuṃsaṃsthāpya|pakṣāṅgula vaśena sūtravatrmanā cakravat vṛttaṃ kṛtvā| pūrvavat prakṛtiṃ kuṇḍānuguṇyenamekhalātrayaṃ ca kuryāt|asya mekhalāsthāne dvādaśa aṣṭau vā dalāni kalpitāni ayugmāni eva, athavāyugmāni kuṇḍāni kārayet| madhyavedikāyāḥ pūrve dakṣiṇe vā bhāge salakṣaṇaṃśayanādhivāsārthaṃ pūrvavat vedikāṃ kārayet|atha tāvat sruksruva vidhiḥ ucyatesuvarṇādilohaiḥ vā pālāśādi yajñavṛkṣaiḥ vā sruk sruvau kārayet| srukdaṇḍaṃ tu bāhudaṇḍasamāyataṃ sāṃguladvitālāyataṃ vā sarvataḥ ṣaḍaṅgula vistāraṃ kṛtvā| taṃ guṇasaṃkhyayā vibhajya|uparyaṃśaṃ dvedhāvibhajya| tayoḥ uparyaṃśaṃ ca bhūtāṃśaṃ kṛtvā| tatra ādyamaṃśaṃ hitvā|uparisthitavedāṃśaiḥ varāhavadanavat agraṃ ekāṃgulānāhaṃ vidhāya| adhovisṛṣṭaikāṃśena sahasvatṛtīyāṃśāvaśiṣṭārdha bhāgena saṃyojite, tadā vistārāyāma samaṃ caturaśraṃ ṣaḍaṃgulamitaṃbhavati| evaṃ galaṃ kalpayitvā| tadadhaḥ nālaṃ dvyaṃgulavistāraṃ, tatrapāśrvayoḥardhāṃgulāyāmavistāra nimnayutaṃ kṛtvā| anyat sūtrapātāt bahiḥ sthitaṃ śeṣeṇa hitvā|galādhovaśiṣṭāṃśaṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃvā kalpayitvā| galamadhye tṛtīyabhāga saṃmitaṃvistārāyāmasamaṃ gādha sadṛśaṃ gartaṃ vṛttaṃ vā kṛtya|garta bāhyaṃ tredhā vidhāya| prathamavalayedalāṣṭakaṃ kṛtvā| madhyāṃśaṃ caturdhā vibhajya| ādyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalaṃ tasya bahiḥ nemimaṇḍalasyamadhye, maṇḍaladvayaṃ ca ekī kṛtya| tasmin ṣaṭ vā daśa vā indīvaradalavat arāṇikalpayitvā| avaśiṣṭena ekabhāgena nemi maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya|tatkoṇeṣu caturṣu śaṃkhān kṛtvā|bahiḥ mekhalāṃ yavonnatāṃ kṛtvā| caturyavapramāṇena gartaṃ ārabhya|agrāntaṃ sarpiṣaḥ vivaraṃkṛtvā| tatpṛṣṭha bhāgaṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhasadṛśaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhasadṛśaṃvā caturaśraṃ vidhāya| ādhāraṃvinā antyaṃvalayatrayāṅkitaṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ aṣṭāśraṃ vā kṛtvā|tadagraṃ ca yathāpuraṃ kamalākāraṃ kalpayet|sruvasya tu daṇḍaṃ hastamānaṃ kṛtvā| tadagraṃ dvyaṃgula vistāraṃ tanmadhye nāsikāpuṭavatardhāṃgulavistārāyāmaṃ vṛttaṃ gartadvayamāpādya| tadadhaḥ gartadvayasya madhye rekhikāṃ yavonnatāṃtayoḥparitaśca avaśiṣṭena ekāṃgulena galaṃ ca vidhāya|pariśiṣṭena golāṃgulākṛtiṃ kṛtvā|mūlaṃ dvyaṃgula vistīrṇaṃ kārayet|maṇḍapasya dvārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayepi prāgādikrameṇa aśvattha, udumbara,plakṣa,vaṭavṛkṣaiḥ teṣu ekena vāyathoktālābhe candanadrumeṇa vā toraṇāni kuryāt| tatpādān saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vāayugmaiḥhastaiḥ āyatān dvāviṃśāṃgulaghanān vṛttān caturaśrān vā kṛtvā|tadupari tadardhena āyatāḥ tādṛśānāhayutāḥ tathāvidhāśca paṭṭikāḥ kalpayitvā| prati paṭṭikaṃdvitālamānāni aṣṭāṃgulānāhayutāni trīṇi trīṇi kīlāni ca nidhāya| toraṇānāṃ pādeṣupūrṇakumbha dakṣiṇāvartaśaṅkha cakra dhvaja paṭaha kārmukanāgān ca citrayet|atha aṣṭa maṅgala vidhiḥyathāvibhavaṃ hemādi lohajāni vā yājñīya vṛkṣajāni vā krameṇa dvāviṃśāṅgula tadadrdhadvayaṅgulaiḥ āyāmavistṛti ghanayutāni sapīṭhāni phalakāni kalpayitvā|teṣu śrīvatsapūrṇakumbha bherī darpaṇamaṇḍala matsyayugma śaṅkhacakrāṇi, padmāsanasthitaṃ garuḍaṃca,dvāviṃśāṅgula mānena kalpayitvā| teṣāṃ pāśrvayoḥ mūrdhani ca cāmara pradīpa chatrāṇilāñchayet| biṃbapramāṇānuguṇyena auduṃbarasnānapīṭhaṃ nayanonmīlanapīṭhajalādhivāsanāsanādīn ca ācārya mūrtipāsana pādukāḥ ca upakumbha kalaśa karakamaṇikadīpastambha ghṛtādi snapanadravya candanādi sugandha vividhavastu samit puṣpa kuśa vividhadhānya suvarṇādiloha ratna savatsagoprabhṛtīn anyān ca saṃbhārān pūrvaṃ saṃpādya| tadanuācāryaḥ yathāvidhi pratiṣṭhāmārabhet|iti kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ pratiṣṭhā upakaraṇa vidhiḥnāma daśamaḥ paricchedaḥ |

ekādaśa paricchedaḥ | chāyādhivāsa jalādhivāsavidhiḥ | pūrvaṃ śilpibhiḥ śāstrokta vatrmanā bimbe māna-unmānapramāṇaparimāṇaupamānalambamānābhidhalakṣaṇayute nirmite, sthūlasūkṣmeṣu pratiṃmāṅgeṣu sukṛteṣu, karmārcā pīṭhikāyāṃ ratnādi nyāsaṃ kṛtvā| śilpinaiva nayaneca unmīlite,tataḥ guruḥ yajamānena saha rathakāraṃ śilpinaḥ ca ābharaṇa vastrādyaiḥ vastubhiḥ toṣayet| teṣu ca nirgateṣu sadanamantarbahiḥ ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya, darbhapuñjaiḥprajvālitaiḥ paryagnikaraṇaṃ ca kṛtvā| prākāra gopura maṇḍapāni ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya| pañcagavyaiḥ pavamānādi sūktaiḥ samprokṣya| goghṛtena sarvata bahūn dīpān uddīpya| kālāgaruprabhṛta dhūpadravyaiḥ sarvataḥ dhūpayitvā| dūrvākṣata sudhācūrṇaiḥ dhāma salaṃkṛtya| tataḥ aparāṅgha samaye, guru bimbasya’‘mānādinyūnātireka śāntyarthaṃ śānti homaṃ kariṣye’‘iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhama vācayitvā| vidhivat agniṃ saṃskṛtya| sākṣataiḥ śamīpallavaiḥ’‘ oṃbhūsvāhā’‘ ‘‘oṃbhuvasvāhā’‘ , ‘‘oṃ suvaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ mahaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ janaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ tapaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ satyaṃsvāhā’‘,iti pratyekaṃ śatamāhutīḥ caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ ca,’‘oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥ parāyaparameṣṭyātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāyapuruṣātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāyanivṛtyātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ lāṃnamaḥ parāyasarvātmane svāhā’‘,itipratimāsannidhau hutvā tadanu namastubhyaṃ bhagavate jāta vedasvarūpiṇe| nārāyaṇāya havyasya kavyasya ca yathātatham| bhoktre yaṣṭavyadevānāṃ ātmane paramātmane| sannidhatsva ciraṃ deva pratimāyāṃ hitāya naḥ| iti mantreṇa,adhokṣajamagnisthaṃ devaṃ devaṃ prāñjaliḥ san upasthāya| agniṃ praṇipatya | sadarbhena navena vāsasā mūlamantreṇa pratimāmācchādya|tenaiva uttarīyaṃ ca vitīrya| viṣṇu gāya rtyā aghrya pādyācamanīya gandha puṣpadhūpadīpādyaiḥ abhyarcya|śrī bhūmyostu oṃ śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ, oṃ hrīṃ bhūmyai namaḥ iti tattanmantraiḥ vastrācchādanādi dīpāntaiḥ abhyarcya | brahmādi parivārāṇāṃ ca svasva mantreṇa tathā kṛtvā| chāyādhivāsa siddhyarthaṃ rakṣā bandhana karmakariṣye, iti saṅkalpya | suvarṇādi pātre, khāridroṇa taṇdulavati ṣaṣṭyuttarakramuka taccaturguṇa nāgavāllīdala tadardha kadalyādi phalayute, niṣphapramāṇa svarṇa sūtrāṇi yadvā saptabhiḥ,pañcabhiḥ vā tantubhiḥ kṛtāni kṣaumamayāni kārpāsamayāni vā sūtrāṇi nidhāya| ahatena vāsasā ācchādya| tat paricāraka mūdhrni vinyasya| cāmara vyajanachatranṛttagīta bṛhaddīpaiḥ sākam dhāmāvaraṇāni grāmaṃ vā pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| bimbasya purataḥ caturaśraṃ bhūmiṃ gomayena anulipya| tatra dhānyabhāreṇa pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā|tadupari tatpātraṃ nidhāya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| sahasrāra huṃ phaṭ iti mantreṇa sūtrāṇi saptavāramabhi mantya| saṃpūjya| biṃbaṃ sampūjya| hastayoḥ aṅguṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ tāni gṛhītvā| tryaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ| urvārukamiva bandhanāt mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya māmṛtā iti mantreṇa candanakṣodena anulipya| viśvettāte savaneṣu pravācyā yācakarthamaghavannindrasunvate pārāvataṃ yat purasaṃbhṛtaṃ vaśvapāvṛṇoccharabhāya ṛṣi bandhave iti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇavā devasya dakṣiṇe, devyāḥ vāme ca haste baddhvā| astramantraṃ śatavāraṃjaptvā | yo brahmābrahmaṇa ujjahāra iti ghṛtasūktena abhimantya | bṛhatsāmakṣatrabhṛt eiti dhūpapātra bhasmanā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā| arghyādibhiḥ deva devyau ca abhyarcya| mahāpūpaṃ nivedya| ācāryaḥ svasyadakṣiṇa haste kautukaṃ baddhvā| devaṃ dviṣaṭkākṣara vidyayāpraṇamya| saṃstutya| devasya purataḥ bhūmau chāyādhivāsārthaṃ dhānyapīṭhe suvarṇādi lohajāṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vā jaladroṇīṃ tādṛśaṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya| gālitena gandhodakena āpūrya| darbhaiḥ paristīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| pūrvavat dvāratoraṇa kumbhān abhyarcya| jaladroṇyādi jalaṃ ‘‘oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣātmane namaḥ’‘ iti mantreṇa saṃśodhya| ‘‘oṃ rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane namaḥ’‘ itimantreṇa dagdhvā| ‘‘oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāyanivṛtyātmane namaḥ’‘iti ayutacandrasamaprabhaṃ nivṛtti mantraṃ dhyātvā| tadvinisṛtaiḥ amṛtaiḥpūritāṃ jaladroṇīṃ vicintya| tasmin ādhārādi padmāntaṃ yogapīṭhaṃsaṃkalpya| aṣṭāviṃśati darbhakṛta bimba dakṣiṇe jale yathākramaṃ niveśya| ‘‘oṃ saśarāya śārṅgāya nārācāya huṃphaṭ sudarśanāya svāhā’‘ iti mantreṇa cakra mudrāṃ ‘‘oṃ namo bhagavate raṃ pralaya kālānalāya huṃphaṭ’’iti mantreṇa agni prākāra mudrāṃ ca pradaśrya| pūrvādi dikṣu ṛgādīn caturaḥ vedān koṇeṣu itihāsa purāṇānica brāhmaṇeṣu paṭhatsu anirvāṇān dīpān āropya|tīre nānāvādyāni āghoṣayet| evaṃ trirātraṃ vā ekarātraṃ yāmārdhaṃ jalādhivāsa, chāyādhivāsavidhiḥnāma ekādaśa paricchedaḥ |

vāstunāthaṃ samarcayet| nayanonmīlanam atha maṇḍapaṃ mārjanālepana prokṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃśodhya| sudhācūrṇādibhiḥ tadbhuvamalaṅkṛtya| astrābhimantritān siddhārthān sarvataḥ dikṣu vikīrya| tataḥ nāstika trayodaśaḥ paricchedaḥ | karmāṅgasnapana vidhiḥ | atha tāvat bimbaśuddhyarthaṃ’‘snapana karmakariṣye’‘iti saṅkalpya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|pratisara karmaṃca pūrvavat vidhāya| adhamādhama snapanopayukta ghṛtādi kaṣāyāṃta snapanadravyāṇi pūrvaṃ saṃpādya| bimbasyapurataḥ caturaśraṃ gomayeṇa anulipya tatra caṃdanādrrāṇi sūtrāṇi prāgāyatāni udagagrāṇi ca ṣaṭ nipātya|teṣu pañcaviṃśati padeṣu madhye navapadāni tatparitaḥ ca aṣṭa dikṣu padāṣṭakaṃ ca kumbhasthāpanārthaṃ visṛjya| śeṣāṃ saṃmṛjya| kumbhāṣṭaka saptadaśakoṣṭeṣu pratyekamāḍhakaṃ tadardhaṃ prasthaṃvā vrīhīṇāṃ tatturyāṃśāni taṇḍulāni tatturyāṃśāni tilāni ca uparyupari krameṇa vinyasya| teṣu padmāni vilikhya| dve dve darbhāgre nikṣipya| sauvarṇān rājatān tāmrān vā yathāvibhava vistaraṃ mṛṇmayān vā droṇa paripūrakān kumbhān viṣṇugāya rtyā kumbhān prakṣālya| mṛṇmayān’‘indrannatveti’‘taṃtunā āveṣṭya| kalaśasthāpana medinyāḥ paścime bhāge kalaśādhivāsārthaṃ dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāya| tasyopari viśva mantreṇa prāgagrān udagagrān vā kuśānāstīrya| teṣuprāṅmukhaḥudaṅmukho vā kumbhān oṃ ityadhomukhān vinyasya| teṣu parameṣṭimantreṇa trīn trīn darbhān āstīrya|puruṣa mantreṇa aghryajalena prokṣya| viśvamantreṇa akṣatān vikīrya| nivṛtti mantrena tān utthāni kṛtva| ‘ ‘snapanārthaṃ hoṣye’‘iti saṃkalpya| vidhivat agniṃ saṃsādya| tasmin viṣṇu gāya rtyā ājyena aṣṭottara śatāhutīḥ hutvā| avaśiṣṭājyenasnapana dravyāṇi saṃsicya| kalaśa sthāpana vedhikā madhye koṣṭeṣu kumbha sthāneṣu madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ ghṛtena āpūrya| viṣṇu gāyatryā vinyasya| tatpūrva kumbhaṃ uṣṇodakayutaṃ tadāgneya māṇikya padmarāga nīlavajra puṣya pravāla mauktika marakata vaiḍūrya ratnapūritaṃ kumbhaṃ| ghṛtakumbhasya yāmye tathā vidha dāḍima cūtāmalaka bilva nārikela panasa mātula’ phalaiḥ bhinnairyutaṃ kumbhaṃ | ghṛtasya naiṛta diśi suvarṇa rajata tāmra sīsa trapu kamsya ayassāraiḥ pratyekaṃ niṣphamātraiḥ pūritaṃ kumbhaṃ ghṛtasya paścima diśi rajanī sūryavartinī sahadevi śirīṣā sadābhadrā kuśāgrāmida mārjana dravyaiḥ pṛthak muṣṭimātrairyutaṃ kumbhaṃ ghṛtasya māruta diśi candana kuṣṭa kuṅkumāgaru uśīra hrībhera girisaṃbhava māṃsī murākhya gandha dravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ phalamātraiḥ yutaṃ kumbhaṃ| ghṛtasya uttare nīvāra veṇu śāli priyaṅgu yava kaṅgu ṣāṣṭika godhūma taṇḍulaiḥ pṛthak muṣṭi mātraiḥ dravyaiḥpūritaṃ kumbhaṃ| ghṛtasya aiśāna diśi yava vrīhibhiḥ pṛthak kuḍupamānaiḥ yutaṃ kumbhaṃ ca saṃ sthāpya| brahmasthāna sthitaṃ kumbha navakasya prācyāṃ diśi tulasī padma dūrvākṣata śyāmāka viṣṇu parṇī bilvapatraiḥ muṣṭi mātraiḥ candanena phalamātreṇa ca yutaṃ pādya kumbhaṃ, taddakṣiṇe siddhārtha akṣata kuśāgra phala tila puṣpaiḥ pṛthak muṣṭi mātraiḥ triniṣpha mātra candanena ca yutaṃ aghryakumbhaṃ| tatpaścime ta[?]ola caṃpaka mukula karpūra jāti phalairyelālava’ tvakcandana puṣpaiḥ palārdha pramāṇaiḥyutaṃ upasparśana kumbhaṃ| taduttare pañcagavyairyutaṃ kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya| madhya navakasyāgneye dadhi kuṃbhaṃ, naiṛte kṣīrakumbhaṃ, vāyavye madhukumbhaṃ, aiśāne śamī palāśa khādira bilvāśvattha vitata nyagrodha tvagbhiḥ palādrdha parimāṇābhiḥ pūritaṃ, kaṣāyakumbhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya| saptaviṃśati darbhakṛta kūrcaṃ ghṛta kuṃbhe saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ tribhirvā darbhaiḥ kṛtān kūrcān upakumbheṣu avāgagraṃ yathākaṇṭhamānaṃ pādyārghyācamanakaṣāya kuṃbheṣu paravāsudeva puruṣa satya acyuta anaṃta keśava nārāyaṇa mādhava goviṃda viṣṇu madhusūdana trivikrama vāmana śrīdhara hṛṣīkeśa padmanābha dāmodarān svasva mantreṇāvāhya| saṃpūjya| pūrva saṃpāditāgnau mūlena kalaśa saṃkhyayā ājyāhutīḥ caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ punarājyena kalaśadevatā mantraiḥ pṛthak sahsraṃ śatamaṣṭāviṃśatiraṣṭauvā āhutīrhutvā| saṃpādājyaṃ sparśa mantrena kumbheṣu saṃsicya| agnistamudvāsya| ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ vedapāragaiḥ brāhmaṇaiśca bimbasya antikaṃ gatvā ‘uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate’ iti mantreṇa bimbaṃ utthāpyā| ‘bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ’ iti snānāsana vedikāyāṃ prāṅmukhaṃ viniveśya| tadanu puṇyakṣetra nadītīra parvata pulina hrada nirjhara saṃgrama śoṣya vedikorvara śālikṣetra vedakhāta vṛṣaśṛ’ hastidanta varāhaghṛṣṭa valmīka kulirāvasata nalini dīrdhikā susthitāḥ ekonaviṃśati mṛttikāḥ pṛthak pātre samānīya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā prokṣya| bimbaṃ arghyādi upacāraiḥupacarya | puṇyakṣetrajaikonaviṃśati mṛttikābhiḥ ‘mūrdhānaṃdivo’ iti mantreṇa bimbaṃ mūrdhādi pādāntaṃ ālipya| śuddhodakena ‘imaṃmevaruṇa’ iti mantrena prakṣālyā| anantaraṃ bimbaṃ arghyādibhiḥ upacarya| ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti pādya kumbhena, ‘āpo hiṣṭhā’ iti aghrya kumbhena, ‘imaṃmevaruṇa’ iti upasparśanena, ‘pavitraṃ te’ iti pañca gavyena, ‘dadhikrāviṇṇo’ iti dadhnā, ‘payovrata’ sāmnā payasā, ‘madhuvātā’ iti madhunā, ‘yajñāyajña’ iti kaṣāyāmbunā, ‘mānastoke’ iti uṣṇa toyena, ‘vaṣaṭ te viṣṇoḥ’ iti maṇivāriṇā, ‘yāḥ phalinīḥ’ iti phalāmbunā, ‘hiraṇyagarbha samavartata’ iti lohavārinā, ‘śannodevīḥ’ iti mārjanāṃbhasā, ‘gandha dvārā’ iti gandhāṃbhasā, ‘trātāramindraṃ’ iti akṣatavāriṇā, ‘idaṃ viṣṇoḥ’ iti yavāṃbhasā, ‘ghṛtasnāta’ iti ghṛtaneca etaiḥ mantraiḥ etaiḥkalaśaiḥpādyapūrvaṃ ghṛtāntaṃ prati dravya ghaṭāplavaṃ upasnāna plotavastrottarīyāghrya pādyācamana gandha paṣpa dhūpa dīpa pradāna sahitaṃ abhiṣicya | anantaraṃ puruṣa sūktena sahasradhārayā śuddhodakena abhiṣicya| vastrādi alaṅkṛtya|arghyādibhiḥ upacarya| phalādikaṃ nivedya| tāṃbūlaṃca samarpayet|ghṛtasya upasnānaṃ uṣṇodakena| iti kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ trayodaśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

itimantraṃ,’‘viśvataścakṣuḥ’‘iti mantraṃ ca uccaran prākśiro dakṣiṇānanaṃ mandirānanaṃ dakṣiṇāśāśiraskaṃ vā bimbaṃ śayyāyāṃ śāyayitvā| ‘‘yuvāsuvāsāḥ’‘ itimantreṇa kambalaiḥ vastraiḥ vā sarvataḥ mūrtikumbhāṣṭakaṃ ca saṃsthāpya paristīrya| teṣu śaṅkhacakra gadāpadma dhvaja śrīvatsa garuḍakamaṭhān pratyekaṃ niṣphamātra jāṃbūnadakṛtān nikṣipya| mūrtikumbhānāṃ madhye pūrvokta lakṣaṇayutāni aṣṭau saṃsicya| mahānasāgni kuṇḍe adhiśrapaṇe ca gārhapatyāgniṃ saṃsthāpya| ācāryaḥ yajamānena saha devasya pārśvaṃ āsādya| praṇamya| utthāya| añjaliṃ baddhvā| imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| bhaktavatsala bhaktāmabhipretārtha sādhaka| prārthaye tvāmahaṃ deva! madanugrahakāmyayā|| sannidhatsva ciraṃsthāne kalpite śraddhayā mayā| prasīdadeva deveśapūjāmapi gṛhāṇa me| grāmasya rājñaḥ rāṣṭrasya prajānāṃ indirāvara| dehi puṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭiṃ ca gatiṃ ca paramāṃ tathā| iti vijñāpya| devāya madhuparkaṃ nivedayet| tadānīmeva ācāryānujñayā yajamānaḥ bhaktinamreṇaśirasā devasya dakṣiṇa haste toyapūrvaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ go bhū hiraṇyādi pūjopakaraṇāni ātmānaṃ putrapautradārādīn hastyādi vāhanāni dāsīdāsān ca sarvasvaṃ devasya pāśrvataḥ ānīya dadyāt| evaṃ ācāryamapi pūjayet| tataḥ ācāryaḥ svarṇādipātraṃ viṣṇugāyartyā prakṣālya| devasya purataḥ dhānyarāśau tat ‘asmadga urubhyo namaḥ’ iti saṃsthāpya| gandhodakena āpūrya| tasmin paramātmānaṃ āvāhya| vedādinā gandhādibhiḥ abhyarcya| yajamānaṃ āhūya,devasya abhimukhaṃ sthāpayitvā| tasya añjaliṃsapuṣpeṇa arghyajalena saṃpūrya|imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| tvayā vinā name kiñcit māṃ vinā tavakastathā| tasmānmāmātmasātkartuṃ prasīda parameśvara| bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalaṃbanam| tvayi vipratipannānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ vibho| ityācāryaḥ devaṃ vijñāpya| dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa yajamānasya ātmānaṃ añjalistha puṣpāghryajalena saha devapādapaṅkaje, ‘asmadga urubhyo namaḥ’ iti samarpayet| pratiṣṭhānte nṛttagītavādyaghoṣa nānāvidhastotrādibhiḥ upacāraiḥ devaṃ toṣayitvā| caturvidhaṃ annaṃ vidhivat nivedya| mahānase agniyamayoḥmadhye caturaśrakuṇḍe nityāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya| saṃskṛtya| samidājyacarubhiḥ mūlamantreṇa yathāvidhi pūrṇāhutyantaṃ hutvā| balipīṭhān saṃskṛtya| tattadāvaraṇeṣu pratiṣṭhāpya| teṣu nityaṃ yathāvidhi baliṃ dadyāt| bahubera pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu kavāṭabandhanaṃ na kuryāt| caturthe divase prāpte uttamatritayena, madhyamatritayena vā devaṃ catussthānārcanapūrvakaṃ kalaśaiḥ yathāvidhi samsnāpya| tadante dhvajārohaṇa pūrvakaṃ utsavaṃ kārayet| tadanu yajamānaḥ tasmin samaye suvarṇakusuma vastra aṅgulīyaka kuṇḍalakṣetrārāmagṛha dāsīdāsa śibikā gaja turagādibhiḥ jīvājīva dhanaiḥ ca,ācāryaṃ toṣayitvā| tasmai ca ātmānaṃ putradārādi nirapekṣaḥ san nivedya| guruṃ mātṛtvena pitṛtvena ca saṃbhāvya| praṇamya tasmaidhenūnāṃ sahasraṃ, athavā niṣphānāṃ uttamāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ,tadardhaṃ vā, ardhārdhaṃ vā dadyāt| atra śriyādidevīnāṃ devena sākaṃ kalpane vivāhakarma na kuryāt| pṛthak cet udvāhakarma aṅkurapūrvakaṃ yathāvidhi kuryāt| karṣaṇādipratiṣṭhāntaṃ aṅgatvena yadāhṛtam| tadiṣṭaśiṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ guroreva dhanaṃ bhavet| iti vacanāt sarvamapi gurave datvā mūrtipānāṃ paricārakāṇāṃ anyeṣāṃ nṛttagatiratānāṃ sadasyānāṃ ca yathāvittānusārataḥ dakṣiṇāma datvā| tadanu devaṃ stutvā| praṇamya| devena anugrahītaḥ yajamānaḥ guruṇā saha kanyakā go bhū hiraṇyādīni dānāni devasannidhau dvijebhyaḥ datvā| bahiḥ nirgatya kṛtakṛtyaḥ devaṃ ācāryaṃ ca namaskṛtya| guruṃ śibhikādikaṃ āropya| vādyaghoṣa purassaraṃ grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| tadveśma praveśayet| sthāpakaḥ devadevasya yaḥ pūrvaṃ deśikottamaḥ| tenaivārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ tadvaṃśyairapi nirguṇaiḥ| pūjā prītikarī saiva devasya kamalāsana| ādau vibhūti vistāraḥ yādṛśaḥ parikalpitaḥ| saṃkocamantareṇaiva kuryāt tādṛśasaṃpadaḥ| devabhūtyanusāreṇa racet devopajīvinaḥ| na kleśayet bhāgavatān tathaiva paricārakān| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ nāma aṣṭhādaśa paricchedaḥ |

ekonaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | matsyādimūrti pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ | atha vibhavamūrtisthāpanavidhiḥ ucyate | matsyādimūrtīnāṃ mahāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ iva adhivāsādikaṃ sarvamapi kuryāt|atra tu viśeṣaḥ kathyate| matsyamūrtiḥ vāruṇa sāmnā nṛsūktena mahākumbhaṃ abhimantya| tasmin ‘‘oṃ namobhagavate myūṃ matsyarūpāya’’ iti vā mūlamantreṇa vā samāvāhya| ācāryaḥ kumbhajalena prokṣya| mīnātmane namastubhyaṃ vedarakṣāvidhāyine| pralayārṇava durvāravāripūravihāriṇe|.’‘iti mantreṇa upatiṣṭheta| kūrmasya, vāruṇasūktena mahākumbhaṃ abhi mantya|aṣṭākṣara vidyayā samāvāhya|karmāvasāne, ‘‘tubhyaṃ namaskriyāṃ kurmaḥ kūrmarūpāya vedhase| dhāriṇe mandarasyādreḥ vibudhānandadāyine| ‘‘ityupatiṣṭheta| varāhasya,varāharūpiṇaṃ mahākumbhe puruṣasūktena āvāhya|karmāvasāne, kroḍātmane namastubhyaṃ yajñadehāya vedhase| daṃṣṭrāgra vidhṛtāśeṣa dharaṇīdharaṇīdhara| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| nṛsihmasya,nṛsihmarūpiṇaṃ mahākumbhe,’‘yuñjate’‘iti anuvākena samāvāhya|karmāvasāne, niśātanakhadaṃbholidalitāsuravakṣase| darśitāśritavātsalya nṛsihmavapuṣe namaḥ| ‘‘ityupatiṣṭheta| vāmanasya,vāmanaṃmahākumbhe’‘yuñjate’‘itianuvākenasamāvāhya|karmāvasāne, ‘‘balidviṣe namastubhyaṃ paritrātavaladviṣe| vāmanāya mahākāya vañcitāśeṣamānava| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| bhārgavarāmasya,jāmadagnyaṃmahākumbhe pauruṣeṇasūktena āvāhya,karmāvasāne, trisaptakṛta kṣatrāṇāṃ nihantre tigmatejase| namastubhyaṃ bhagavate paraśvathavidhāriṇe| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| rāghavasya,rāmaṃ sītālakṣmaṇādibhiḥsahitaṃ vā mahākumbhe pauruṣenasūktena āvāhya,karmāvasāne, namastubhyaṃ bhagavate rāghavāya mahātmane| rāvaṇādi jagaddveṣi nibarhaṇamahaujase|| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| rāmapratiṣṭhā pṛthak cet parivārātmanaḥhanūmatpramukhān ca pratiṣṭhāpayet| prathamāvaraṇe prācyāṃ bharataṃ, dakṣiṇe jānakīṃ, pratīcyāṃ jāmbavantaṃ, udīcyāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ, āgneyādividikṣu sugrīva, vibhīṣaṇa, nala,śatrughnānca saṃsthāpya|dvitīyāvaraṇe pūrvādidikṣu vasiṣṭha, vāmadeva, jābāli,gautama, bharadvāja, kauśika, vālmīka, nāradān, tṛtīyāvaraṇe indrādilokapālān,garuḍasthāne hanūmantaṃ,viṣvaksenasthāne nīlaṃ guhaṃ vā sthāpayet| utsave tu dhvajapaṭe garuḍaṃ hanūmantaṃ vā likhitvā dhvajārohaṇaṃ kuryāt| balarāmasya,balarāmaṃ pūrvavat kumbhe samāvāhya|karmāvasāne, baline balabadrāya namaḥ śeṣamahāhaye| tubhyaṃ māleva mahatī dharā yena śirodhṛtā| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| kṛṣṇasya,kṛṣṇaṃ bhagavadbimbavat saṃsthāpya|karmāvasāne, vṛṣnivaryāya kṛṣṇāya namastubhyaṃ madhudviṣe| bhūbhāra bhūtakaṃsādi mahāsuranighātine|| ‘‘ iti upatiṣṭheta|rukmiṇīsatyabhāmādīnāṃ śriyādīnāmiva udvāhakarmakuryāt| kalkiviṣṇoḥ pūrvavat kṛtvā|karmānte, mlecchānāmupasaṃhatrre sādhūnāṃ sthitihetave| namastubhyaṃ bhagavate bhūsurānvaya janmane|| ‘‘iti upatiṣṭheta| matsyādi daśamūrtīnāṃ ṣoḍaśanyāsaḥ na iṣyate| lohabiṃbānāṃ ca| tāsāṃ śilāmayīnāṃ varṇacitraṇaṃ yadi, adhivāsādikaṃ karma pūrvaṃ kṛtvā paścāt varṇalepanaṃ vidhāya| anantaraṃ āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt| dhruvabiṃbasthiteḥ bhinnakāle karmādyarcāsthāpanaṃ yadi, tāsāṃ pṛthageva śayanādikaṃ kuryāt| brāhmekarmārcāṃ, yāmye utsavakautukaṃ, uttare tīrthasnapanabiṃbe, dakṣiṇe śayanotthāpana biṃbe, balibiṃbaṃ ca anyāni lohabiṃbāni laukikāni iṣṭabhūmiṣu ca sthāpayet| yadvā utsavārthabiṃbāni dvārapāśrvayoḥ vā, abhiṣekamaṇḍape vā dakṣiṇābhimukhāni sthāpayeta| jalādhivāsayogyānāṃ tu chāyādhivāsanaṃ kūrcādarśamaṇḍala snapanaṃ kūrcadvārā śayanādhivāsaṃ ca kṛtvā, sarvaṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ ṣoḍaśanyāsa caturthasnapanavarjitaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt| vaṭapatraśāyinastu garbhamandirodare abhitaḥ vāridhaṃ vilikhya| taddale śayānaṃ śyāmalaṃ komalākṛtiṃ bālavapuṣaṃ devaṃ citrābhāsena kalpayitvā| dvārapāśrvayoḥ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahīṃ ca vilikhya citrābhāsoktavidhinā pratiṣṭhā karma kuryāt| atha lakṣmyādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate devasyadevīnāṃ ca sthāpanaṃ yadisamānakālīnaṃ tadā devyāḥ sahaiva śayanam|kālabhede tu pṛthageva kuryāt| pūrvavat samadhyavedikaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvā| tasmin vedikāyāṃ śāyayitvā| prāgādi toraṇeṣu balākinī vanamālinī vibhīṣikā śā’rīḥ,dvārakumbheṣu dvandvaśaḥ jyeṣṭhāvidyā śraddhā kānti śrī tuṣṭi kṣamā vṛddhiḥ| pūrvādi dhvajeṣu dvandvaśaḥ, dhṛti lajjā jayā māyā sāvitrī kṣamā śuddhi śraddhāśca saṃpūjya| prāgādi homakuṇḍeṣu lakṣmī,sarasvatī,puṣṭi,tuṣṭiśca āvāhya| svasva mantreṇa homaḥ kāryaḥ| kalaśa devatāstu vāgīśvarī kriyā kīrti lakṣmī sṛṣṭi prahvī satyā brāhmyaḥ| mahākumbhe śrīdevī| evaṃ vidhivat saṃpūjya| ṣoḍaśanyāsarahitaṃ śeṣaṃ karma pūrvavat kuryāt| eṣaḥ vidhiḥ asvātantye,svātantye tu grāme vā nagare vā pattane vā ālaye śriyaḥ sthāpanaṃ grāmābhimukhaṃ kalpayitvā| vimānopari catasṛṣu dikṣu tuṣṭi puṣṭi sāvitrī vāgdevīḥ,koṇeṣu sihmaṃ vainateyaṃ vā kalpayitvā| tatra brāhme sthāne śilādimayīṃ pratikṛtiṃ sthāpayitvā| svasvasthāneṣu parivārān dvāra pārśvayoḥ caṇḍīṃ pracaṇḍīṃ ardhamaṇḍapa dvāre dakṣiṇe balākinīṃ, uttare vanyamālinīṃ, prathama gopuradvāre vibhīṣikāṃ śāṅkarīṃ, dvitīya gopuradvāre śaṅkha padmanidhīṃ, tṛtīyagopuradvāre nalakūbara jṛṃbhalau, caturthagopuradvāre śibhikuṇḍala maṇibhadrau, pañcamagopuradvāre jayāṃ vijayāṃ viṣvaksena sthāne caturbhujāṃ vāmena vetraṃ, itareṇahastena tarjanaṃ ca kurvatīṃ| aparābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ padme dadhānāṃ, pītavarṇaṃ sumukhīṃ sthāpayitvā| prāsādamukhamaṇḍape vainateyaṃ| ādimūrteriva parivārāṃ ca kalpayitvā| svātaṃtrye evaṃ kalpayitvā| caturthe ahani snapanaṃ kṛtvā| taddine dhvajamutthāpya mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ vibhavamūrti śrīdevī pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ nāma ekonaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

viṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | pāṇigrahaṇa vidhiḥ | atha śriyādi devīnāṃ pāṇigrahaṇa vidhiḥ ucyate | yathoktadivase aṅkurārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā| ācāryaḥ udvāhadivase śubhe muhūrte devasya devyāśca saṃkalpa pūrvakaṃ pṛthak udvāhakautukaṃ yathāvidhi baddhvā| devaṃ kṣaumavastrottarīya kirīṭahārakuṇḍalādyābharaṇa gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ alaṅkṛtya| vaivāhika sadanaṃ praveśya|tatradevaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayitvā|ullikhya agniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya| ācāryaḥ devena saha antargarbhagṛhaṃ praviśya|devamāsane viniveśya| devīmnūtanena vāsasā ‘‘yuvāsuvāsāḥ’‘ itimantreṇa pradakṣiṇaṃ paridhāpya| ācamayya| ābharaṇapuṣpādyaiḥ alaṅkṛtya|ācāryaḥ svayaṃdevīṃ devena vedādinā saṃyojya| tadanu yajamānaḥ prāṇānāmya| saṃkalpya| jagatkāraṇabhūtāya devāya madīyāṃ gotrajāṃ kanyakāṃ prajāsahatvakarmabhyaḥ pratipādayāmi’ iti devīṃ sarvābharaṇasuvarṇagobhūsahitaṃ sahiraṇyodakaṃ devāya dadyāt| tataḥ gṛhītapāṇiṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca mandirāt kalyāṇamaṇḍapaṃ prāpayya| ācāryaḥ devaṃ devīṃ ca āsane viniveśya|svayaṃ uttarāśābhimukhaḥ san prānānāyamya|saṃkalpya| pūrvoktavaṅghau paristīrya|purastāttantram kṛtvā vidhyuktavatrmanā krameṇa ādhāra homam nṛsūktena samidbhiḥ ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ caruṇā viṣṇugāya rtyā caturviṃśatyāhutīḥ, śrīsūktena ghṛtena pañcāśatāhutīśca juhuyāt| śrībhūmyoḥ yugapat udvāhakarma yadi ubhayorapi aṅkurādikaṃ sarvaṃ pṛthageva kuryāt|ekakṛtve ekakālīnatve ca sati śrībhūmyoḥ aṅkurādikaṃ sarvaṃ pṛthageva|ekasmin kāle paryāyeṇa yadi tatrāpi bhinnamācaret| ānupūrvāvaśenāpi karma vibhaktameva syāt| yadvā muhūrte bhinne tu vaivāhikaṃ karma bhinnameva| muhūrtayoḥ yaugapadye kriyāṃ ānupūvryā kuryāt| śrībhūmyoḥ bhinnakartṛtve yaugapadyodvāhe’pi śrībhūmyoḥ pratisaraḥ pṛthageva| devasya tu eka eva|tayorapi ekāgnau bhinnāgnau vā yathābhimataṃ ullekhanādi purastāttantram kṛtvā|śrībhūmyoḥ api pāratantye sarvāḥ kriyāḥ prativyakti pṛthageva pūrvaṃ śriyai paścāt bhūmyai ca paryāyeṇa kuryāt| bhūmestu udvāhe bhūmimantreṇa samidbhiḥ ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ viṣṇugāya rtyā caruṇā caturviṃśatyāhutīḥ puruṣasūktena ghṛtena ṣoḍaśāhutīśca hutvā| tataḥ viṣṇusūktena lājahomaṃ kṛtvā| agniṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| ācāryaḥ lājaśeṣaṃ praṇavena sakṛt hutvā| ‘‘imaṃ me varuṇa’‘tatvāyāmi’‘tvanno agne’‘satvanno agne’‘tvamagne ayāsi’‘iti pañcavāruṇikaiḥ ghṛtena hutvā|pañcopaniṣaṇmantraiḥ prāyaścittāhutīḥ dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa pūrṇāhutiṃ ca hutvā|brāhmaṇān toṣayitvā| devaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| ghṛtāropaṇaṃ ācaret| ghṛtāropaṇaṃ yathāghṛtadūrvāṅkuracandana śālitaṇḍulāni pātre nidhāya|hastābhyāṃ tat ādāya|ācāryaḥ devasya, devyāśca aṅgeṣu’‘sumaṅgalaṃ’ iti dūrvāṃ, pādayoḥ ‘‘suśobhanaṃ’‘ iti ghṛtamkaṭyāṃ ‘subhadraṃ’ iti candanaṃ mūdhrni’ sumaṅgalam iti śālitaṇḍulāni ca kṣiptvā|sarvaiḥ sabhyaiḥ api yathā kārayitvā| ‘rasenāsmi’ iti madhuparkam nivedya|lakṣmīpatiṃ ca ābharaṇādyaiḥ alaṅkāraiḥ prasādhya|yathārhaiḥ mālyānulepanādyaiḥ api alaṅkuryāt|yajamānaḥ devaṃ praṇamya|tasmai dhenuḥ gurave yathāvittānusārataḥ dakṣiṇām dadyāt|tataḥ ācāryaḥ hareḥ nīrājanaṃ datvā| dikṣu piṇḍikākṣepaṇaṃ kṛtvā| laukikenamārgeṇa anyat sarvamapi vidhāya| śrībhūmi sahitaṃ devaṃ grāmadhāma pradakṣiṇam kārayitvā|maṇḍape devaṃ devyau ca āropya|rājopacāraiḥ upacarya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya| ante brāhmaṇān bhojayet| evaṃ divase divase snapanam,aharniśaṃ pūrvavat homam utsavam ca kṛtvā| turīyādināpararātrau samidājyacarubhiḥ lājena ca mūlamantrābhyāṃ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| tataḥ pañcopaniṣadaiḥ api hutvā|pañcamedivase devam devyau ca tailena abhyarcya| vidhivat susnāpya|mahāhaviḥ nivedya|grāme mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| tataḥ ārabhya śrībhūmi sahitaṃ devaṃ mandire abhyarcayet|itarāsāṃ devīnāṃ ca etādṛśāḥeva vidhiḥ|jāmadagnyādi devīnāṃ udvāhaṃ smārtavatrmanā kuryāt| iti śriyādi devīnāṃ pāṇigrahaṇavidhiḥ nāma viṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

dvāviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | maṇḍapapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ | atha maṇḍapapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥucyate | pūrvavatvedikāṃ nirmāya|ālayaviśodhanādi dhyānāntaṃ sakalaṃ karmajālaṃ vimānapratiṣṭhokta vidhinā kṛtvā| ācāryaḥ, maṇḍapaṃ viśvakarmīyaṃ sarvaratna pariṣphṛtam sauvarṇaiḥ bahubhiḥ stambhaiḥ navaratnavirājitaiḥ| uttaṃbhitaṃ sarvaśaktimayaṃ dhyāyedga uruḥ svayam| ‘‘ iti dhyātvā| vidhivat agniṃ purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ saṃskṛtya| tataḥ śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā sampātājyena maṇḍapasya tattasthāneṣu nyaset| ‘‘oṃ prakṛtyai svāhā’ ‘apāne,’‘oṃ vasudhāyai svāhā’‘jagatyām’,‘oṃ kriyāyai svāhā’‘vapre,’‘oṃ mohinyai svāhā’‘kaṃpe,’‘oṃ ratyai svāhā’‘vājane,’‘oṃ māyāyai svāhā’‘grīvāyām, ‘‘oṃ vāgīśvaryai svāhā’‘prātakaṃpe,’‘oṃ iṣṭāśaktyai svāhā’ ‘kumude,’‘oṃ kṣamāyai svāhā’ ‘paṭṭikāyāṃ,’‘oṃ brāhmyai svāhā’‘ stambhapādaśilāyām,’‘ oṃ vaiṣṇavyai svāhā’‘ stambhe,’‘oṃ kamalāyai svāhā’‘ kapote,’‘oṃ śāntyai svāhā’‘uttare,’‘oṃ padmāyai svāhā’‘ tulāyām,’‘oṃ aiśānyai svāhā’‘ sopānapaṅktiṣu, caturṣumaṇḍapadvāratoraṇeṣu adhaḥ’‘oṃ śāntyai svāhā’‘ dakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ, oṃ vāgdevyai svāhā upari,oṃ śriyai svāhā uttara śākhāyām, oṃ ratyai svāhā’‘iti saṃpātena nyasya| śāntihomāvasānikaṃ sarvaṃ karma pūrvavat nirvartya| tataḥ prabhāte sumuhūrte guruḥ svayaṃ mahākumbhaṃ samādāya pūrvoktāḥ śaktīḥ svasvamantreṇa namontaiḥ āgacchapadasaṃyuktaiḥ maṇḍape pūrvoktasthāneṣu nyasya| vyāpakarūpeṇa vicintya| tatrasthāni citrāṇi citrābhāsāni ca kumbhasthavāriṇā kūrcena svasvamantreṇa yathāpūrvaṃ prokṣayet| tadanu yajamānaśca pūrvavat gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| āsthāna maṇḍapapratiṣṭhā āsthānamaṇḍapādīnāma tu maṇḍapaśodhana paryagnikaraṇa pañcagavya prokṣaṇa vāstuhoma puṇyāhavācana balikumbhasthāpanādikaṃ kṛtvā| ekasmin kuṇḍe āhutīśca hutvā| ācāryaḥ sumuhūrte mahākumbha jalena pūrvavat prokṣayet| sarvamapi karma sadyaḥ vā kuryāt| gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| gopurapratiṣṭhā gopurapratiṣṭhāṃ vimānapratiṣṭhāvat kuryāt| prākārapratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu aṅkurārpaṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ vidhāya| guruḥ varmamantreṇa prākāraṃ prokṣayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| dvāraśākhākavāṭapratiṣṭhe tāvat ādau eva ukte| atrāpi tathaiva kuryāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ maṇḍapa āsthāna maṇḍapa gopura prākāra dvāraśākhā kavāṭa pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma .dvāviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

trayoviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | balipīṭhanirmāṇa pratiṣṭhe | atha balipīṭhanirmāṇa vidhiḥ ucyate balipīṭhikāṃ garbhamandirasamāyāma vistārāṃ, tadardhāṃ, turīyāṃśa samāṃ vā, yadvā garbhamandiraṃ pañcadhā vibhajya| tadvyaṃśāṃ ekāṃśāṃ vā athavā navasu ekabhāgasamāṃ yadvā hastavaśena ekahastāvarāṃ, pañcahastaparāṃ vā vistāra dviguṇotsedhāṃ, triguṇotsedhāṃ, ardhārdhikāṃ, vistāratulyotsedhāṃ vā, pañcāṅgakalpanopetām, kapotabhūtamālā haṃsamālādi virājitāṃ nirmāya, tadagravistṛtiṃ tredhā vibhajya, dvābhyāṃ paṃkajaṃ vidhāya| pīṭhikākoṇeṣu garuḍān sihmān vā prāgādiṣu vighnarāḍīśapakṣīśa durgāḥ yathonnati pārśve sopānapaṅktīśca kalpayet| balipīṭhapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate evaṃ pīṭhikāṃ gopurāsthānamaṇḍapayoḥ madhye kalpayitvā| yathāyogaṃ aṣṭasu dikṣu balipīṭhāni tāladvayena vistārāyāmayutāni pratyekaṃ caturaṅgulonnata mekhalātrayayutāni, tanmadhye vṛttākāreṇa caturaśrākāreṇa vā caturaṅgulāyāma vistārakarṇikāyutāni ca kṛtvā| gehasyaparitaḥ pūrvādyāsu saṃsthāpayet | māhāpīṭhasya paścimabhāge dhvajastaṃbhasya pīṭhaṃ ca nirmimīta| prāsādābhimukhaḥ staṃbhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ| yathā pūrvābhimukhe deve pratyaṅmukhaḥ, paścimābhimukhe deve pūrvābhimukhaḥ, sarvaṃ saṃsthāpya| ācāryaḥ vāstuhomāṅkurāvāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ śāntihomāvasānikaṃ mandirasya iva kṛtvā| tataḥ prabhāte sumuhūrte mūlavidyayā mahākumbhajalena pīṭhaṃ kūrcena samprokṣya| tasmin prācyāṃ vighnarājāya namaḥ,dakṣiṇe oṃ īśānāya namaḥ,paścime oṃ pakṣirājāya namaḥ,uttare oṃ durgāyai namaḥ, madhyakarṇikāyāṃ oṃ sarvebhyaḥ viṣṇupārṣadebhyaḥ namaḥ iti prokṣya| aṣṭāsvapi dikṣu kumudādigaṇeśān svaiḥ svaiḥ anucaraiḥ saha, svasvamantreṇa āvāhyasānnidhyaṃ prāthrya| teṣu nityaṃ baliṃ dadyāt| yajamānaḥ yathāśakti brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ vitīrya| ācāryāya śataniṣphāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| atha mahānasa pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ācāryaḥ tatra vāstuhomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā|dhānyarāśau salakṣaṇaṃ kumbhaṃ ekaṃ vinyasya| tasmin mūlena āvāhya, abhyarcya| agniṃ saṃsādhya| samidājya carupāyasaiḥ pratidravyaṃ mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| tatrasthānāṃ devānāṃ caṇḍapracaṇḍa kṣetrapālarudra gaṇeśa jṛṃbhala maṇibhadra śibhikuṇḍala dharma adharma dhātṛvidhātṛ lakṣmyādyānāṃ homapūrvaṃ tatvanyāsādikaṃ karma kṛtvā| cullīṣu ‘‘agnimīle iti mantreṇa agniṃ nidadhīta| tatra pāyasādīnāṃ haviṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ paricārakāḥkuryuḥ|nityahomārthaṃ kuṇḍe agniṃ purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ yathāvidhi sthāpayitvā| tadanu mahākumbhajalena caṇḍādīnāṃ nyasanaṃ kuryāt| mahānasa dvāre oṃ caṇḍāya namaḥ, oṃ pracaṇḍāya namaḥ, dakṣiṇa pārśve oṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ,oṃ īśvarāya namaḥ,uttare oṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ,oṃ jṛṃbhalāya namaḥ,paścime oṃ maṇibhadrāya namaḥ, oṃ śibikuṇḍalāya namaḥ, anyeṣu dvāreṣu satsu, prāsādadvāravat lakṣmyādīnāṃ kalpanaṃ caret| culyāḥ vāme oṃ dharmāya namaḥ,oṃ adharmāya namaḥ,pṛṣṭhataḥoṃ dhātre namaḥ,agreoṃ vidhātre namaḥ, tatraiva cullyābhimukhaṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ, dīrghaculyāstu ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ,dharmā’dharmau kalpayet|sarvān tān abhyarcya| tatra sthāni sakalāni pātrāṇi kumbhajalena śrīsūktena prokṣayet|gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| dhānyāgāra pratiṣṭhā dhānyāgāra dhanāgāra sārasvatagṛha majjanaśālā puṣpavāṭikāsadana tāṃbūlakalpana gṛhataila sthānādīnāṃ dhāmnām śilpibhiḥ kalpitānāṃ ācāryaḥ śāstroktena vidhinā vāstuhomādi prokṣaṇāntaṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍapasya iva kuryāt| dakṣiṇāca yathāvasu deyā| atha vāpīkūpa taṭākapratiṣṭhā teṣāṃ bhāge paścime caturhastāyāmaṃ ekahastocchritāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā| suvarṇena alpakāyaṃ jalādhidaivataṃ nirmāya| suvarṇādilohajān mṛṇmayān vā kalaśān saratna lohakūrcāpidhānān nava dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya|yathāvidhi āvāhya abhyarcya| taiḥ jalādhidaivataṃ vidhivat snāpayitvā| tadanu vedikāyāṃ salakṣaṇāyāṃ śāyayitvā| tatra mahākumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya| tasmin jalādhidaivataṃ āvāhya abhyarcya| caturṣu kuṇḍeṣu ekasmin vā agniṃ upasamidhya|tatra taṃ āvāhya| taddaivatyaiḥ mantraiḥ samidājya carubhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| bhūsuraiḥ vāruṇasūktāni pāṭhayitvā| tataḥ prabhāte sulagne puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| vāpyādīn prokṣya| ācāryaḥ amṛtavāribhiḥ pūritān vicintya| tataḥ suvarṇādi lohakṛtāni matsyakūrmādīni jalādhidevatāpratimāṃ mahākumbhaṃ ca vāpyādiṣu nikṣipya|tatra gaṅgādisarvasaritaḥ svasvamantraireva āvāhayet| yajamānaḥ gurave yathāvasu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā| tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaḥ api yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃbalipīṭhanirmāṇa tatpratiṣṭhā mahānasadhānyāgāravāpīkūpa taṭākapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma trayoviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<24 >
caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | prabhāpratiṣṭhā | atha prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate kālāṃtare cet prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhā, jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ karma yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā| guruḥ jvālāmālāsahasrāḍyāṃ vidyutsaṃghātasannibhāṃ prabhāṃ dhyātvā| saṃspṛśya| agnausamidājyacarubhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| sarpiṣā śānti homaṃ ca hutvā| saṃpātena prabhāṃ saṃspṛśya| prabhāte kumbhavāriṇā mūlenaprokṣya| prabhāṃ sumuhūrte devena saṃyojya| mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| pīṭhasthāpanam|pīṭhasthāpane tu guruḥ tatra pīṭham samsthāpya| yogāsanamantraiḥ ādhārādi padmāntaiḥ agnau hutvā| saṃpātena pīṭhaṃ saṃspṛśya padma pīṭhaṃ sumuhūrte devena yojayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| atha ghaṇṭā pratiṣṭhā ucyate ghaṇṭāṃ pañcagavyena pañcavāruṇikaiḥ mantraiḥ saṃsnāpya| navavāsasā āveṣṭya| śālitaṇḍulatilaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tadūdhrve navavastraṃ sadarbhaṃ vinyasya| tatra ghaṇṭāṃ tanmantreṇa śāyayitvā| navena vāsasā ācchādya| tatrasalakṣanaṃ kumbhaṃ ekaṃ samsthāpya| tasmin’‘śabdabrahmasvarūpiṇyai oṃ ghaṇṭāyai namaḥ’‘ iti āvāhya abhyarcya| kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā tanmantreṇa samidādibhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ, caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśa ca hutvā| tāṃ śabdabrahmamayīṃ dhyātvā| śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā| saṃpātena ghaṇṭāṃ samspṛśya| prabhāte kumbhatoyena prokṣya| tataḥ ghaṇṭāṃ devasya sarvakarmasu cālayet|gurave dakṣiṇā pūrvavat| dhūpa dīpapratiṣṭhā dhūpadīpayostu pūrvavat sarvaṃ karma kṛtvā| ‘‘oṃ dhūpapātrādhidaivatāya pāvakāya namaḥ’‘ iti dhūpaṃ, oṃ dīpapātrādhidaivatāya bhāskarāya namaḥ’‘ iti dīpaṃ ca homānantaraṃ mahākumbha jalenaprokṣayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| bheryādi pratiṣṭhābheryādīnāṃ pañcagavyena śuddhiṃkuryāt| rathādīnāṃ chatrādīnāṃ ca pratiṣṭhā rathādiyānānāṃ tu śuddhiṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā| svasvadevatāmantreṇa mahākuṃbhajalena prokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt| chatrādīnāmapi pūrvavat sarvatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ yathāvidhi sarvaṃ karmakuryāt| yajamānaśca gurave vittānusārataḥ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| akṣamalā pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ atha akṣamālāpratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate suvarṇa rajata tāmra trapu sīsa kāṃsyāyasphaṭika sūryakānta candropala putra jīvendrākṣī vibhītikā niṃba padma sitaaṃbhoja kamalākṣa rudrākṣa śaṅkha jalaja kuśagrantyādiṣu japtuḥ abhimata karmānuguṇān maṇīn aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyākān tadardhān saptaviṃśati saṃkhyākān vā akṣāsthi tulyān dhātrīphalāsthisadṛśān badarāsthi samānān vā saṃpādya tān doṣavarjitān nirīkṣya| pañcavāruṇikaiḥ pañcopaniṣat mantraiśca pañcagavyaiḥ saṃkṣālya| tān hemai rājate vā sūtre triguṇīkṛte keśādi doṣavarjite kārpāsasūtre vā pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhaṃ mukhena mukhaṃ parasparaṃ yathā na saṃbadhyeta| tathā antarāṃtarā suvarṇena vā sūtreṇavā madhyabandhayutān āropya| tāṃ mālāṃ kaṭakākāraṃ kṛtvā| tanmālaumahattaraṃ anyaṃ maṇiṃ nidhāya| evaṃ akṣamālikāṃ kṛtvā| tāṃ puṇyāhajalena prokṣya| padmadalesaṃsthāpya| kuṃkumādyaiḥvilipya| śālitaṇḍulaiḥ, bhārādipramāṇayutaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| tatra cakrapadmaṃ vilikhya| kuśaiḥ navavastraiśca ācchādya| hemavastrayutaṃ mahākumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe nikṣipya| tasmin ‘oṃ namo akṣamālikādhi daivatāya mantrapuruṣāya namaḥ’‘ iti mantreṇa āvāhya abhyarcya kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā agniṃ upasamidhya| samiccarughṛtaiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tasyāḥ śoṣaṇādi kṛtvā| tāṃ aṇḍamayīṃ dhyātvā|tanmadhyepuruṣaṃ dhyāyet baddhāñjalimavasthitam| caturbhujaṃ valarkṣābhaṃ varadābhayahastakam| akṣamālāṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ śikhāgre kaṭakākṛtim| iti dhyātvā|tadanu śāntihomānantaraṃ saṃpātena tāṃ saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte tasyāṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tatvāni vinyasya| ācāryaḥ svahṛdayakamale mantrarūpiṇīṃ abhinnāṃ tejasā ādityasaṃkāśāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃśaktiṃ dhyātvā| tāṃ brahmarandhrāt akṣamālikāyāṃ tanmantreṇa āvāhya| mahākumbha jalena prokṣya| sannidhattāṃ bhavān deva mantramūrte janārdana| japākṣamālāvalaye bhaktānugrahakāmyayā|| iti gāthāṃ udīrya, tatra mantravigrahaṃ akṣamālāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ valakrṣābhaṃ devaṃ dhyātvā| abhyarcya| guruḥ yajamānāya dadyāt| pūrvaṃ guruḥ akṣamālāyāṃ yaṃ mantraṃ sthāpitavān tameva gaṇayet| yathāvittaṃ gurave dakṣiṇā deyā| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ prabhāpīṭha ghaṇṭādhūpadīpabheryādivādya rathādiyāna chatrādiparibarhākṣamālāpratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<25 >
pañcaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | gṛhārcāpratiṣṭhā | atha gṛhārcā pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyatesuvarṇādilohajāṃ,yadvā candanā’garu devadāru bilva sarala tamāla cūta badarī panasa kṣīriṇī saptalājāti spandana timiśa kadaṃba kuravaka tilaka madhūkāsana jaṃbū punnāga kanada khadira niṃba vibhītika śālmalyādi vṛkṣajāṃ yajamānābhīṣṭa karmānurūpāṃ brāhmaṇasya cet hastamānamitāṃ, kṣatriyasyacet ekaviṃśāṅgulamānāṃ vaiśyasya cet ekonaviṃśāṅgulāṃ, śūdrasya saptaviṃśāṅgulāṃ, lohajāṃ cet brāhmaṇasya dvādaśāṅgulamānena, kṣatriyasya navāṅgulamānena, viśaḥ saptāṅgulamānena, śūdrasya pañcāṅgulena kṛtāṃ pratimāṃ ratnajāṃ maṇijāṃ vā śrībhūmibhyāṃ śriyāvā yutāṃ kevalāṃ vā prabhā pīṭhādiyutāṃ salakṣaṇāṃ saṃhāraśayanamātrarahitāṃ yathāvidhi śilpinā kārayitvā| gṛhasya mārutyāṃ diśi sthāpayet| tatpratiṣṭhārthaṃ sarvān saṃbhārānsaṃbhṛtya| yajamānaḥsvayaṃ ācāryavaraṇaṃ kṛtvā | aṃgaṇe nadītīre vā, yadvā supūjite kṣetre prapāṃ samadhyavedikāṃ sacatuṣphuṇḍāṃ saikakuṇḍeṃ vā nirmāya, ācāryeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayet| ācāryaḥ pūrvaṃ aṅkurān arpayitvā| tadanu jalādhivāsa nayanonmīlana pādyādi dravyakalaśasnapana śayanādhivāsa kumbhāvāhanādikaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmiva kṛtvā| kuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ tatvahomādi śāntihomāvasānikaṃ hutvā| pūrvavat saṃpātena saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte pratimāsthāpanasthāne ratnanyāsaṃ kṛtvā| tatra yathāvidhi saṃsthāpya| āvāhanādikaṃ karma kuryāt| jaṅghamasya cet āvāhanādikaṃ abhipreta vedikāyāṃ kṛtvā| tadanu sthāne sthāpayet| dvāre caṇḍa pracaṇḍa kṣetrapāla vighneśa vāstunātha durgā guha viṣvaksena śaṅkha padmanidhīśca āvāhya abhyarcayet|tadanu yajamānaḥ ca ācāryācoditaḥ bhūmau daṇḍavat praṇamya imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| ‘ dāsosmi tava deveśa saputragaṇabāndhavaḥ| sannidhatsva gṛhe yāvat anvavāyo mahācyuta| pūjāṃ mayāṃ yathāśakti vihitāṃ vikalāmapi| gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan bhaktajanānugraha kāmyayā| ‘‘ itthaṃ ācāryasannidhau bhagavantaṃ yācayitvā| gurave mūrtipebhyaśca yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ vitīrya| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| śrīvatsapratiṣṭhāḥ atha śrīvatsapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate śrīvatsaṃ agre śālibhāre saśāṭike niveśya| puṇyāhādipūrvakaṃ sarvaṃ karma kṛtvā|tatvāni vinyasya| kumbhe ca āvāhya abhyarcya| padmakuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| śrīvatsamantreṇa samidājya carubhiḥ pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tatvahomaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca kṛtvā|saṃpātena spṛṣṭvā| kumbhajalena prokṣya| sumuhūrte viṣṇoḥ vakṣasi niveśayet|gurave dakṣiṇāca pūrvavat| kaustubha pratiṣṭhāḥ kaustubhaṃ tu yathāpūrvam svamantreṇa sthaṇḍile sthāpayitvā| suvarṇa pratimāṃ kaustubhākāreṇa kārayitvā| mahākumbhe vinyasya pūrvavat sarvaṃ karma kuryāt| vanamālā pratiṣṭhāḥ vanamālāṃ suvarṇamayīṃ nānāratna pariṣphṛtāṃ pūrvoktavidhānena svamantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya sumuhūrte viṣṇoḥkaṇṭhe laṃbayet| atha kirīṭa pratiṣṭhāḥ śuddhakārtasvaramayaṃ ratnacitaṃ vā kirīṭaṃ bhagavadyogyaṃ kṛtvā| pādyādi ghṛtāntaiḥ saptadaśakalaśaiḥkirīṭamantreṇa saṃsnāpya| savastradhānyakṛta sthaṇḍile nidhāya| kumbhe tanmantreṇa āvāhyaabhyarcya| kuṇḍacatuṣṭaye vā ekasmin kuṇḍe vā samidājyacarubhiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīnāṃ hutvā| śāntihomaṃ hutvā| saṃpātena kirīṭaṃ saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte kumbhajalenasvavidyayā prokṣya| tadanu bhadrāsane samāsīnaṃ devaṃ rājavat upacarya saṃsnāpya| alaṃkṛtya ārādhya| vedaghoṣaiḥ vādyaghoṣaiḥ sarvopacāraiḥ saha ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ sākaṃ pañcopaniṣanmantraiḥ devasya mūrdhani kirīṭaṃ āropya| devaṃ yānaṃ āropya| tūryaghoṣa puṣpavṛṣṭyādyupacārapurassaraṃ grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya mandire viniveśya arcayet| gurave dakṣiṇā deyā| bhūṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāḥ hārādi nūpurāntaṃ bhūṣaṇajālaṃ dvādaśākṣareṇa gandha jalena saṃkṣālya| dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya| agnau svavidyayā hutvā| tattadbhūṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā| dvādaśākṣaramanuṃ japan tattanmantreṇa taistaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣayet| cakrādyāyudha pratiṣṭhāḥ atha cakrādyāyudhānāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate| cakraṃ tu hastamānena yadvā saptadaśāṃgulam| aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ yadvā viṃśatyaṃgulasaṃmitam| caturdaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi ṣoḍaśāṃgulameva vā| dvādaśāṃgulamānaṃ vā svalakṣaṇa pariṣphṛtam| mūlabimbānanasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ samujvalam| yadvā śatāramathavā caturviṃśatyarānvitam| ṣoḍaśāramathāṣṭāram athavā ṣaḍaraṃ varam| sahasrajvālamathavā ṣaḍjvālaṃ nābhimaṇḍitam| trilohanirmitaṃ cakraṃ nālapīṭha samanvitam| kṛtvā karaṇḍamakuṭaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ vā sudarśanam| caturbhujadharaṃ kruddhaṃ bhrukuṭī kuṭilānanam| puruṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ yadvā dakṣiṇenāpi tarjanam| spṛśantaṃ kaṭimanyena ca itarābhyām kṛtāñjalim| mukhyābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ tu susthitaṃ padmaviṣṭare| ‘‘ evaṃ rūpayutaṃ cakraṃ kalpayitvā| pūrvavat aṅkurārpaṇajalādhivāsa nayanonmīlana snapana śayanādhivāsadvāratoraṇakumbhapūjānāṃ anantaraṃ mahākumbhe sudarśanaṃ tanmantreṇa āvāhya| abhyarcya| atyugraṃ puruṣaṃ dhyāyet dvibhujaṃ rakta vāsasam| raktadaṃṣṭrānanam nābhau susthitaṃ cakranāyakam| ‘‘ iti dhyātvā| catuṣphuṇḍeṣu yadvā ekasmin samidājya carubhiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| cakraṃ śoṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃśoṣya| śāntihomāvasāne saṃpātena nābhyādyavayavān saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte svavidyayā prokṣya| sampūjayet| śaṅkhādi pratiṣṭhāḥ śaṅkhādīnāṃ caturṇām yathā pūrvaṃ ācāryaḥ svasvamantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā| yathāvidhi pūjayet| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ ca pūrvavat| caṇḍādidvārapāla pratiṣṭhāḥ caṇḍādidvārapālānāṃ jalādhivāsanayanonmīlana snapana śayanādhivāsa eka kumbhapūjana tatvahomanyāsa śāntihomasparśanādikarma kṛtvā|ācāryaḥ tattanmantreṇa bījayuktena kumbhajalena prokṣayet|gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| garuḍa pratiṣṭhāḥ atha vainateyapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate aṅkurāvāpanādi karmaṃ yathāvidhi pūrvavat kṛtvā| ācāryaḥ pūrvādiṣu caturṣu koṇeṣu krameṇa satya suparṇa garuḍa tārkṣyān āvāhya| teṣu krameṇa bṛhatsāma, suparṇamanu ,rathantara, garuḍagāyatrī mantraiḥ pratyekaṃ pratidravyaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| parastādupariṣṭāśca śiṣṭaṃ karma yathāpūrvaṃ kuryāt| gurave dakṣiṇā ca deyā| ādityapratiṣṭhāḥ ādityapratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu sva gāyartyārādhanam| tathaiva homaḥ| ‘bibhrāḍi’ tyanuvākena sāvi rtyā ca sthāpanaṃ sūryavidyayā kumbhaprokṣaṇaṃ ca kuryāt| brahmādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ ca yathā puram| svatantre paratantre ca svaiḥ mantraiḥ sthāpanaṃ bhavet| durgā ca mātaraḥ sapta yāḥ kaścit devatāḥ striyaḥ| tāsāṃ pratiṣṭhā lakṣmīvat svaiḥ svaiḥ mantraiḥ viśiṣyate| viṣvaksena pratiṣṭhāḥ viṣvaksenasya bhagavatbiṃbasyeva sarvakarmāṇi kṛtvā| svamantreṇa sthāpanaṃ kuryāt| sarvatra dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| bhaktapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ bhaktānāṃ pratikāyaṃ svatantraṃ svāmitantraṃ vā śilādibhiḥ yathālābhaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ saumyaṃ sthitaṃ āsīnaṃ yathāvarṇa rūpaṃ yathāśramadharmaṃ yathāvayorūpadharaṃ padmapīṭhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ karmānurūpyeṇa vā pratiṣṭhitaṃ śilpinā kalpayitvā| śubhedine guruḥ ādau aṅkurān yugmāsveva pālikāsu arpayitvā| vedikādhivāsana kumbhāṣṭakarahitaṃ sarvaṃ anyat karmajālaṃ pūrvavat| dvāratoraṇayajana pūrvakaṃ praṇavena anyaiḥ mantraiśca yathāvidhi kṛtvā| kumbhaprokṣaṇaṃ tanmantreṇaiva kuryāt| teṣāṃ svātantye sihmadiṅmūrti varjitaṃ mandiraṃ kuryāt| dīkṣā guru pratiṣṭhāḥ ācāryaḥ mantrasiddhaye dīkṣāguroḥ pratimāṃ kṛtvā| puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ sarvaṃ karmajālaṃ bhaktānāmiva kṛtvā| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaḥdakṣiṇāṃ ca vitīrya| tatra svādhyāyā’dhyayanādivipraiḥ kārayitvā| svayaṃ ca kuryāt| teṣāṃ svātantye dhvajārohaṇa homabali tīrthayātrārahitamutsavaṃ kuryāt| pāratantye bhagavatā sākaṃ bhagavatprītaye kuryāt| gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ gṛhārcā ,śrīvatsa, kaustubha, vanamālā, kirīṭa, bhūṣaṇa, cakrādyāyudha, caṇḍādidvārapāla, garuḍaḥ āditya bhaktā, dīkṣāgurupratiṣṭhāvidhiḥnāma pañcaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

ṣaḍviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | dīkṣā vidhiḥ | atha tāvat dīkṣāvidhiḥ ucyate| dīkṣāmaṇḍapaṃ pratiṣṭhāmaṇḍapavat samadhyavedikaṃ kalpayitvā| vedikāyāḥ paścime tālatrayāt bahiḥ, brāhmaṇasyacet dīkṣā tāladvaya sammita caturaśraṃkuṇḍaṃ, kṣatriyasya yadi gokarṇayugmena vṛttaṃ, yadivaiśyasya vitastibhyāṃ caturaśrākāraṃ, pādajasya prādeśadvayena trikoṇaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ kalpayitvā | sruksruvau ca evameva varṇānupūrveṇa, evaṃ anyāni pātrāṇi samidādīn yāgasaṃbhārān ca daśaṃyāṃ saṃpādya|tadanu ekādaśyāṃ sāyāhne dīkṣācāryaḥ maṇḍape sarvālaṅkārayute pūrvavat dvāratoraṇa kumbhādīn saṃsthāpya pūrvavat aṅkurāvāpanaṃ kṛtvā|puṇyāhajalena madhyavedikāṃ prokṣya| prāṇāyāmapūrvakaṃ tasyāṃ candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi prāgāyatāni saptadaśa tāvanti udagāyatāni ca nipātya | teṣu ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśatapadeṣu madhye ṣaṭtriṃśat koṣṭāni saṃmṛjya|tanmadhye śaṅakuṃ saṃsthāpya | vṛttāni samāni pañcabiṃbāni yathā syuḥ tathā bhrāmayitvā| teṣu prathamaṃ bimbaṃ karṇikākṣetraṃ| dvitīyaṃ tredhā vibhajya| tathā kṛteṣu prathamaṃ kesarāntavalayaṃ, dvitīyaṃ dalāntavalayaṃ, tṛtīyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalaṃ | tannābhimaṇḍalamapi tredhā vibhajya| tadbahiḥ śiṣṭeṣu biṃbeṣu arakṣetraṃ dvābhyāṃ | tadbahiḥ ekena nemimaṇḍalaṃ ca kalpayitvā | tadbahiḥ aṣṭāviṃśati padaiḥ pīṭhikāṃ, tadbahiḥ paṅktidvayena aśītipadaiḥ vīthikāṃ ca kalpayet| tadbahiḥ paṅktidvitayena dvādaśādhikaśatapadaiḥ dvayoḥ paṅktayoḥ caturaśraṃ kṛtvā| tanmadhye pūrvādi uttarāntaṃ catuścatuṣpadaiḥ caturdvārāṇi āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu api tathaiva ca kṛtvā| dvārapārśvayoḥ bāhyarathyāyāṃ dve dve avāntararathyāyāṃ ekaikaṃ ca parimārjayet| evaṃ cet ardhaśobhāḥ bhavanti| ardhaśobhayoḥ madhye bahiḥ paṅktau ekaikaṃ āntara paṅktau trīṇi ca evaṃ caturbhiḥ padaiḥśobhāḥ bhavanti| evaṃ catasṛṣudikṣu śobhānāṃ aṣṭakaṃ, ardhaśobhānāṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ ca kṛtvā| tataḥ varṇakalāpaparipūraṇaṃ kuryāt| pañcaratnaiḥ dhātubhiḥ vā teṣāṃ cūrṇaiḥ vā pañcavarṇaiḥ puṣpaiḥ vā maṇḍalapadānāṃ paripūraṇaṃkuryāt|sitasya śālyādi taṇḍulapiṣṭaṃ, kṛṣṇasya puṭadagdhaṃ śyāmasya kṣuṇṇaśuṣphapatracūrṇaṃ, raktasyakausumbhaṃ, pītasya haridrācūrṇaṃ, sarvatra varṇānāṃ iti anuṣaṅkāḥ| pītenakarṇikāṃ, śuklaiḥ bindūn | karṇikārekhāḥ pāṭalaiḥ kesarāvaliṃ dvidhākṛtvā | śvetena pūrvabhāgaṃ, uttaraṃ pītena, kesarāṇi śuklena, bindūn raktena, aṣṭadalāni śvetena| dalāntāniraktaiḥ dalāntavalayaṃ raktenaśvetena vā nābhimaṇḍalatrayaṃ śyāmena, pītena, raktena, arānta valayaṃ kṛṣṇena, dvādaśārāṇi raktena, nemyantamedinīṃ sitena, nemiṃ dvedhā kṛtvā| kṛṣṇenapūrvabhāgaṃ, uttaraṃsitena, antarālāni śyāmena|kṛṣṇena pūrvabhāgaṃ, uttaraṃ sitena, antarālāni śyāmena kṛṣṇena vā tadbahiḥ pīṭhaṃ pītena pāṭalena śvetena vā, tadbahiḥ vīthikāṃ sitena latāvitānayutāṃ, śobhāṣṭakaṃ raktena, ardhaśobhāḥ ṣoḍaśa pītena, uttarādi dvāra catuṣṭayaṃ krameṇa śukla rakta pīta kṛṣṇaiḥ, koṇān kṛṣṇena ca varṇena, sarvatra antarālāni kṛṣṇena śyāmena vā varṇena āpūrya| caturṣukoṇeṣu śvetena śaṅkān kṛtvā|tataḥ maṇḍalārādhanaṃ kuryāt| karṇikāyāṃ mantrādhvānaṃ arcayet|tatsavarūpaṃ tu dvādaśākṣara aṣṭākṣara balamantra, viṣṇugāyatrī, sudarśanamantra, pavitrantra, caturmūrtimantra, nṛsiṃhamantra, rāmamantra, kṛṣṇamantra, varāhamantrān uccārya arcayet| kesareṣu tatvādhvā arcanamjīvaprāṇamanobuddhyahaṅkāra śabdasparśa rūpa rasa gandha śrotra tvakcakṣu jihvā ghrāṇa vākpāṇipādapāyūpastha pṛthivyaptejo vāyvākāśarūpāṇi jīvatatvāni dhātṛ vidhātṛ mitrāvaruṇa bhaga vivasvatpūṣa savitṛ ravi tvaṣṭṛ viṣṇu vīrabhadra , śaṃbhu girīśaśarvomāpatīśāna harasthāṇu bhava śiva śūlyādi rūpatatvāni ca praṇavādi caturthyantāni arcayet| daleṣvarṇādhvā’rcanam oṃ kaṃ namaḥ parāya ityārabhya kṣaṃ namaṃ parāya ityantena nābhibhāge padādhvā’rcanam| tatra keśavādīn saptaṛṣīn ca, prācyādiṣu ādivarāha nārasiṃha śrīdhara hayavaktra bhārgavarāma rāghava vāmanavāsudevān ca, kumudādisupratiṣṭhāntāṃśca, jayavijaya caṇḍapracaṇḍa bhadra subhadra dhātṛ vidhātṛ sūryacandra kāma brahma vināyaka ṣaṇmukha durgā kubera śaṃkarān, ca,vimalotkarṣaṇī, jñāna, kriyā, yogi prahvī, satyā, īśānā anugrahaśaktīśca, ādityādiketvantān ca, lakṣmī sarasvatī rati śānti tuṣṭi puṣṭi kriyā kīrti vārāhīśca, praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ arcayet| areṣu kalādhvāpūjanaṃ tatra akārādi svarārcanaṃ kuryāt| nemibhāge bhuvanādhvā’rcanaṃ; tatprakārastu atala vitala,sutala, nitala mahātala, rasātala, talātala, pātāla, bhūrbhuvassuvarmaharjanastapassatyaloka gandharvaloka, yakṣaloka, apsaraloka, kinnaraloka, yamaloka, niṛtiloka varuṇaloka, rudraloka, devaloka, brahmaloka, śivaloka, viṣṇuloka, sadāviṣṇuloka, kumbhīpāka, mahāraurava, kṣurāla, sannimāla, śītala uṣṇajala santapana taptaloha śālmalīrūpadhīyantradhanurbhinna, śuddhanirayān, praṇavādi caturthyantaṃ arcayet| binduṣu dvādaśākṣarāṇi karṇikāyāṃ paramātmānaṃ kesareṣu śrī sarasvati rati śānti prīti kīrti puṣṭi tuṣṭīḥ dalabhūmiṣu śrīvatsādi dvādaśaśaktīḥ dalasya paritaḥ vyāptyādyāḥ, prathamanābhau viṣṇuṃ, dvitīye brahmāṇaṃ, tṛtīyerudraṃ, dvādaśāreṣuviṣṇvādīn dvādaśa arāntavalaye matsyādi daśamūrtīḥ, prathama nemivalaye śaṃkhādīn, āgneyādi pīṭhakoṇacatuṣphe ananta,varāha nārasiṃha hayagrīvān latāvīthikāyāṃ indrādilokapālān, dvāracatuṣphe caṇḍādidvandvaṃ,vīthyāṃ īśāne viṣvaksenaṃ, pūrvadvārabāhye vainateyaṃ, dakṣiṇe padmaṃ, paścime gadāṃ, uttare śaṃkhaṃ ca praṇavādiṃ caturthyantaiḥ svasva mantraiḥ arcayet| tadanu hemādimayaṃ kumbhaṃ tādṛśaṃ karakaṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ cet sūtraveṣṭitaṃ tadyugalaṃ gālitodakena āpūrya| nyastaratnasuvarṇa sravacandana pariṣphṛtaṃ ahatavāsa yugmasaṃveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā| karakaṃ astramantreṇa śatavāraṃ abhimantya| avicchinnadhārayā vedikāṃ paritaḥ prādakṣiṇyena karakaṃ tasyāḥ pṛṣṭataḥ kumbhaṃ ca nītvā| cakrapadmasya īśāna koṇe dhānyarāśau dakṣiṇe kalaśaṃ vāme karakaṃ ca samsthāpya| kumbhe mūlamantreṇa hariṃ pīṭhakalpanapūrvakaṃ āvāhya abhyarcya| maṇḍale sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ paramātmānaṃ yathāvidhi samabhyarcya| tadanu aṣṭākṣareṇa agniṃ mathitvā| kuṇḍamadhye nidhāya | tatra śrṛtaṃ caruṃ caturdhā vibhajya| bhāgamekaṃ maṇḍalasthāya haraye,kumbhasthāyā aṃśaṃekaṃ ca nivedya|agnau ekaṃaṃśaṃ hutvā| guruḥ svayaṃ ekaṃ aṃśaṃ upayuñjīta|tatra agnau samidhāṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ ājyāhutīnāṃ api tathā mūlamantreṇa caruṃ puruṣa sūktena hutvā| pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryāt| tadanu ācāryaḥ snātaṃ jitakrodhaṃ madādirahitaṃ śuciṃ ahatakṣaumavasanaṃ sottarīyaṃ alaṃkṛtaṃ śiṣyaṃ āhūya navena vāsasā netre svamantreṇa baddhvā taṃ ātmanaḥ dakṣiṇapārśve prāṅmukhaṃ viniveśya| tena darbhaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭaḥ san dvādaśākṣareṇa ājya, caru, samitpuṣpatilaiḥ, dvādaśāhutīḥ juhuyāt| tataḥ guruḥ śiṣyasya mūrdhānaṃ prasṛtimudrayā triḥ prādakṣiṇyena aṣṭākṣarena spṛśan bhasmanā pāṇḍareṇa mūlamanunā śiraḥ spṛṣṭvā,śiṣyasya ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ vidhāya| astramantreṇa pratisaraṃ baddhvā | śiṣyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ ca praṇavena prāśayitvā| dantān dhāvayitvā | dantakāṣṭhaṃ bhūmau nipātya avalokayet| naiṛta vāruṇayāmyeṣu yadyagraṃ aśubhaṃ bhavati| tadā nṛsiṃhamantreṇa tilaiḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ juhuyāt| tataḥguruḥśiṣyaṃ ācāntaṃ kare gṛhītvā deveśaṃ praṇamya| saṃsāra pāśa baddhānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamokṣaṇe| tvameva śaraṇaṃ deva gatiranyā na vidyate| pāśamokṣaṇaheturyaḥ tvatsamārādhanātmakaḥ| tenemān janmapāśena pāśitān paśu janmanaḥ| vipāśayāmi deveśa tadanujñātumarhasi| iti imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrya śukla,kṛṣṇaraktavarṇaṃ tantuṃ triguṇīkṛtya punaśca triguṇīkṛtena tena māyāsūtreṇa śiṣyasya śikhāṃ upakramya| pādāntaṃ pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyayā mūlamantreṇa veṣṭayitvā| tenaiva mantreṇa sarpiṣā aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīśca hutvā |māṣodanena bhūtebhyaḥ baliṃ datvā|śiṣya netrabandhaṃ dehabandhaṃ ca vimocya | māyāsūtraṃ anyasminśarāve nidhāya anyena pidhāya | kumbhapārśve nidhāya|darbhān bhūmau saṃstīrya | tatraśiṣyaṃ śāyayet | tadā maṇḍala kuṇḍāgnistha devān na udvāsayet| prabhāte śiṣyasya susvapnadarśane sadya eva dīkṣeta | dusvapnadarśane tu sadyaḥguruḥ snātvā yāgamaṇḍapaṃ samāsādya | dusvapna doṣaśāntyarthaṃ śānti homaṃkariṣye iti saṃkalpya pūrvavat śāntihomaṃkṛtvā | pūrvavat toraṇa, dhvaja kumbhapūjanaṃ kṛtvā | manḍalasthaṃ kumbhasthaṃ ca devaṃ abhyarcya | caturvidhaṃ annaṃ nivedya | natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya| śiṣyasya netre pūrvavat baddhvā | taṃ ātmanaḥ dakṣiṇe pārśvaṃ prāpayya samidādibhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tataḥ māyāsūtraṃ pañcaviṃśatidhā chitvā | tena pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ aṣṭakṛtvā | prakṛtyādīni hutvā | guruḥ svahṛtpadme paramapuruṣaṃ dhyāyan | tasmin śiṣyajīvaṃ saṃhārakrameṇasaṃhṛtya | tasya śoṣaṇādi kṛtvā | tadanu tatva sṛṣṭihomapūrvakaṃ śiṣyasya sthūlaśarīraṃsṛṣṭvā | svahṛdayasthaṃ maṇḍale vicintya | maṇḍalasthaṃ śiṣye dhyātvā | śiṣyaṃ sajīvaṃ dhyātvā | mūlamantreṇa kumbhajalena prokṣya | śiṣyasya netrabandhaṃ unmucya| mūlamantreṇa anyat vāsaḥ paridhāpya | tasya pādaprakṣālanaṃ ācamanāntaṃ kārayitvā | anyena vāsasā śiṣyasya netre baddhvā | guruḥ taṃ antike prāṅmukhaṃ upaveśya | ṣaḍadhvanaḥ śodhayitvā | mahāvyāhṛtimantreṇa ājyena aṣṭottaraśatamāhutīnāṃ hutvā| hutaśeṣeṇa śiṣyasya pādau tilaiḥ tāvatīḥ tanmantreṇa hutvā | hutaśeṣeṇa śiṣyasyanābhiṃ, kuśeśayaiḥ tāvatīḥ pūrvokta vidyayā hutvā namaste sarvalokeśa bhagavan maṃtra vigraha| ārādhayāmi tvāṃ bimbe tāvannivasa me hṛdi| ityuktvā | tato bāhyapūjāṃ vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā kuryāt| atha maṃtra śuddhiḥ oṃ yaṃ vāyave namaḥ maṃtrabījāni śoṣayāmi| oṃ raṃ agnaye namaḥ maṃtrabījāni dahāmi| oṃ laṃ pṛthvyai namaḥ| amṛtadhārayā plāvayāmi| oṃ haṃ maṃtrabījāni śodhayāmi| iti śodhanaṃ kṛtvā| śuddhamaṃtraṃ akṣamālayā aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā aṣṭāviṃśatirvā,bījādyanta saṃpuṭitaṃ japet| dvayaṃ maṃtra śuddhiḥ| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ bhūtaśuddhi maṃtranyāsāntaryāga, mānasāgnikārya,mantraśuddhividhiḥnāma saptaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
