aṣṭāviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | atha sarvāṇidravyāṇi prakṣālya | dakṣiṇe ca galaṃtikāṃ prakṣālya| aṃbupūritāṃ kṛtvā | vāme ca pārśve vinyasya| oṃ vardhanyādyarcanapātrādhidaivatāya oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | viṣṇugāyatryā’rghyadipātrāṇi prakṣālya| devasyātmano vā’gre tripādukāṃ vinyasya | tasyāṃ oṃ raṃ tripādukādhidaivatāya oṃ tretāgnaye namaḥ| ityāvāhyā’bhyarcya| tadupari pātrādhārasthālikāṃ vinyasya| tasyāṃ oṃ laṃ pṛthvyai namaḥ ityāvāhyābhyarcya | tadupari madhya dakṣiṇa vāmeṣu pādyārghyacamanīya pātrāṇi nidhāya | gālitodakairāpūrya| praṇavena spṛṣṭvā|kuśāgrākṣata puṣpa phalacandana tilasiddhārtha yavānarghya pātre| tila dūrvāviṣṇuparṇī śyāmāka padmākṣatāṇipādya pātre | elālavaṃga karpūra jātītakkola caṃdanānyācamanīyapātre ca nikṣipya| dakṣiṇahaste oṃ raṃ dvādaśārāya cakrāya namaḥ tanmadhye oṃ haṃ sūryāya namaḥ iti dhyātvā| dīptaistadraśmibhiḥ dravyāṇidagdāni dhyātvā | vāmahaste ṣoḍaśadalayutāya vikasvarāya śvetapadmāya namaḥ, tanmadhye oṃ vaṃ ṣoḍaśakalāyutāya’mṛtamayāya caṃdramase namaḥ iti dhyātvā| tasmādutthaiḥ amṛtāṃbubhirdravyāṇi siktāni dhyātvā | tāni yāgayogyāni viciṃtya | hastayorubhayoḥ oṃ namonārāyaṇāyeti devaṃ dhyātvā | tābhyāṃ dravyāṇi saṃspṛśya | viṣṇugāyatryā’bhimaṃtrya | oṃ surabhimudrāyai namaḥ iti surabhi mudrāṃ pradarśya|tadutthenāmṛtāni ca pūritānipātrāṇi viciṃtya| oṃ arghyaṃ kalpayāmi, oṃ pādyaṃ kalpayāmi, oṃ ācamanaṃ kalpayāmi ityuccharan tāni spṛṣṭvā | arghyāpātrāt kiñcijjalaṃ anyasmin pātre gṛhītvā | ādhāra stalikopari vinyasya | arghyāpātre om viṣṇave namaḥ, pādya pātre om madhusūdanāya namaḥ, ācamanīya pātre om trivikramāya namaḥ ityāvāhya abhyarcya | pātrāntarastamarghyajalam vāma haste saṃsthāpya | mūlamaṃtreṇa saptavāraṃ abhimantriya | tajjalena oṃ sahasrārahumphaṭ; iti dravyāṇyātmānañca prokṣya| devasya yogapīṭhaṃ kalpayet om pṛṃ ḍhṛṃ ādhāra śaktyai namaḥ om hrūṃ kāla pāvaka kūrmāyanamaḥ om hāṃ sahasra phaṇādhṛta caturaśrabhūmaṇḍalāyaanantāya namaḥ om bhūm bhūmyai namaḥ . tadupari āgneyādi koṇeṣu | om dharmāya namaḥ , om jñānāya namaḥ ,om vairāgyāya namaḥ , om aiśvaryāya namaḥ , etān yogāsanāṅghrirūpān puruṣākṛtīṃ caturbhujān siṃhavaktrān sthitān dhyāyāmi | om adharmāya namaḥ, om ajñānāya namaḥ, om avairāgyāya namaḥ, om anaiśvaryāya namaḥ, madhye om sadāśivāya namaḥ | etān aruṇavarṇān pūrvasadṛśān dhyāyāmi | yogāsanāṅghri antarāntara prāgādiṣu,om ṛgvedāya namaḥ, om yajurvedāya namaḥ, om sāmavedāya namaḥ, om atharvavedāya namaḥ, om kṛtayugāya namaḥ , oṃ tretāyugāya namaḥ , om dvāparayugāya namaḥ, om kaliyugāya namaḥ etānīṣārūpena dhyāyāmi| om vaikārika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, om taijasika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, om bhautika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, etān pāśarūpeṇayutān dhyāyāmi | om satvaguṇāya namaḥ, om rajoguṇāya namaḥ, om tamo guṇāya namaḥ, etān guṇarūpena dhyāyāmi | om ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ tūlikārūpebhyo pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmane namaḥ | om maṃ āstaraṇa rūpāya jīvātmane namaḥ |tadupari om raṃ agnimaṇḍalāya namaḥ | om vaṃ somamaṇḍalāya namaḥ | om haṃ sūrya maṇḍalāya namaḥ |upari om śvetāya dvādaśadalayutāya vipulakarṇikākesarayutāya guṇatrayātmakāya avyaktapadmāya namaḥ om bhadrāsanāyanamaḥ ityāsanāntasthadevatāśca āvāhya gandhādi caturbhirabhyarcya pīṭhasya dakṣiṇepārśve om brahmaṇe namaḥ, oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ, om īśvarāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | uttare oṃ sanatkumārāya namaḥ, oṃ sanakāya namaḥ, oṃ sanantāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| paścime oṃ durgāyai namaḥ, om vighneśāya namaḥ, om nāradāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| agre om asmadga urubhyo namaḥ ,oṃ asmatparama gurubhyo namaḥ om asmatsarva gurubhyo namaḥ | iti dhyātvā | tadanvāvāhanaṃ kuryāt | ekabheravidhāne tu nāvāhayet| surasiddhāvatārite harau ca tatra tu hṛdayasthaṃ biṃbe dhyātvā| ābhimukhyakaraṇamevāvāhanam | na parivāra kalpanaṃ ca| anyatra pratimādau cet|āvāhanapātramadbhiḥ prakṣālya | mūlamantreṇā’dbhirāpūrya | hastābhyāmālalāṭamuddhṛtya| tasmin oṃ namonārāyaṇāya āgacchāgacchā iti vā oṃ namobhagavate vāsudevāyāgacchāgacchā iti vā biṃbānuguṇaṃ caturvāraṃ japtvā hṛdayasthamāvāhya | kūrcena tattoyaṃ pratimāmūrdhni secayitvā | pātrasthaṃ pratimāyāṃ viciṃtya | āvāhanamudrāṃ pradarśya | kiṃcidutthāya praṇamya| svāgatamuktvā | tanmudrāṃ pradarśya | pratimāmudrāṃ ca pradarśya | sannidhiṃ kalpayitvā | mudrāṃ pradarśya | tatra hareḥ sthitiṃ yāgāvasānikaṃ prārthya | prārthanāmudrāṃ ca pradarśya | oṃ namobhagavatevāsudevāya sanmukhobhava iti sāmmukhya mudrāṃ pradarśayet | ekabera viṣaye mūlāt yathāvidyukta vartmanā’‘vāhya | āvāhana sthāpana sannidāna sannirodha sāmmukhya prārthanāmudrāḥ pradarśya | mūlena saparyāsanaṃ datvā | hastanyāsaṃ vinā devadehe maṃtranyāsaṃ kṛtvā | kirīṭa śrīvatsa kaustubha vanamālā cakra śaṃkha gadāpadma garuḍa mudrāśca pradarśya | vibho sakala lokeśa viṣṇojiṣṇo prabho hare | tvām bhaktyā pūjayāṃyadya bhogairarghyadibhiḥkramāt | divyenā’rghyopacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi | arcayiṣyāmi samaye bhagavantam janārdanam| iti deveśaṃ vijñāpya| om tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargodevasya dhīmahi dhīyo yonaḥ pracodayāt arghyaṃ samarpayāmi | iti devasya mūrdhni arghyaṃ samarpya | om trīṇipadā vicakrameviṣṇurgopā’thābhyaḥ tatodharmāni dhārayan pādayoḥ pādyaṃ samarpayāmi | iti dvivāraṃ | om āpaḥ punantu pṛthvīṃ pṛthvī pūtā punātumā punantu brahmaṇaspatiḥ | brahma pūtā punātumām | iti mukhecācamanam samarpya | madhukṣīraṃ ca dadhyājyam madhuparkamiti smṛtam | ekāṅgaṃ vā samastam vā madhuparkam na lopayet | ityuktavat om namobhagavatevāsudevāya madhuparkam nivedya | hastābhyāṃ śirasāpadbhyāṃ manasā ca dhiyā tathā | ahaṃkārenacātmānaṃ nipātya dharaṇī tale| ityaṣṭāṅga praṇipātena devaṃ praṇipatya| dāsoham te jagannātha saputrādi parigrahaḥ preṣyam prasādikartavye mām niyuṅkṣva hi te sadā| iti deveśaṃ vijñāpya parivāra kalpanaṃ kuryāt yogāsanābjapatreṣu, pūrvādiṣu, dvādaśasu | om śrīvatsāya namaḥ, om vanamālāyai namaḥ, om yogamāyāyai namaḥ, oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, om vimalāyai namaḥ | om sṛṣṭyai namaḥ, om utkarṣiṇyai namaḥ, om prajñāyai namaḥ, om satyāyai namaḥ, om aiśānyai namaḥ, om anukampāyai namaḥ, om pitāmahyai namaḥ pīṭhasya paritaḥ prathamāvaraṇe prāgādiṣu om vyāptyai namaḥ, om kāṃtyai namaḥ, om tṛptyai namaḥ, om śraddhāyai namaḥ, om vidyāyai namaḥ, om jayāyai namaḥ, om kṣamāyai namaḥ, om śāṃtyai namaḥ iti cāmaradhāriṇīśca, dvitīyāvaraṇe om śaṃkhiṇe namaḥ, om cakriṇe namaḥ, om gadine namaḥ, om khaḍgiṇe namaḥ, om padmine namaḥ, om musaline namaḥ, om śārṅgaṇe namaḥ , om vanamāline namaḥ iti ca . tritīyāvaraṇe oṃ iṃdrāya namaḥ, om agnaye namaḥ, om yamāya namaḥ, om naiṛtaye namaḥ, oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ , om vāyave namaḥ, om somāya namaḥ, om īśānāya namaḥ | tritīyāvaraṇādbahiḥ bhagavatpratimukhaṃ vainateyaṃ ca | aiśānyām om viṣvaksenāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| snānāsanaṃ kalpayāmi om pādukādhi daivatāya om am anantāya namaḥ | iti pādukāmabhyarcya idaṃ viṣṇuḥ, trīṇipadā iti devasya pādukārohaṇaṃ smṛtvā | abhiṣecanam | ‘uttiṣṭha’ iti devam utthitamsmṛtvā | bhadram karṇebhiḥ iti snānāsana vedikāyām niviṣṭam vicintya tadanu asya devadevasya nityasnapanaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpya|tadaṅgaṃ śuddhi puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā| kumbhān snapanadravyāṇi ca prokṣya| suvarṇādi lohajān mṛṇmayān vā sūtraveṣṭitān nava kumbhān prakṣālya | ardhamaṇḍapa madhye dhānya rāśau prāgudak sūtrāṇiṣaṇṇipātya | teṣu brahmādīśānāṃtaṃ kalaśān saṃsthāpya tān ghṛta pādya dadhyarghyakṣīrācamana madhu paṃcagavya phalairāpūrya|tān savastra ratna kūrcāśvattha pallavāpidhānān kṛtvā|teṣu ghṛtādi phalāvasāneṣukrameṇa paravāsudeva viṣṇu śrīdhara madhusūdana hṛṣīkeśa trivikrama padmanābha vāmana dāmodarānāvāhya, abhyarcya| darbhairācchādya| cakramudrāṃ pradarśya | snānāsanastha devaṃ pūrvavadarghyadibhirabhyarcya |om tadviṣṇoḥ iti dantadhāvanam, viṣṇu gāyatryā jihvā nirlekhanam, oṃ viṣṇornukam iti āmalakaṃ ca datvā, ‘na te viṣṇo, ‘āpohiṣṭhā’ iti abhiṣecanam , om atodevā avantviti kanaka kaṅkatena keśa śodhanam kṛtvā|tadanu sthāpita kalaśai pādyādi ghṛtāṃtaiḥ snāpayet| viṣṇu gāyatryā pādyena, dadhikrāviṇṇa iti dadhnā, payovrata sāmnā payasā,na te viṣṇu iti ācamanena, madhuvāteti madhunā, viṣṇoḥkarmāṇīti paṃcagavyena, yāḥphalinīriti phalavāriṇā,ghṛtasnāteti ghṛtena ca pratidravya ghaṭamupasnāna plotavastrottarīya arghyāpādyācamanagaṃdha puṣpadhūpa dīpadānapurassaramabhiṣicya|om hiraṇya varṇām hariṇīmiti haridrayālipya| om hiraṇya varṇāḥśucayaḥ iti catasṛbhiḥ ṛgbhiḥ saṃkṣālya| gaṃdhadvāretigaṃdhāṃbunā ca viṣṇu gāyatryā kuṅkumenā’‘lipya| pāvamānībhiḥ, brahmajijñānaṃ, kayānaścitra, ityabhiṣicya | om tatsaviturvareṇyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhīyoyonaḥ pracodayāt | iti devam pariṣicya oṃ sahasra dhārādhi daivatāya oṃ pūrṇacandrāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | nṛsūktena sahasradhārayā kuṃbhenābhiṣicya|oṃ śaṃkhādhi daivatāya oṃ jaleśāya namaḥ oṃ padma dhārādhi daivatāya oṃ puṣṭyai namaḥ ityabhyarcya| abhiṣicya| agnirmūrdhā iti plota vastreṇa aṅgāṃbu nirhṛtaṃ kṛtvā | viṣṇugāyatryā vastraṃ om iti yajñopavītam ,uttarīyaṃ ca samarpya . arghyā pādyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| alaṃkārāsanārthaṃ pūrvavat pāduke datvā| alaṃkārāsanaṃ alaṃkārāsanaṃ viciṃtya||pūrvavadarghyadibhirabhyarcya| oṃ mūrdhānam divaṃ iti ārdrān keśān agarudhūpena saṃśoṣya| candanena ca gaṃdhadvāreti maṃtreṇa gaṃdhenā’nulipya|om tadviṣṇoḥ iti mantreṇa divya parimala puṣpāṇi samarpayāmi | jitanta iti mantreṇa sarvābharaṇān samarpayāmi | viṣṇu gāyatryā añjanam samarpya | darpaṇādhi daivatāyai oṃ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ ityāvāhya vyāhṛtyā darpaṇaṃ samarpya | oṃ dhūpapātrādhidaivatāya oṃ pāvakāya namaḥ| ityabhyarcya| dhūpamudrāṃ pradarśya| jitanta iti devasya nāsikāyāṃ dhūpaṃ ca, dīpādhi daivatāya bhāskarāya namaḥ dīpamudrāṃ pradarśya| devasya netrayoḥ om uddīpyasva iti dīpaṃ ca pradarśya| tilaṃ vastram tathā hemam tāṃbūlam taṇḍulaṃ tathā | phalāni gavyamāghāram gāśca dhānyam yathā vasu | gogrāsam deśikāyaiva dadyāddevasyasannidhau | itivat mātrādānam kṛtvā | tiraskariṇīmapohya | vādyānyāghoṣya | vedapāṭhān stotrapāṭhāṃśca pāṭhayitvā | devasya nīrājanam | oṃ nīrājanādhi daivatāya om svadhāyainamaḥ | ityabhyarcya datvā | bhojyāsanam devasya bhojyāsanāya pūrvavat pāduke datvā| bhojyāsanasthaṃ vicintya| pūrvavadarghyadibhiḥ abhyarcya|madhuparkaṃ nivedya| praṇavena tāṃbūlaṃ ca datvā| havirnivedayetsiddhaṃ bhojya bhakṣyādi saṃyutam| madhurādi rasopetaṃ vidhyuktaṃ susamāhitam| asaṃskṛtaiśca niṣpannaṃ yuktamanyaiḥ phalādibhiḥ| apakvairatipakvaiśca yathāyogaṃ prakalpayet| iti naivedyadravyāṇyastramaṃtreṇa prokṣya| sarvamaṃtreṇa pariṣicya| śītalodaka sampūrṇam elā karpūra samyutam | maṃdoṣṇam vāsanāyuktam arhaṇāṃbu iti smṛtam | ityuktavat om iti arhaṇaṃdatvā | naivedyasya dāhanāpyāyane kṛtvā | surabhi mudrāṃ pradarśya | arghyāt puṣpamādāya | viṣṇuhaste samarpya | dakṣiṇajānuṃ bhūmispṛṣṭaṃ kṛtvā | vāmajānumunnamya | anvārabdhassavyena dakṣiṇa kareṇa darśita grāsamudrayā ‘‘devasyatve”ti maṃtreṇa yathoditaṃ naivedyaṃ devasya dakṣiṇahaste nirvapet| tataḥ pānakaṃ pānīyaṃ ca nivedya,ācamanam datvā | tāṃbūlaṃ ca nivedayet | karmārcāyāṃ ca dhruvabherādau yadyudīritaṃ tatsarvamācaret | bahubhere tu śrī bhūmyośca | śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ iti śriyaṃ, bhūṃ bhūmyai namaḥ iti bhuvaṃ ca āvāhya| padmāsanaṃ datvā | svasvamantreṇa ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā | kamala mudrāṃ pradarśya | anyat sarvaṃ arghyādi naivedyāntaṃ svasva mantreṇa samarpayet | tadanu devaṃ stutvā | dvādaśākṣaraṃ anyaṃ vā mantraṃ yathodīritasaṃkhyayā japtvā | tadanu vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā agnaudevaṃ saṃpūjya | bhūtebhyaḥ balidānaṃ nityotsavaṃ ca kṛtvā | deveśaṃ vijñāpya praṇamya ca | pūjakaḥ svayamādadītāvaśiṣṭāni pūjāvastūni ādāya| devaprītyarthaṃ taiḥ ātmapūjanaṃ kuryāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ aṣṭāviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

ekonatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | agnikāryavidhiḥ | atha agnikārya vidhiḥ ucyate | ācāryaḥ agnayāgāradvāre oṃ śroṃ caṇḍāya namaḥ priṃ pracaṇḍāya namaḥ| | madhye oṃ kṣaṃ garuḍāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | antaḥpraviśya| agni kuṇḍasya paścime bhāge prāṅmukhamāsane upaviśya | oṃ asurānta cakrāyasvāhā astrāya phaṭ ; iti kuṇḍasya saṃmārjanālepane kṛtvā| prācyāṃ śirassamākhyātaṃ bāhu yugmaṃ vyavasthitam| pūrvavat kṛtvā | tena saha pañcāvaraṇake dhāmni pañcasu āvaraṇeṣu baliṃ datvā | geyavādya purassaraṃ paryaṭanaṃ utkṛṣṭotsavaḥ | ekakālahīnaḥ madhyamaḥ | kāladvayahīnaḥ adhamaḥ | kālatrayahīnaḥ kṣudraḥ| vinā balipradānena na utsavaḥ abhyudayāvahaḥ| mahāvātādisaṃkṣobhe na nityotsavaṃ ācaret| caṇḍapracaṇḍayoreva vā kevalaṃ baliṃ datvā | tatraiva ‘‘sarvebhyaḥ śrīviṣṇu pārṣadebhyo namaḥ iti baliṃ kṣipet | śuklāṃbaradharaṃ śuciṃ sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutaṃ garuḍātmanābhāvitaṃ paricārakaṃ āhūya | pūrvoktavidhinā vāhitaṃ pātraṃ stuti dhvaja cāmara cakravāhana saṃyutaṃ tanmūrdhni nikṣipya | sarvavādya gīta nṛttapurassaraṃ, caṇḍādīnāṃ gītatāla nṛttapurassaraṃ baliṃ yathāvidhi dadyāt | ‘oṃ croṃ caṇḍāya namaḥbaliṃ dadāmi,’oṃ pṛṃ pracaṇḍāya namaḥbaliṃ dadāmi| prathamāvaraṇe caṇḍapracaṇḍau ārabhya pañcamāvaraṇaparyantaṃ sthitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dvārapālānāṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpa balipradānānantaraṃ mallatāla ṛṣabhasvara vaijayantī nṛtāni darśayet | gopurottarasāle oṃ sūryāya candramase ca baliṃ datvā | daivata svaraṃ, bhadratālaṃ, sarvamaṅgala nṛttaṃ, sālāśritānāṃ sarveṣāṃ balipradānānantaraṃ, prathamāvaraṇadevatāsu kāmāya, sarvamaṅgalanṛttaṃ, dhaivata svaraṃ bhadratālaṃ, yāmyāyāṃ ‘oṃ brahmaṇe sadevīvāhanaparivārāya namaḥ baliṃ dadāmi, iti datvā | brahmatālaṃ madhyamasvaraṃ, megharañjanī rāgaṃ, sarvamaṅgala nṛttaṃ, naiṛte ‘oṃ gajānanāya,bhadratālaṃ pañcamasvaraṃ, varāṭi rāgaṃ hastinṛttaṃ, vāruṇyāṃ oṃ ṣaṇmukhāya bhadratālaṃ dhaivata svaraṃ, sarvamaṅgala nṛttaṃ, vāyau durgāyāṃ tathaiva saumyāyāṃ oṃ dhanādhipataye bhadratālaṃ niṣadhasvaraṃ, takkeśi rāgaṃ, pṛṣṭakuṭṭimanṛttaṃ aiśāne oṃ īśāya ḍhakkarītālaṃ dhaivatasvaraṃ śālāpāṇirāgaṃ, vāmajānūrdhva nṛttaṃ, garuḍasya madhyamasvaraṃ, garuḍagāndhārirāgaṃ, garuḍatālaṃ, viṣṇukrānta nṛttaṃ, viṣvaksenasya balitālaṃ, ṛṣabhasvaraṃ, varāṭi rāgaṃ, svastika nṛttam | idaṃ ekāvaraṇamātraviṣayam| antarhāropete dhāmni tu antarmaṇḍalanāmni prathamāvaraṇe gopurottarasāle oṃ puruṣāya, dakṣiṇe oṃ acyutāya, tālādīni pūrvoktāni|āgneye oṃ hayagrīvāya baddhāvatālaṃ ṛṣabha svaraṃ kollirāgaṃ sarvatobhadra nṛttaṃ | yāmyāṃ oṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya gāndhārasvaraṃ kauśikarāgaṃ bhṛṅgiṇītālaṃ bheṭaka nṛttaṃ | naiṛte oṃ varāhāya madhyamasvaraṃ naṭṭabhāṣārāgaṃ jayatālaṃ, cakramaṇḍalanṛttaṃ | vāruṇyāṃ oṃ pradyumnāya pañcamasvaraṃ , śrīrāgaṃ, samatālaṃ, kāntāra nṛttaṃ | vāyau oṃ anantāya dhaivatasvaraṃ, kāmadarāgaṃ, jayatālaṃ, kuṭṭima nṛttaṃ | uttarasya oṃ aniruddhāya niṣadhasvaraṃ, takkeśirāgaṃ, bhadratālaṃ, pṛṣṭa kuṭṭima nṛttaṃ | aiśāne oṃ nṛsiṃhāya dhaivatasvaraṃ, dakṣarāgaṃ, ḍhakkarītālaṃ, kaṭibandhananṛttaṃ|aṅgaṇe indrādi pīṭhikā sthāneṣu,pūrve oṃ cakriṇe, ṣaḍjasvaraṃ, gāndhārarāgaṃ, samatālaṃ,vilāsanṛttaṃ| āgneye oṃ musaline, ṛṣabhasvaraṃ, kollarīrāgaṃ, baddhāvatālaṃ, sarvatobhadranṛttaṃ | yāmyāṃ oṃ śaṃkhiṇe, gāndhārasvaraṃ, kauśikarāgaṃ, bhṛṅgiṇītālaṃ, kheṭakanṛttaṃ | naiṛte oṃ khaḍgine,madhyamasvaraṃ, naṭṭabhaṣārāgaṃ, mallatālaṃ, cakramaṇḍalanṛttaṃ | vāruṇyāṃ oṃ gadine, pañcamarasvaraṃ, śrīkāmadarāgaṃ, maṅgalatālaṃ, kāntāranṛttaṃ | vāyau oṃ śārṅgiṇe, kuṭṭimanṛttaṃ, dhaivatasvaraṃ, takkeśi rāgam, jaya tālaṃ, kauberyāṃ oṃ padmine, pṛṣṭakuṭṭima nṛttam, niṣadasvaram dakṣa rāgam,bhadratālam | aiśāne oṃ vajrine, vāmajānūrdhvanṛttam, dhaivatasvaram | śālāpāṇi rāgam, ḍhakkarītālam | antarhāranāmni dvitīyāvaraṇe sūryādīnāṃ pūrvameva uktāni | aṅgaṇe pūrve oṃ indrāya surādhipataye sadevīvāhanaparivārāya namaḥ | baliṃdadāmisamatālaṃ, ṣaḍjasvaram, gāndhārarāgam, vilāsanṛttam, āgneye oṃ agnaye namaḥ baddhāvatālaṃ, ṛṣabhasvaram, kollirāgam, subhadrakanṛttam, naiṛte oṃ naiṛtaye mallatālaṃ, madhyamasvaram, naṭṭabhāṣārāgam, cakramaṇḍalanṛttam, vāruṇe oṃ varuṇāya maṅgalatālaṃ, pañcamasvaram, kāmadarāgam, kāntāranṛttam, vāyavye oṃ vāyave kuṭṭima nṛttaṃ, dhaivata svaraṃ, takkeśirāgaṃ, jayatālaṃ, saumye oṃ kuberāya, pṛṣṭakuṭṭimanṛttaṃ, niṣadhasvaraṃ, dakṣarāgaṃ, bhadratālaṃ| aiśāne oṃ īśānāya vāmajānūrdhvanṛttaṃ,dhaivatasvaraṃ,śālāpāṇirāgaṃ, ḍhakkarītālam| madhyāntarhāranāmnitṛtīyāvaraṇe dhātrādi dvārapālānāṃ, dvādaśādityānāṃ ca bhadratālaṃ, dhaivatasvaraṃ, sarvamaṅgalanṛttaṃ | agniyama madhye vasavaḥ, yamaniṝtimadhye pitṛgaṇāḥ, niṝtivāruṇa madhye viśvedevāḥ, varuṇavāyu madhye saptamarutaḥ, vāyukuberamadhye saptaṛṣayaḥ, kubereśānamadhye ekādaśarudrāḥ, bhadratālaṃ, dhaivatasvaraṃ, sarvamaṅgala nṛttaṃ, tatrāṅkaṇe kumudādayaḥ, teṣāṃ tālarāganṛttāni uktāni | maryādāyāṃ dvārapālāḥ durjayādayāḥ, āvaraṇadevatāstupūrve sādhyā, āgneye navagrahāḥ, yāmyāyāṃ aṅgirasaḥ, naiṝte aśvinau, vāruṇyāṃ lakṣmīsarasvatīvighneśāḥ, vāyau indrādīśāntāḥ, uttarasyāṃ brahmādivāstudevagaṇāḥ, aiśānyāṃ saptaviṃśati nakṣatrāṇi | teṣāṃ ca bhadratālaṃ, dhaivatasvaraṃ, sarvamaṅgalanṛttāni, aṅgaṇe upendrādayaḥ, teṣāṃ indrādivat tālādīni| mahāmaryādā nāmni pañcamāvaraṇe dvārapālāḥ, kumudādayaḥ, teṣāṃ tālādīni uktāni | āvaraṇadevatāstu pūrvasyāṃ siddhaṛṣināgāḥ, āgneye asurāḥ, yāmyāyāṃ rākṣasāḥ, naiṛte yakṣavidyādharāḥ, paścimāyāṃ saurabheyī guhya gandharvāḥ, vāyavye apsarasaḥ, saumyāyāṃ prājāpatayaḥ matryāśca, aiśāne adhirohiṇyaḥ, eteṣāṃ balitālaṃ dhaivatasvaraṃ, sarvamaṅgalanṛttaṃ, aṅgaṇe indrādi pīṭhikāsu viśveśādayaḥ | teṣāṃ indrādivat tālarāga nṛttāni| evaṃ prathamāvaraṇādi sarvāvaraṇeṣu balipradānamātraṃ cet balyarthaṃ kramāt paribhrāmya | pīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya ālayaṃ praviśya | taṃ ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya antaḥ praviśya arghyaṃ datvā, mūlamantreṇa mūlabere samutsṛjya | baliśeṣaṃ kiñcit viṣvaksenasya śirasi nikṣipya| pariśiṣṭaṃ akṣatādikaṃ ca balipīṭhe nikṣipet | nityotsave tu tadbimbaṃ śibikādiṣu vā paricāraka śirasi vā āropya | paribhramaṇaṃ ācaret | tadā tatra vilāsa kartaryādi nṛttabheda saṃyutaṃ puṣpa prapā chatra cāmara sarva vāditra sarvageya brahmaghoṣabahudīpa saṃkulaṃ utsavaṃ kuryāt| tasya bimbasya śrīvatsādyaṣṭamaṅgalāni darśayitvā | devasya sannidhāne eva sarveṣāṃ baliṃ datvā | āvaraṇeṣu pṛthukādi tāmbūlaṃ ca naivedyaṃ ācareta|śaṃkhaninadena kevalaṃ prākāradvārā nirgatya balipīṭhasya purataḥ mandirābhimukhaṃ devaṃ sthāpayitvā | pīṭhasya sarvāsu dikṣu vāditreṣu ghoṣiteṣu kṣālite pīṭhikā mūrdhni guruḥ viṣṇupārṣadān sampūjya | tatra baliṃ niravaśeṣaṃ datvā | pīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya | dhāmāntaḥ praviśya | mukhamaṇḍape devasya pāduke datvā | yānādeḥ avaropya | devaṃ viṣṭare prāṅmukhaṃ āropya | arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya | avasarocitaṃ upahārādikaṃ pradāya| garbhagehaṃ praviśya | bahiraṅgaṇa bhūmiṣu geyavāditranṛtteṣu nyūnabhāvaṃ samādhātuṃ śuddhatāṇḍavaṃ darśayitvā | devaṃ mūlamantreṇa mūle samarpya | praṇamya stutvā, pradakṣiṇīkṛtya | svagṛhaṃ praviśya, svārthaṃ devaṃ prapūjayet| svārthārcanaṃ prathamameva iti kecit| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ nityotsava vidhiḥnāma triṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

ekatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | snapana vidhiḥ | atha snapanavidhiḥ ucyate | viṣusaṃkramaṇa,grahaṇā’yanadvaya, dvādaśī, śravaṇa, kartṛjanmadinatraya, tithitraya, vyatīpāta, rohiṇī, darśa, paurṇamāsī, punarvasu, pañcamyādi śubhatithi nakṣatravārādiṣu kṛtaṃ snapanaṃ kevalam | pratiṣṭhotsavādiṣukarmāṅgaṃ | karmāṅgenā’ṅkurāvāpana niśācūrṇa snapanādikam | kevale sarvaṃ catusthānārcanayutaṃ kuryāt| ācāryaḥtatpūrvedyurdevasyāṅkurapratisara purassaraṃ adhivāsaṃ sadyo vā kuryāt | adhivāsastu snapanapratimāyāṃ tīrthapratikṛtau vā tadalābhe utsavabiṃba balibiṃba karmārcā kūrcādiṣu lepamṛṇmaya bhittistha paṭastha viṣaye sakūrca darpaṇe’dhivāsaṃ kuryāt| snapanārthaṃ prāsādasya agrataḥ sarvāsu āvaraṇabhūmiṣu sarvāsu dikṣu yathāvakāśaṃ caturdvāra catustoraṇastambhaveṣṭana vitāna muktādāmapūrṇakumbhadarbhamālādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtaṃ daśahastavistṛtaṃ dviguṇena āyataṃ maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā | tasminpūrvaklṛpte vā maṇḍape tat tredhā vibhajya | tṛtīyeṃśe paścime caturaśrāṃ caturhastavistārāṃ śilādinirmitāṃ upānādiyutāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā | tadupari caturaśrāṃ vṛttaṃ vā prādeśena vistīrṇaṃ aṣṭāṅgulena caturaṅgulena vā unnataṃ valayaṃ vedikopari ca ādhāratulyaṃ āśvabhramedinīṃ kuryāt | mṛṇmayādiṣubimbeṣu bahirvedi prakalpanam| ekabere tu na bahiḥ snāna vediprakalpanam| toraṇādi na kartavyaṃ gṛhārcā snapane tathā| iti vidhāya | tat gomayena anulipya | sudhācūrṇā’kṣata dūrvāṅkura dīpa sāṃkura pālikādibhiḥalaṅkṛtya | tasya raudrekoṇe gālitavastu sugandhijalapūritāni jaladroṇyādi bhājanāni ca| vedikāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bhūtale pavamānādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ abhimantritaṃ sāpidhānaṃ upasnānāmbubhājanaṃ ca kalpayitvā | arghyādi dīpaparyantāni pūjādravyāṇi snānopayuktāni ca| tadanu vedikāgre | adhamottamasnapanavidhiḥ candanārdrāṇisūtrāṇi caturdaśa prāgāyatāni udagāyatāni ca āsphālya teṣu ekonasaptatyuttaraśatakoṣṭheṣu dhānyapīṭhānurūpyeṇa ṣoḍaśāṅgulāyāmavistāreṣu brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ nava nava padāni ekādhikāśīti saṃkhyākāni kalaśāspadāni visṛjya| śeṣāṇi aṣṭottarāśītisaṃkhyākāni vīthyarthaṃ saṃmārjya | pratipadaṃ vrīhyāḍhakena tadardhena vā taṇḍulena tadardhena tilena ca pīṭhikāṃ āracayya| tadupari dvaudvau darbhau pratyasya | tadupariṣṭāt sauvarṇān rājatān tāmrānvā mṛṇmayān pakvabimba phalopamān acchidrān svanavataḥ kālamaṇḍalavarjitān abhinnān pāṣāṇasphoṭavarjitān droṇena tadardhena vā vāriṇā paripūraṇocitān saptadaśakumbhān vāryāḍhakena pūraṇocitān catuṣṣaṣṭiśuddhodakakumbhān ca tantunā ‘indraṃ natvā’iti pariveṣṭitān viṣṇugāyatryā prakṣālya | kalaśāspadamedinyāḥ paścime bhāge dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāya | ācāryaḥ svayaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | saṃprokṣya | tasmin prāgagrān udagagrān vā darbhān saṃstīrya | teṣu etān oṃ iti brahmādīśānantaṃ adhomukhān saṃsthāpya | teṣāṃ upari oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥ parāya parameṣṭyātmane namaḥ iti trīn trīn darbhān vinyasya | prāṅmukhaḥ san arghyātoyena oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣātmane namaḥ iti prokṣya | oṃ rāṃ namaḥparāya viśvātmane namaḥ iti akṣatān vikīrya | oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛtyātmane namaḥ iti uttānīkṛtya | vidhivat agniṃ saṃsādhya | viṣṇugāyatryā ājyena snapanadravyāṇi saṃsicya | yathocitaṃ vastrapūtaiḥ ghṛtādi snapanadravyaiḥ tattanmantraiḥ kumbhān āpūrayet| oṃ lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ iti saptadaśakalaśān uddhṛtya | teṣu ekaṃ madhyamanavaka madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ droṇamāṇena ghṛtena oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ iti saṃpūrya | madhye saṃsthāpya | tādṛśa pramāṇena uṣṇodakena āpūrya | oṃ puruṣāya namaḥ iti ghṛtakumbhasya prācyāṃ ca | tasya āgneyadikkumbhaṃ māṇikyapadmarāganīla vajrapuṣyarāga pravāla mauktika marataka vaidūryanāmabhiḥ navaratnaiḥ saratnodakaṃ oṃ keśavāya namaḥ itisaṃpūrya | tadyāmyāyāṃ sodakumbhaṃ kadalīdāḍima cūtāmalakabilvanālikerapanasa mātulaṅgābhidhaiḥ bhinnaiḥ phalaiḥ oṃ satyāya namaḥ iti | ghṛtasya naiṝtakumbhaṃ lohodakena suvarṇa rajatatāmra sīsa trapukāṃsyāyobhidhānaiḥ pratyekaṃ niṣphapramāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ lohaiḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya’ iti| tatpaścimesajalaṃ kumbhaṃ rajanīsūryavartinīsahadevī śirīṣa sadābhadra kuśāgraiḥ mārjanadravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimāṇaiḥ oṃ acyutāya namaḥ iti| tasya mārutaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ candanakuṣṭa kuṅgumāgaru uśīra hrībera girisaṃbhava māṃsīmurābhidhaiḥ pṛthak palamitaiḥ gandhadravyaiḥ oṃ mādhavāya namaḥiti| tasya kauberaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ nīvāraveṇuśāli priyaṅgu yava kaṅgu ṣāṣṭika godhūmataṇḍulaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimātraiḥ oṃ anantāya namaḥ iti| tasya aiśānaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ yava veṇu vrīhibhiḥ pratyekaṃ kuḍupa pramāṇaiḥ oṃ goviṃdāya namaḥ iti ca saṃpūrya | brahmasthāna navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ sodakaṃ pādyābhidhānaṃ tulasī padma dūrvākṣata śyāmāka viṣṇuparṇī bilvapatraiḥ palamātreṇa candanena ca oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ iti saṃpūrya | yāmya navakasya madhyamaṃ arghyākhyaṃ sodakaṃ kumbhaṃ siddhārthākṣata kuśāgra pūrvokta phalayava tila candanapuṣpaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimātraiḥ, candanena triniṣphamātreṇa oṃ madhusūdanāya namaḥ iti | paścima kumbhanavakasya madhyamaṃ upasparśanākhyaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ takkola caṃpakamukulakarpūra jātīphala elālavaṅgatvakcandanapuṣpaiḥ pratyekaṃ palārdhaparimāṇaiḥ oṃ trivikramāya namaḥiti | uttara navakasya madhyamaṃ pañcagavyākhyaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhidviguṇena āghāreṇa,tasmāt triguṇena payasā taccaturguṇena mūtreṇa tasmāt caturguṇena śakṛdvāriṇā ca gomūtraṃ viṣṇugāyatryā gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ| āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāviṇṇeti vai dadhi| ghṛtaṃ śukramasītyevaṃ gavyāni sahayojayet| athavā viṣṇugāyatryā,yadvā ‘‘parameṣṭī śakṛnmantraḥ,gomūtrasya tu pūruṣaḥ| viśvamantraḥ bhavet dadhnaḥ nivṛttiḥ sarpiṣā bhavet|payasaḥ sarvamantraḥ syāt yadvācāṣṭākṣareṇa vā | evaṃ saṃyojya | devasyatveti sarvāṇi ekīkṛtya | evaṃ sādhitena etena pañcagavyena droṇamānena | evaṃ saṃyojanaprakāraḥ snapanavidhau, prokṣaṇe tu etatsarvaṃ pañcakaṃ samaṃ|prāśane tu gomayena samaṃ mūtraṃ dadhisyāt dviguṇaṃ tataḥ| tataḥ caturguṇaṃ sarpiḥ sarpiṣā’ṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ| prāśane pañcagavyasya pramāṇamidamīritam| droṇamānaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtamānaṃ ca tādṛśam| tādṛgeva dadhi kṣīraṃ tāvadeva ca mākṣikam| ardhaṃ vāsyādāḍhakaṃ vā nyūnaṃcedāsuraṃ bhavet| gṛhārcāsnapane nyūnaṃ prasthenaiva prakalpayet| pañcagavyāni gṛhṇīyāt mṛtpātre nūtane śubhe| kapilāyāḥ jarāyāḥ vā pañcagavyaṃ praśasyate| na ārtāyāḥ na ca garbhiṇyāḥ na vṛddhāyāḥ kadācana| na avatsāyaḥ upādadyāt dhenomūtraṃ śakṛddvayam| bhūmiṣṭhaṃ gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ soṣṇaṃ kṛmyādi dhūṣitam| niṣpīḍya samyak gṛhṇīyāt gomayasya rasaṃ punaḥ| sadyastaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ ahorātroṣitaṃ dadhi| kṣīraṃ grāhyamataptaṃ ca daśahājjanmanaḥ param|evaṃ saṃpādya | oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ iti | āgneya navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhnā oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ iti naiṝtakumbha navakasya madhya kumbhaṃ payasā oṃ hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ iti, vāyavīyakumbha navakumbha navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ madhunā oṃ padmanābhāya namaḥ iti, aiśānyāṃ kumbhanavakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ śamīpalāśakhādira bilvāśvattha vikaṅga ta audumbara nyagrodhatvakbhiḥ palārdhaparimitābhiḥ kṛtena kaṣāyena oṃ dāmodarāya namaḥ iti ca saṃpūrya | viṣṇugāyatryā saptadaśa dravya kumbhān saṃsthāpya | madhyamanavakasya pūrvanavakādyaṣṭanavakamadhyadravyakumbhānāṃ ca parito’ṣṭāvaṣṭau śuddhodakalaśān dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa saṃsthāpayet | pūrvoktadravyā’lābhe tu pādyadravyāṃtarālābhe dūrvāgrepi ca sarṣapaḥ| śastamācamanīye tu takkolaṃ mārjanāṃbasi| sahadevī gandhatoye candanakṣoda iṣyate| kaṣāyatoyecāśvatthaṃ śītamuṣṇodake sati| ratnodake vajramekaṃ kadalyekā phalāṃbasi| suvarṇaṃ lohapānīye śālitaṇḍulamakṣate | yavodakaghaṭe vrīhiḥ śasyate kamalāsana| alabdhe dadhinīkṣīraṃ kṣīrālābhe tu taddadhi| madhūnyalabdhe sarpīṃṣi tadalābhe bhaven madhu| alābhe pañcagavyānāṃ ghṛtamevaikamiṣyate| pañcagavyeṣu yasyasyāt alābhastatpade ghṛtam| iti bhagavaduktaiḥ evaṃ dravyapūraṇaṃ kṛtvā | paristīrya| saptabhiḥ pañcabhistṛbhiḥ vā darbhaiḥ kṛtān kūrcān kumbheṣvavāgagrān mahākumbhe cartuīṃvaśatibhirdarbhaiḥkṛtaṃ kūrcaṃ karṇamānaṃ tathā nikṣipya tāṃ cakramantrena śarāvaiḥ pidhāya | ‘yuvāsuvāsā iti mantreṇa vāsasā pratyekamalābhe, prativyūhaṃ vā sarvānāveṣṭya | ācāryo mūrtipairbrāhmaṇaissaha devasamīpamāsādya | ‘uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspata iti devamutthāpya | bhadraṃkarṇebhiḥ iti snānasanavedikāyāṃ viniveśya| vedavidbrāhmaṇairayugmaissaha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | tānyathāvittānusāraṃ toṣayitvā | guruḥ prāṇānāyamya | sthāpiteṣu toraṇadhvajakumbheṣu tattaddevānāvāhya abhyarcya | maṇṭapadvāreṣu tauryatrikaṃ pravartayitvā | pūrvasaṃsādhitā’gnau yāvatkalaśasaṃkhyayā mūlamantreṇājyāhutīrhutvā | anyasmin saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya | caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīśca hutvā | devaṃ gandhādibhirabhyarcya | kumbheṣu saṃpātājyāropaṇamāracayya | ghṛtādi dravyakumbheṣu ādhārādi padmāntaṃ pīṭhaṃ saṃkalpyā’bhyarcya | ghṛtakumbhe oṃ namo bhagavate paramātmane vāsudevāyāgacchāgaccha ityāvāhya | abhyarcya | arghyāditāmbūlāntaṃ saṃpūjya | uṣṇodaka phalamārjanākṣata ratnaloha gandhayava pādyā’rghya ācamana pañcagavya dadhipayo madhukaṣāyakumbheṣu puruṣasatya acyutānanta keśava nārāyaṇa mādhava govindaviṣṇu madhusūdana trivikrama vāmana śrīdhara hṛṣīkeśa padmanābha dāmodarān krameṇa āvāhya abhyarcya | arghyādi tāṃbūlāntaṃ saṃpūjya | sarveṣu śuddhodakumbheṣu ca aṣṭākṣareṇa āvāhya abhyarcya| tadanu oṃ dhānyādhi daivatāyai bhūmyai namaḥ, oṃ kūrcādhi daivatāya astrāyaphaṭ, oṃ cakrikādhidaivatāya oṃ sudarśanāya namaḥ, oṃ vāsodhidaivatāya viṣṇave namaḥ | anyeṣāṃ yāgadravyāṇāṃ oṃ janārdanāya namaḥ | iti ca āvāhya abhyarcya | devasya viṣṇu gāyatryā arghyaṃ trīṇi padeti pādyaṃ, āpaḥpunantu iti ācamanaṃ, tadviṣṇoḥ iti dantadhāvanaṃ, viṣṇu gāyatryā jihvānirlepanaṃ, vāmadevyaṃ iti abhyaṅgaṃ, viṣṇornukaṃ iti āmalaka vāri, nate viṣṇuḥ iti abhiṣekaṃ, agniḥmūrdhā iti plotavastraṃ, praṇavena vastraṃ, uttarīyaṃ ca datvā|punaḥ arghyādi dīpāntaṃ arcayitvā | chinnakautukatantuṃ sapuṣpaṃ samarcitaṃ pādyakumbhaṃ viṣṇugāyatryā uddhṛtya|mūrtipa dattaṃ ācāryaḥ kare gṛhītvā | pādyakumbhasthā’vāgagrakūrcāhṛtajalena devasya śirasi praṇavena saṃprokṣya | viṣṇugāyatryā pādyavāriṇā, praviṣṇurastu iti arghyājalena, na te viṣṇuḥ iti ācamanāmbunā, viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi iti pañcagavyena, dadhikrāviṇṇeti dadhnā, payovrata sāmnā payasā, madhuvāteti madhunā oṣadhyaḥ iti kaṣāyena, tvaṃ viṣṇuḥ iti uṣṇajalena, yāḥ phalanīḥ iti phalavāriṇā, śannodevīḥ iti mārjanāṃbhasā, sāvitryā akṣatodakena, trātāramitiratnodakena,mahāvyāhṛtyā lohavāriṇā, gandhadvāreti gandhāṃbunā, śatadhāreti yavodakena, ghṛtasnāteti sāmnāghṛtena ca athavā puruṣasūktasya ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ idaṃ viṣṇuḥ ityanayārcayā vā, dvādaśākṣareṇa, ṣaḍakṣareṇa viṣṇugāyatryā vā svaiḥ svaiḥ mūrtimantraiḥ vā pādyādi ghṛtāntaiḥ pratidravyakumbhasnapanaṃ upasnānottarīyārghyacamanīya gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāntaṃ devaṃ abhyarcya abhiṣicya| dravyakumbhoddharaṇāntarāntarā śuddhodakumbhān dvādaśākṣareṇa uddhṛtya, abhiṣicya | tadanu nava sapta pañca trīn vā kumbhān ekaṃ vā kumbhaṃ puṇyāhapurassaraṃ haridrātaṇḍulasya cūrṇaiḥ saṃpūrya | dhānya pīṭhe nidhāya | tān savastra ratnalohakūrca pallavāpidhānān kṛtvā | tatra śriyaṃ āvāhya abhyarcya | śrīsūktena taiḥ abhiṣicya |tataḥ devaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya | natvā, sahasradhārayā snāpayitvā | praṇavena alaṅkārāsanaṃ datvā | arghyaṃ ārabhya nīrājanāntaṃ iṣṭvā|khāridroṇaṃ tadardhaṃ vā taṇḍulaṃ datvā| caturvidhaṃ annaṃ nivedya| nityahomaṃ kṛtvā| tataḥ sukhāsīnaṃ devaṃ natvā| stutvā|manorathaṃ prārthayet| yajamāno’pi gurave śataniṣphaparimitāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ṛtvijāṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā paricāraka vedapāṭhakādīnāṃ datvā | pūjārthaṃ āhṛtaṃ śiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya dadyāt | etadadhamottamam | eteṣu ekottarāśītikumbheṣu sarvakoṇastha dvātriṃśacchuddhodakumbhahīnaṃ adhamamadhyamam | sarvaiḥ catuṣṣaṣṭi śuddhokakumbhaiḥ hīnaṃ adhamādhamam | madhyamottamasnapanavidhiḥ atha madhyamottamasnapanavidhiḥ ucyate madhye pūrvoktādhamottamaikāśītikalaśasthāpane vihitenasūtravartmanaiva tadbahiḥ caturdikṣu tathā sūtrāṇi āsphālya | dve dve paṅkti vīthyarthaṃ tatparitaḥ saṃmārjya | śiṣṭeṣu ekāśītipadeṣu madhye kumbhānāṃ navakaṃ indrādi somāntāsu dikṣu pratidiśaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ, āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu pratyekaṃ catuṣphaṃ, evaṃ ekonapañcāśatkalaśān saṃsthāpya | śeṣāṇi dvātriṃśatpadāni vīthyarthaṃ parimārjya | evaṃ caturdikṣu kṛtvā | prāksthita ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhyanavakamadhyamaṃ oṃ varāhāya namaḥ iti guḍodakena | dakṣiṇe ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhyanavakamadhyamaṃ oṃ nārasiṃhāya namaḥ iti ikṣurasena | paścima ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhyanavakamadhyamaṃ oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ iti nālikerajalena | uttara ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhyanavakamadhyamaṃ śāntikumbhaṃ tulasīveṇunīvāraśāliśvetasarṣapatilaiḥ tulasīṃ vinā pratyekaṃ kuḍuba pramāṇaiḥ muṣṭimātratulasyā ca, śāntidravyā’bhāve tulasyā ekayā vā oṃ hayagrīvāya namaḥ iti ca| guḍābhāve ca ikṣurasaṃ tasya abhāve guḍodakam| guḍamānaṃ palāśītiḥ ardhaṃ ardhārdhameva vā| nālikerajalābhāve tatsthāne kṣīramiṣyate| āpūrya | guḍodake oṃ varāhāya namaḥ, ikṣurase oṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ, nālikerodake oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ, śāntivāriṇī oṃ hayagrīvāya namaḥ ityāvāhya abhyarcya | ‘madhuvāteti guḍodakena, madhunaktaṃ iti ikṣurasena, madhumāmna iti nālikerāṃbhasā, vedāhaṃ iti śāntijalena, jitaṃte iti śuddhodakumbhaiḥ samsnāpya | tadanu pādyādighṛtāntaiḥ snapanaṃ ācaret | snapanānte niśācūrṇaiḥ snapanaṃ kuryāt| iti madhyamottama snapanavidhiḥ| ekottarāśīti kalaśastha catuṣṣaṣṭiśuddhodakumbhān tatparitaḥ catasṛṣu dikṣu sthāpitaikona pañcāśatkalaśastha dvinavatyuttara saṃkhyākān śuddhoda kumbhān ca kroḍīkṛtya ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśataśuddhodakumbheṣu ardhaśuddhodakumbhahīnaṃ madhyamamadhyamaṃ, sarvaśuddhodakumbhaiḥ vinā madhyamā’dhamam| uttamottamasnapanavidhiḥ atha tāvat uttamottamasnapanavidhiḥ ucyate | pūrvokta ekāśīti kalaśāspadasya pūrvādyāśāsu catasṛṣu dikṣu pratidiśaṃ ca ekonapañcāśatkumbheṣu sthāpiteṣusatsu, ekāśīti kalaśasthāpanasya āgneyādiṣu caturṣukoṇeṣu pratikoṇaṃ tattatsūtravartmanaiva pūrvavata sūtrāṇi āsphālya | tathaiva ekona pañcāśatka laśān saṃsthāpya | āgneya ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhya navakamadhyamakumbhaṃ maṅgalākhyaṃ indravalyaṅkura, aśvatthapallava, kuśeśaya, ekapatrāṃbuja, candana, kuṣṭa, kuṅguma, rohiṇadruma, yūthikā, mallikā, utpalatraya, jāti, caṃpaka, ketakībhiḥ dvau indravallyaṅkurau, aśvatthapallavaṃ muṣṭimātraṃ ekapatrāṃbujamekaṃ, kuśeśayamekaṃ, puṣpāṣṭakaṃ muṣṭimātraṃ, candanāni ekaikaṃpalaṃ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya iti naiṝta ekonapañcāśatkalaśamadhya navakamadhyamakumbhaṃ sarvauṣadhākhyaṃ māṃsīkuṣṭha, haridrādvitaya, murā, śaileya, caṃpaka, mukula, mustā, vacā, karpūraiḥ, pratyekaṃ palamitaiḥ | kṣuṇṇaiḥ, oṃ namobhagavate saṃkarṣaṇāya namaḥ, vāyavya ekonapañcāśatkalaśamadhya navakamadhyamakumbhaṃ sarvagandhākhyaṃ, karpūrakuṅkuma kuṣṭha māṃsī malayaja, murā priyaṅgu, kesara, mustā tamāla, nāgakesara, mūladvitaya, kaccora, suraparṇī, kesara, uśīra, tāra, lodhra, haricandana, agarudvitaya, sitakuṣṭha, kāleya, granthipallava, campakamukulacūrṇitaiḥ pratyekaṃ palasammitaiḥ oṃ namobhagavate pradyumnāya namaḥiti | aiśāne ekonapañcāśatkalaśa madhyanavaka madhyamakumbhaṃ mūlauṣadhākhyaṃ vyāghrī, sihmī, balā, śarapuṅka, śatāvarī, bilvamūla, vacā, śuṇṭhī goraṇḍī, śatamūlaiḥ, pṛthakpalamitaiḥ cūrṇitaiḥ oṃ namobhagavate aniruddhāya iti| āpūrya | maṅgalodake vāsudevaṃ,sarvauṣadhīkumbhe saṃkarṣaṇaṃ, sarvagandhakumbhe pradyumnaṃ, sarvamūlauṣadhīkumbhe ca aniruddhaṃ āvāhya| saṃpūjya| viṣṇornukamiti maṅgalāṃbunā, oṣadhya iti sarvauṣadhījalena, nārāyaṇānuvākena sarvagandhāṃbunā, yā oṣadhīriti, aṣṭākṣareṇa śuddhajalaiśca saṃsnāpya | anantaraṃ ghṛtāntaṃ snāpayet | ityuttamottamam | sarvatra kroḍīkṛtya | aṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttara catuśśata śuddhodakumbheṣu arddhaśuddhodakumbhaiḥ hīnaṃ uttamamadhyamaṃ | sarvaiḥ aṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttara catuśśataśuddhodakumbhaiḥ vinā pañcaviṃśatidravyakumbhaireva kṛtaṃ uttamādhamam| iti snapananavakam| atha aṣṭottaraśatakalaśasnapana vidhiḥ ucyate kalaśasthāpana prāgāyateṣu ṣaṭsu udagāyateṣu ca tathā sūtreṣu āsphāliteṣu pañcaviṃśatipadāni bhaveyuḥ| teṣu mānuṣedvādaśapadāni hitvā | madhye brahma divyasthapadanavakaṃ ekīkṛtya | sūtravartmanā koṣṭānāṃ yathāśataṃbhavati tathā kṛtvā|tatra prācyāṃ avācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ udīcyāṃ dve dve paṅktī hitvā tatparitaḥ dve dve paṅktī saṃmārjya | tatra brahmādīśāntāsu dikṣu vidikṣu ca navapadāni kumbhāspadāni, evaṃ anayārītyā aṣṭottaraśatakalaśāspadāni kalpayet | evaṃ kalaśān saṃsthāpya | brāhmamadhyakalaśacatuṣṭayāgneya padakumbhaṃ pūrvoktapramāṇena ghṛtena, avaśiṣṭān trīn śuddhodakenāpūrya | tatparitaḥ pūrvādīśāntā’ṣṭadiksthitā’ṣṭa catuṣphā’‘gneyakumbhāṣṭakaṃ, uṣṇodaka,ratnodaka, phalodaka, lohatoya, mārjanodaka, gandhavāri, akṣatavāri,yavodakāṇi pūrvoktamānaiḥāpūrya | mānuṣebhāge prācyādīśānānta sthitā’ṣṭa navaka kumbhāṣṭakaṃ evaṃkṛte dravyakalaśāḥ saptadaśa śuddhodakumbhānāṃ ekottarāśītiḥ | evaṃ sarvamapi kroḍīkṛtya aṣṭottaraśataṃ kalaśānāṃ bhavati| devamantrābhiṣekāśca pūrvavat| atha ekonapañcāśatkalaśasnapana vidhiḥ ucyate prāgāyatāni daśa tathā udagāyatāni ca sūtrāṇi āsphālayet | evaṃ cet ekottarāśītipadāni bhaveyuḥ| kalaśāspadasya catasṛṣu dikṣu dve dve paṅktī hitvā|tataḥ ekasyāṃ ekasyāṃ paṅktau sammārjitāyāṃ madhye navakaṃ dikṣu pratidiśaṃ ṣaṭkāni vidikṣu pratyekaṃ catuṣphāni evamekonapañcāśatkalaśāspadāni bhaveyuḥ| madhye nava,dikṣu catvāraḥ,vidikṣu catvāraḥdravyakumbhāḥ bhavanti|evaṃ cet saptadaśadravyakumbhāḥ dvātriṃśat śuddhodakumbhāḥ mantradevatāḥ snapanaṃ ca pūrvavat| atha pañcaviṃśatikalaśasnapanavidhiḥ yathā ekottarāśītipadāni bhaveyuḥ,tathā sūtrāṇi āsphālya| catasṛṣu dikṣu ekaikāṃ paṅktīṃ hitvā| tataḥ dve dve paṅktīṃ sammārjya| madhye nava pratidiśaṃ trīn trīn pratikoṇamekaikaṃ kalaśānāṃ saṃsthāpya|madhyastha trika catuṣṭaya madhyasthāśca koṇacatuṣṭayasthāḥ catvāraśca dravyakumbhāḥ saptadaśa aṣṭau kumbhāḥ śuddhodakapūritāḥ| dravya mantradevatāḥ snapanaṃ pūrvavat|yadvā candanāgaru kāśmīra kuṣṭha tagara vīṇāsitā’garu haricandanahrīberaiḥ gandhadravyaiḥ madhya kumbhanavakaṃ, dikṣu stithān caturaḥvidikṣu caturaśca tamālasitakuṣṭha suraparṇīrasa karpūra nāgakesara mustācampakamukula priyaṅgu puṣpa kāleya granthipallava bīja māṃsi kharjūra śaileya hrīberadruma muraiḥ vā sarvān kumbhān pūrayet| atha ṣoḍaśakalaśasnapana vidhiḥ prāgāyatāni nava tathā udagāyatāni ca sūtrāṇi tathā sati catasṛṣu ekaikāṃ paṅktīṃ hitvā| dvayoḥ dvayoḥ paṅktyoḥ sammārjitayoḥ madhye catvāri dikṣu dve dve vidikṣu ca ekaikaṃ, evaṃ ṣoḍaśa kalaśāspadāni bhaveyuḥ| madhya catuṣphasya āgneyaṃ kumbhaṃ pūrvoktaiḥ navabhiḥ ratnaiḥ naiṝtaṃ tathā saptalohaiḥ,vāyavyaṃ tathāgandhadravyaiḥ aiśānaṃ tathā ājyena ca āpūrya| pūrvādisthita dvādaśakumbhān pādyārghya dadhyācamana pañcagavya kṣīrākṣata mārjana madhu kaṣāyakuśodaka yavaiḥ pūrvoktamānaiḥ krameṇa āpūrya| puruṣādi dāmodarāntān āvāhya|nṛsūkta ṣoḍaśaṛgbhiḥ snapanaṃ kuryāt| atha dvādaśakalaśa snapana vidhiḥprāgāyatāni sapta tathā udagāyatāni ca sūtrāṇi,tathā sati madhye catuṣphaṃ vihāya catasṛṣvapi dikṣu ekaikāṃ paṅktīṃ saṃmṛjya|koṇeṣu catasṛṣu triṣu triṣu padeṣu mṛṣṭeṣu, catuṣphasya bahiḥ prācyāṃ avācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ udīcyāṃ dve dve bhavataḥ| evaṃ sati dvādaśa kalaśāspadāni bhaveyuḥ| madhyacatuṣphasya āgneyaṃ kumbhaṃ pūrvoktaiḥ navabhiḥ ratnaiḥ naiṝtaṃ lohaiḥ,vāyavyaṃ gandhadravyaiḥ,aiśānaṃ sarpiṣā ca āpūrya|tatpūrvādyuttarānta padasthitān aṣṭau kumbhān krameṇa pādya dadhyarghya kṣīrācamana madhu pañcagavya phalaiḥ pūrvoktamānaiḥ āpūrayet|mantradevatāḥpūrvavat| eteṣāṃ alābhe tu madhyacatuṣphaṃ āgneyaṃ ārabhya bahi sthita somakumbhāntaṃ koṣṭā’garu kālīya granthipallavabīja candana kāśmīra māṃsī tamāla mura parvatotthasuvarṇa rajaḥkaṇa caṃpaka mukula kharjūradravaiḥ prādakṣiṇyena āpūrayet| atha navakalaśasnapana vidhiḥ prāgāyatāni sūtrāṇi catvāri tathā udagāyatāni ca| tathā sati padāni nava bhaveyuḥ| madhyakumbhaṃ ārabhya aiśānantaṃ ghṛta pādya dadhyarghya kṣīrācamana madhupañcagavya phalaiḥ krameṇa | navaratnaiḥ vā pūrayet|mantra devatāḥ pūrvavat| atha pañcakalaśasnapana vidhiḥ ekaḥ madhye catasṛṣu api dikṣu catvāraḥ| madhyaṃ ārabhya saumya paryantamaṇipravāla mauttika vajra vaiḍhūrya pañcalohaiḥ| athavā pratyekaśaḥ pañcagavyaiḥ vā pūrayet| pañcagavyasya mantradevatāḥ paññcopaniṣadaḥ| atha ekakalaśasnapana vidhiḥ ekaṃ kalaśaṃ madhye saṃsthāpya pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ vā pūrayet|gurave yathāśakti niṣphamānā deyā| iti śrī varāha guru viracitāyāṃ kriyakairava candrikāyāṃ uttamādi snapana vidhiḥ nāma ekatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<32 >
dvātriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | atha ekottarasahasrakalaśasnapanavidhiḥ ucyate | pūrvedyureva bhagavataḥ pūrvavat aṅkura pratisarādhivāsān ca kṛtvā | dvātriṃśaddhastavistāradviguṇena āyataṃ kalaśāspada bhūbhāga vaipulyānuguṇaṃ mahat anyat maṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvā | yathāpuraṃ dvārādīni ca| kalaśāspadabhūmiṃ pañcaviṃśatidhā vibhajya| madhyamaṃ brāhmaṃpadaṃ ekottarāśīti ghaṭāspadaṃ yathā bhavati tathā vibhajya|brahmādīśānāntaṃ nava nava padāni ekāśīti ghaṭāspadāni hitvā | śiṣṭāniaṣṭottarāśīti padāni saṃmārjya | pratipadaṃ vrīhīṇāṃ āḍhakeṇa taṇḍulānāṃ tadardhena tadardhena tilānāṃ pīṭhikāṃ kṛtvā | tadupari dvau dvau darbhau vinyasya| tadanu suvarṇādi lohajān mṛṇmayān pūrvokta lakṣaṇayutān droṇeṇa vā jalānāṃ tadardhena vā pūryān| dravyakumbhān , jalānāṃ āḍhakena pūryān ca| kalaśān viṣṇugāyatryā prakṣālya | mṛṇmayāṃstu vāme karatale vinyasya taditareṇa kareṇa tantuṃ gṛhītvā veṣṭitatantūnāṃ antarālaṃyavamātraṃ ardhāṅgulamātraṃ vā yathā bhavet tathā | ‘‘indraṃ natve’ti mantreṇa āveṣṭyā| kalaśāspadamedinyāḥ paścime bhūtale dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāya | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | tasmin prāgagrān udagagrān vā darbhān saṃstīrya | tatra brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ kumbhān adhomukhān oṃ iti vinyasya | teṣāṃ upari pūrvavat trīn trīn darbhān parameṣṭhimantreṇa vinyasya| arghyā toyena puruṣa mantreṇa prāṅmukhaḥ prokṣya| viśvamantreṇa akṣatān vikīrya| nivṛttimantreṇa uttānikṛtya | tadanu vidhivat agniṃ saṃsādhya| sarpiṣā viṣṇugāyatrya aṣṭottara śatāhutiḥ hutvā saṃpātena snapana dravyāṇi saṃsicya | vastrapūtaiḥ snapanadravyaiḥ tattat devatā mantraiḥ kalaśān saṃpūrya| dravya kalaśān uddhṛtya | viṣṇugāyatrya yathāsthānaṃ vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā sthāpayet| madhye brāhmebhāge ekottarāśīti ghaṭāḥ| divye aindre divye yāmye vāruṇe divye saumye ca pratidiśaṃ ekottarāśītikalaśāḥ | divyabhāgāgneyādi koṇacatuṣṭayeṣvapi pratikoṇaṃ ekonapañcāśat saṃkhyākāḥ kalaśāḥ| teṣāṃ tu prāgudagagrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya| pūrvādi dikṣu dve dve paṅktī hitvā | paritaḥ ekaikāṃ paṅktiṃ saṃmārjya | madhye nava pūrvādyuttarāntaṃ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ | āgneyādīśānāntaṃ catvāri catvāri kalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ| tatparitaśca mānuṣe bhāge ṣoḍaśasthāneṣu ca pratisthānaṃ pañcaviṃśatikalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ | teṣāṃ tu prāgudagagrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya | catusṛṣu dikṣu ekaikām paṅktī hitvā | tadanu dve dve paṅktī sammārjya | madhye nava dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi vidikṣu ekaikāṃ | evaṃ pañcaviṃśati kalaśān sthāpayet |evaṃ cet kalaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ekottaraṃ bhavati | brāhme madhyanavake navakamadhyame sarvalohān || suvarṇa rajata tāmra sīsa trapu kāṃsyā’yassārān niṣphamātrān, māṇikya padmarāga nīlavajra puṣyaka pravālamuktāmarataka vaiḍhūryāṇi | kadalī bījapūrakā’‘mrā’‘malaka bilva nālikera panasa mātuluṅgāni māṃsi kuṣṭha haridrādvitaya murāśaileya campaka mukula mustāvacā karpūrāṇi pṛthak pṛthak palamātrāṇi | karpūra kuṅakuma kuṣṭha māṃsi candanamurapriyaṅgu kesara mustātamālanāgakesara mūladvaya, kacchora suraparṇi kesarośīra tagara loghra haricandana agaru dvaya, sitakuṣṭhakāleya granthipallava campaka mukulāni pratyekaṃ palamānāni cūrṇikṛtāni| śrīvatsa vanamāla śaṅkha cakra gadāṃbuja khaḍga śārṅgāṇi svarṇanirmitāni pratyekaṃ niṣphamānāni ca sajale kumbhe oṃ namobhagavatevāsudevāya iti viniveśya | taṃ yuvāsā iti vāsobhyāṃ āveṣṭya | sakūrca pippala dalāpidhānaṃ kṛtvā| tatra yogapīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya | tasmin sāṅgaṃ saparivāraṃ vāsudevaṃ āvāhya | arghyādi dīpāntaṃ abhyarcya| brāhme tasya prācīnakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe sūryakānta padmarāgau| tasya puruṣo devatā | brāhme āgneya kumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe vaiḍhūrya candrakāntau| tasya vāsudevaḥ devatā | brāhme yāmyakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe indranīlāyasyakāntau tasya satyo devatā| brāhme naiṝtakumbhanavaka madhyame kumbhe pravālagaruḍau tasya saṅkarṣaṇo devatā| brāhme vāruṇa kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe puṣyasphaṭikau tasya acyutaḥdevatā | brāhme vāyavya kumbhanavakamadhyamekumbhe padmarāgamaratake tasya pradyumno devatā| brāhme vāruṇa kumbhanavakamadhyamekumbhe vajraṃ,rajatam tasya anantaḥ devatā| brāhme raudrakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe tāmramauttike tasya aniruddhaḥ devatā| sarveṣu śuddhodakeṣu mauktikāni teṣāṃ devatā nārāyaṇaḥ| tasyāṃ prācyāṃ divye bhāge ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe kadali panasa āmra mātulaṅga bhavya jaṃbukesara badari phalāni | tasya devatā tattvātmā | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe mātulaṅga dāḍimaphale | tasya devatā pṛthvī | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe jambūnāraṅga phale | tasya devatā apāṃadhiṣṭhātri| tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe takkolailāphale | tasya tejasvīpuruṣaḥ devatā | tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe kṣīrikāmalaka phale | tasya vāyurdevatā| tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame ghaṭe drākṣā kharjūra phale | tasya ākāśātmā devatā | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame ghaṭe cūtapārāvataphale| tasya devatā manaḥ| tasya saumya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kṣudraṃ panasaphalaṃ| tasya devatāahaṃkāraḥ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe bilvakadali phale | tasya devatā buddhiḥ | sarveṣu śuddhodaka kumbheṣu badari phalāni devatāḥ pūrvavat| aṣṭākṣareṇa pañcopaniṣadaiḥ kumbhānāṃ abhimantraṇam | divyayāmye ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe uśīra, kuṅakuma, kuṣṭha, māṃsī, malayaja, mura, hrībera, agarupiṣṭāni pratyekaṃ palamātrāṇi tasya devatā trailokyamohanaḥ | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe jaladavāreṇamūle| tasya devatā babhruḥ | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe karpūrakāśmīre | tasya devatā śauriḥ | tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe campaka mukula māṃsīpiṣṭe | tasya devatā dāśārhaḥ| tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe candana raktacandanakṣodau | tasya devatāannādhipatiḥ | tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame kumbhe suraparṇī maurarajasī | tasya devatāvaikuṇṭhaḥ | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame ghaṭe girijamūla praiyaṅgava mūla rajasī | tasya devatā puruṣottamaḥ | tasya saumya navakamadhyame kumbhe kuṣṭa sitakuṣṭapiṣṭe | tasya devatā mukundaḥ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kṛṣṇa dhavalāgarukṣodau | tasya devatā vṛṣākapiḥ| avaśiṣṭeṣu śuddhodaka kumbheṣu tamāla patrāṇi | devatāḥ pūrvavat | puruṣamantreṇa vā pavamānādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ vā kumbhābhimantraṇam| divya vāruṇe ekottarāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavakamadhyame kumbhe vāpi saritkūpa hrada vṛṣṭi hima āpagā samudra taṭāka pāthāṃsi nava | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe vāpījalaṃ | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe sarijjalaṃ | tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kūpajalaṃ | tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe hradajalaṃ | tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame kumbhe himajalaṃ | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame vṛṣṭi| tasya saumya navakamadhyame kumbhe āpagājalaṃ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe samudrajalaṃ | eteṣāṃ devatāstu krameṇa bhārgavarāmarahitāḥ matsyādayaḥ| śuddhodakānāṃ pūrvavat| divye saumye ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe yava godhūma vrīhi śāli mudga priyaṅgu māṣa śyāmāka nīvārāṇi| tasya devatā garuḍārūḍhaḥ padmanābhaḥ| tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe yavaṃ | tasya devatā vanamālā | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe godhūmaḥ | tasya devatā śaṅkhaḥ | tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe vrīhiḥ | tasya devatā cakraṃ| tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe śāliḥ | tasya devatākaustubhaḥ | tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame mudgaṃ | tasya devatāpadmaṃ | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame priyaṅguḥ| tasya devatā śārṅga | tasya saumya navakamadhyame kumbhe māṣaṃ | tasya devatā gadā | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe śyāmāka nīvāraḥ | tasya devatā khaḍgaḥ| śiṣṭāḥ śuddhodakāḥ devatāśca tathā| divye āgneyeekonapañcāśat ghaṭāspade madhyamanavake ghṛtaṃ | tasya aindraṣaṭke gomūtraṃ| tasya yāmyaṣaṭke kṣīraṃ| vāruṇa ṣaṭke dadhi | saumya ṣaṭke gomayarasaḥ | tasya āgneya kumbha catuṣṭaye uṣṇodakaṃ | naiṝta catuṣṭaye pañcāmṛtaṃ | tattu kṣīra dadhi ghṛta madhu śarkarāḥ tasya aiśānakumbha catuṣṭaye saktavaḥ | teṣāṃ devatā nārāyaṇaḥ | divye naiṝte ekonapañcāśat ghaṭāspade madhyanavake tailaṃ | devatā matsyamūrtiḥ | tasya aindraṣaṭke ghanasāradravyaṃ | tasya yāmyāṣaṭke lājaṃ| vāruṇa ṣaṭke mārjanāṃbhaḥ | saumya ṣaṭke ca mārjanadravyāṇi tu rajanī, sūryavartinī, sahadevī, śiriṣa, sadābhadra, kuśāgrāṇi pṛthak muṣṭimātrāṇi | tasya āgneyādīśānāntakoṇacatuṣṭayakumbha catuṣpheṣu ṣoḍaśasu guḍavāri | teṣāṃ devatā vāsudevaḥ| divya mārute ekonapañcāśat ghaṭāspade madhyamanavake sarṣapatailaṃ | tasya aindrāṣaṭke pūrvokta pādya dravyāṇi | tasya yāmyaṣaṭke arghyadravyāṇi pūrvoktāni | vāruṇa ṣaṭke ācamanīya dravyaṃ| saumya ṣaṭke maṅgalodakaṃ indravallyādi| āgneyādīśānāntakoṇa catuṣṭaya kumbha catuṣpheṣu ṣoḍaśasu ikṣurasaḥ| teṣāṃ devatā aniruddhaḥ| divyaiśānaikonapañcāśat ghaṭāspade madhyamanavake madhu | tasya aindrāṣaṭke sarvagandhodakaṃ karpūrakuṅgumādi | tasya yāmyaṣaṭke śāntivāri tulasi,veṇu,nīvārādi| vāruṇa ṣaṭke saumya ṣaṭke ca tathā | āgneya catuṣphe naiṝta catuṣpheṣu vāyavya catuṣpheṣu ca nālikerajalaṃ| tasya aiśānacatuṣphe kṣīraṃ | teṣāṃ devatā hariḥ| mānuṣe pade prācyāṃ kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau madhyama navaka madhyamekumbhe kṣetratīrtha, abdhi, śaila, gaja, sūkara, dantāgra, valmīka, vṛṣaśrṛṅgāgramṛttikāḥ aṣṭau | tatparitaḥ sthite kumbhāṣṭake pracyādīśānāntaṃ pūrvoktāḥ krameṇa ekaikāḥ | navakasya devatā keśavaḥ| śiṣṭaṣoḍaśa śuddhoka kumbheṣu devatā nārāyaṇaḥ| tata aindrāgneyāntarāla pañcaviṃśatau navakamadhyakumbhe sahadevi, vacā, śatamūlā, śatāvarī, kumārī,gaḍūcī, sihmī, vyāghrītyaṣṭau mūlakṣodāḥ| tatparitaḥ sthite kuṃbhā ṣṭake krameṇa sahadevyādimūlikāḥ ekaikāḥ| navakasya devatā nārāyaṇaḥ | śiṣṭeṣu ṣoḍaśaśuddhoda kumbheṣu ca| tatra āgneyapañcāśatau navakamadhyamakumbhe nyagrodha, audumbarā’śvattha, jambu, bilva, palāśa, madhuka, śirīṣāṇāṃ tvacoṣṭau tadrasāḥ | tatparitaḥ sthite kumbhāṣṭake krameṇa nyagrodhāditvagrasāḥ| navakasya devatā mādhavaḥ | śiṣṭaśuddhodakumbhānāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ| āgneyayāmyayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ navaka madhyame kumbhe pālāśa, bilva, vakula, kadaṃba, āmra, śirīṣa, nyagrodhā’śvatthajāḥ pallavāḥ aṣṭauḥ| tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu aṣṭasu kalaśaṣu palāśa pallavādyekaikaṃ pallavaṃ krameṇa| tasya navakasya devatā govindaḥ| śiṣṭaṣoḍaśaśuddhoka kumbhānāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ| yāmye kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakasya madhyame kumbhe jātī, mallikā, priyaṅgu, padma, vakula, nandyāvartaka, campaka, kundajāni aṣṭau puṣpāṇi | tatparitaḥ stithakalaśeṣu aṣṭasu jātyādi puṣpaṃ ekaikaṃ krameṇa| tasya navakasya devatā viṣṇuḥ| śiṣṭānāṃ pūrvavat| yāmyanaiṝtayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navaka madhyamakumbhe siddhārtha rājasiddhārtha vaṃśa,gorocanendraveṇu, ṣāṣṭha, yava, śamī, caṇakāni aṣṭau|tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu kalaśeṣu aṣṭasu siddhārthādyekaikaṃ krameṇa| tasya navakasya devatā madhusūdanaḥ| śiṣṭānāṃ pūrvavat| tatra naiṝte kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakasya madhyame kumbhe grāmyatilā’‘raṇyakatila, jīraka, kṛṣṇajīraka, atasīsaṃbhavacchinna, śatapuṣpa, kuṭhārarṣi bimbāni aṣṭau dravyāṇi| tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu aṣṭasu kalaśeṣu tilādikrameṇa ekaikam| tasya navakasya devatā trivikramaḥ| śiṣṭānāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ| naiṝta vāruṇayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakasya madhyame kumbhe śyāmāka, ṣāṣṭika, śāli, nīvāra, taṇḍula, dūrvā’ṅgura, kuśāṅgura, indravallyaṅgurā’śvatthāṅgurāṇi aṣṭau dravyāṇi| tatparitaḥ sthitakalaśeṣu aṣṭasu śyāmākādyekaikaṃ kramarjī | tasya navakasya devatā vāmanaḥ| śuddhodakānāṃ pūrvavat| tatra vāruṇe kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakasya madhyame kumbhe kuśadivyeṣu kāśa uśīra, śarapuṃkha, tagara, apāmārgamūlāni aṣṭau | tatparitaḥ sthitakumbhāṣṭake kuśādimūladravyaṃ ekaikaṃ krameṇa | tasya navakasya devatā śrīdharaḥ| śuddhokānāṃ pūrvavat| vāruṇavāyavyayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navaka madhyame kumbhe tulasi, kṛṣṇatulasi, veṇu, kesari, ketaka, bilva, śamī, jātīpatrāṇyaṣṭau | tatparitaḥ sthitakalaśāṣṭake tulasyādyekaikaṃ krameṇa| tasya navakasya devatā aṣṭau | tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu aṣṭasu śvetārkādyekaikaṃ krameṇa| tasya navakasya devatā hariḥ | śiṣṭānāṃ pūrvavat| aiśānaindrayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakamadhyame kumbhesurabhi, padma, kesara, patra, elā, lavaṅga tvaṅ, nāgakesara, latā jātīphalānyaṣṭau | tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu aṣṭasu surabhyādyekaikaṃ krameṇa | tasya navakasya devatā kṛṣṇaḥ | śiṣṭānām pūrvavat | aiśāna indrayoḥ antarāle kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatau navakasya madhyame kumbhe suvarṇa, rajata, tāmrāṇi pratyekaṃ pañcaniṣphapramāṇāni padmākṛtīni ca, kāṃsyadarpaṇaṃ caṣakāṇi ca ayolavitrā dyākārāṇi trapusīsaka pittalāni ca pratikṛtirūpeṇa pṛthak pṛthak etāni aṣṭau, tatparitaḥ sthiteṣu aindrādīśānānteṣu kalaśeṣu aṣṭasu suvarṇādyekaikaṃ krameṇa, tasya navakasya devatā hayagrīvaḥ| śiṣṭānāṃ ṣoḍaśaśuddhodakumbhānāṃ devatā nārāyaṇaḥ| evaṃ dravyāṇi vinyasya tattaddevatāśca āvāhya abhyarcayet | etasmin ekottarasahasra kalaśa snapane aṣṭau catvāraḥ vā ācāryāḥ | mūrtipāḥ ṣoḍaśa | puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ vidhivat evaṃ devatāḥ plotavastra uttarīya arghyapādyācamana gandhapuṣpa dhūpadīpārcanayutaṃ snāpayet| mānuṣe aindre pañcaviṃśatimadhyamṛtpūrita kumbhanavakasya saśuddhodakasya ‘viṣṇornukaṃ iti mantraḥ | tatsamīpasthita aṇoraṇīyān, itikrameṇa | divye agnikoṇe ekonapañcāśatghaṭāspade madhyanavakasya aindrādibrahmāntaṃ gomūtrādi ghaṭeṣu gāyatrī, payovratasāma, dadhikrāviṇṇo, gandhadvārāṃ, viṣṇorarāṭamasi, mūrdhānaṃ divaḥ, hiraṇyagarbhaḥ, āpyāyasva, ghṛtasnātā itimantreṇa | divye naiṝte ekona pañcāśatghaṭāspade madhye navakasya aindrādibrahmaparyantaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ, ādyaṃ sāma, pavitraṃ te, bhagavān vāsudevaḥ, ityādi catasraḥ ṛcaḥ kramāt| divye aiśāne, ekonapañcāśatghaṭāspade madhye navakasya aindrādi brahmāntaṃ ānonuyudbhiḥ, śrīsūktam, madhumānnaḥ, madhunaktam, madhuvātā, iti mantreṇa | brāhme pade indrādīśānānta navakānāṃ madhyamadravya kumbhānāṃ aṣṭasu puruṣasūktasya dve dve ṛcau āditaḥ kramāt | śiṣṭānāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭi śuddhodakumbhānāṃ mūlamantreṇa, madhyasthanavaka madhyamakumbhasya pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśāhutīśca puruṣasūktena juhuyāt | vastrābharaṇa jīvājīva dhanādibhiḥ deśikānāṃ yāvatkalaśasaṃkhyayā dakṣiṇā | tadardhaṃ ṛtvijāṃ, tadardhaṃparicārāṇāṃ anyeṣāṃ ca deyā || iti śrī | garuḍamantreṇa ca | yadvā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu tattaddevatāmantraiḥ vā samidbhiḥ ājyaiśca caruṇā puruṣasūktena ca ekasmin kuṇḍe tu ‘oṃ namo bhagavate vainateyāya namaḥ’ iti āvāhya | garuḍamantreṇa ca gehamaṇḍapaprāsāda gopuravīthikāḥ toraṇa dhvaja vitāna kadalīkramuka pūrṇakumbha sāṅkurapālikā śatadīpāgarudhūpādibhiḥ alaṅkāraiḥ alaṅkṛtya| prathamāvaraṇe dvitīyāvaraṇe diśāṃ antarāleṣu sarvāsu dikṣu avakāśānuguṇaṃ saptahastāyataṃ pañcahastāyataṃ vā vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ caturdvāra samanvitaṃ yāgamaṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvā| tasyaparitaḥ prapāṃ kalpayitvā| tryaṃśe tasya madhye hasta samucchritāṃ dvihastena trihastena vā vistīrṇāṃ vediṃ kārayitvā| tasyāḥ prācyāṃ āhavanīyasya agneḥ caturaśraṃ kuṇḍaṃ, dakṣiṇasyāṃ dakṣiṇāgneḥ cāpa samākṛtiṃ, pratīcyāṃ gārhapatyasya vṛttaṃ, kauberyāṃ diśi sabhyasya trikoṇaṃ, āvasakthyasya caturaśraṃ, kuṇḍaṃ yadvā’‘vasakthyarahitaṃ yadvā ekamāhavanīyaṃ vā kuṇḍaṃ kalpayitvā| pūrvavat toraṇa sruksruva aṣṭamaṅgala vividha homapātrāsanādīni anyāni yāgopakaraṇāni kārayitvā| yāgamaṇḍapaṃ vitānadarbhamālā toraṇa puṣpamālā dūpadīpākṣata raṃbhāstambhādi pariṣphāraiḥ bhūṣayitvā| pūrvaṃ caturṇāṃ ācāryāṇāṃ varaṇaṃ, tataḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ,tadanuparicārakāṇāṃ ca kṛtvā|yajamānaḥ yathāvidhi adhivāsahomaṃ kṛtvā| tūryaghoṣaiḥ vedaghoṣaiḥ saha devaṃ stotraiḥ stutvā| guruḥ samāhitacittaḥ san jāgareṇa niśāṃ nītvā| tataḥ prabhāte sumuhūrte guruḥ ‘uttiṣṭha’ iti mantreṇa devaṃ me prasīda oṃ| iti vijñāpya| dikṣubrāhmaṇeṣu śākunasūktaṃ paṭhatsu devaṃ’‘ idaṃ viṣṇuḥ” iti mantreṇa śibikādikaṃ yānaṃ āropya| yānaṃ vahatsu bhūsureṣugaruḍaṃ āvāhya| sarvālaṅkāra sarvopacāra sahitaṃ devaṃ sarvāvaraṇabhūmikāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā| yānāt avaropya| maṇḍape sauvarṇaṃ bhadrāsane viniveśya| sarvamutsavārthaṃ āhṛtaṃ prābhṛtadravyaṃ janasaṃsadi ‘‘itoyātaṃ idaṃ sarvaṃ itoyātaṃ” iti bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa kariṣye kautukakriyām| mahotsavārthaṃ deveśa tadarthaṃ tvaṃ prasīda me| iti vijñāpya| mūlotsava snāna balibimba cakrāṇāṃ yathāvidhi utsavapratisaraṃ badhvā| tadanu vedikāyāṃ pratyahaṃ yāvattīrthadināvadhi sāyaṃ prātaḥ hunet| ekāgnau vā homadravyaṃ traye catuṣṭaye vā agnau hunet| tāvatā ca agniṃ samyak rakṣet| balidānaṃ tu prathamaṃ yāgamaṇṭape kartavyam| tatprakārastu cakra balibimbā’nnamūrti sahitaṃ yāgamaṇḍapāt niṣkramya| taddvāreṣu purataḥ kumudādīnāṃ śucau bhūmau āvāhya abhyarcya| baliṃ datvā| balidravyapātra ghaṇṭā puṣpabājana toya karaka dhūpa dīpapātra dīpikādhārakeṣu agre gacchatsu tadanu annamūrtiḥ, tataḥ cakraṃ, tadanu nityotsavārcāṃ ca ityevaṃ kṛtvā| vitānachatrādi samanvitaṃ dvāreṣu caṇḍādīnāṃ āvaraṇeṣu tattaddevatānāṃ toyapūrvottaraṃ baliṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ balidravyaṃ sarvān pārṣadān uddiśya baliṃ datvā| baliṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ālayaṃ praviśet| evaṃ dhvajārohaṇāditīrthāntaṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ baliṃ dadyāt| āraṃbhadivase rātrau samāptidivase ahani balimekamekāṃ madhyadivaseṣu ahni rātrau ca balidvayaṃ kuryat| tīrthadivase grahaṇāyana viṣuvādiṣu prāpteṣu tasmin balidvayaṃ kuryāt| grāmādi rahite sthānamadhye mahāpīṭhasya purataḥ brahmaṇe baliṃ vitaret| balidravyāṇi tu prathamehani phalalarajanīcūrṇa karaṃbha lājān caruṇā samyojya| dvitīye ahani caruṇā tilataṇḍulena saṃyojya| tṛtīye tu lāja dhānyāpūpikāḥ caruṇā saṃyojya| caturthe caruṇā saktuśālipiṣṭa nālikera jalāni saṃyojya| pañcame padmabīja pāyasa śālitaṇḍulaṃ caruṇā saṃyojya| ṣaṣṭe tu apūpaṃ caruṇā saṃyojya| saptamādiṣu triṣu divaseṣu caturvidhamannaṃ apūpaiḥ saktubhiḥ saṃyojya| kramāt baliṃ dadyāt| tadanu sumuhūrte prāpte guruḥ śayanasthaṃ utsavakautukaṃ ‘uttiṣṭhe’ti mantreṇa utthāpya|svastisūktaṃ paṭhadbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saptabhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tasmātmandirāt nirgamya| rathantarasāma uccārya| syandanena gajena vā anyena vā yānena maṇḍapāntaraṃ nītvā| ‘bhadraṃ karṇe’ti taddinavihitaṃ yānamāropya| tatra devam nyāsapūrvakaṃ abhyarcya| pṛthukādikaṃ nivedya| svalaṅkṛtaiḥ brāhmaṇaiśca purataḥ yānārūḍhena sāñjalinā dhvajārūḍhena tārkṣyeṇa pṛṣṭhataśca kanakaśibikāṃ ārūḍhena vetrahastena viriñcādīn samutsārayatā praṇamatā viṣvaksenena ca kanakapātre pāduke samāropya| purataḥ dhārayadbhiḥ vipraiśca rājacihnai anyaiḥ sakalavedaśāstrāgamajñaiḥ parasparajigīṣubhiḥ vādanipuṇaiḥ vipraiḥ gadyapadya miśrāṇi stotrāni paṭhadbhiḥ vandibhiśca nṛtyatā gāyatāgāṇikyena ca anyaiḥ tattadvidyāviśāradaiśca sākaṃ ānaddha, tata, suṣira, dhanādi caturvidha vādyaghoṣaiḥ ca āvaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ parikramya| bahiḥ tathā vīthikāśca pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya| praveśasamayepi prākāravalayaṃ prādakṣiṇyena gatvā| maṇḍapālayaṃ antaḥ praveśya| tatra yānāt āsane devaṃ avaropya| baliberaṃmandire cakraṃ yāgasadane bahisthite balipīṭhe ca annarmūīṃta niveśya|dhruvaberaṃ nityaiḥ dviguṇaiḥ vastubhiḥ arcayet pratyahaṃ devasya vīthikāparyaṭanānantaraṃ yathāvidhi snapanakarma kuryāt| ekabera vidhāne tu mūlabiṃbe, bahubere tu utsavakautukaṃ vā snapanakautukaṃ vā yathāśakti yathāvastu snapanaṃ kuryāt| maṇḍape siṃhaviṣṭare devaṃ niveśya| dehaśuddhipurassaraṃ arcayitvā| snapanakarmasamāpya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya| maṇḍanālayaṃ āsādya| devaṃ bhūṣaṇādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya| bimbe tatra sthite deśikaḥ yāgamaṇḍapaṃ prāpya| dvāratoraṇa kumbhamahākubha upakumbha maṇḍalārādhanaṃ kṛtvā| yathoditaṃ nivedya| pūrvavat hutvā| yathāvidhipūrvavat balyarcādi bimbayutaṃ balikarmakṛtvā| tadanu utsavārcāṃ alaṅkṛtya, yānaṃ āropya| pūrvavat sarvālaṅkārasahitaṃ grāmadhāmādi prādakṣiṇyena nītvā| tatra sthāne sthāne samāhṛta tāṃbūla,vīṭikāḥ, pṛthukādīni, bhakṣyāṇi, nālikeraphalāni, pānīyācamanādīni yathāvidhi akhilaṃ naivedyaṃ ca astramantreṇa adbhiḥprokṣya nivedayet| pakvaṃ phalaṃ tūṣṇīṃ pradarśayet puṣpābharaṇādikaṃ pathi samāgataṃ sarvamantreṇa prokṣya devāṅge niyojayet| evaṃ grāmaṃ dhāmaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā| dhāmaṃpraveśya| devaṃ yānāt śibikāṃ āropya| maṇḍapaṃ praveśya,tatra pūrvavat sarvopacārasahitaṃ arcayet| evaṃ apūrvābharaṇa,mālāmbara,yānodyānādyaiḥ tīrthadināvadhi pratidinaṃ yathākautūhalaṃ tathā devaṃ toṣayet| grāmādau nityaṃ devasya śrībhūmibhyāṃ saha vinā vā mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| ṣaṣṭe ahani snānabimbasahitaṃ yātrākautukaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ āropya| tasya purataḥ dhānyarāśau kumbhān saṃsthāpya, saṃpūjya| devaṃ mantrāsanādi snānāsanāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| kalaśaiḥ saṃsnāpya| vastrādidīpāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya| ekaberaviṣaye mūlabere sarvamevaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu kṣālitaṃ ulūkhalaṃ vastrādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya| taṇḍulapīṭhe saṃsthapya| śrīsūktena lakṣmīṃ dhyāyan mantritaṃ arcitaṃ kṛtvā| mūlamantreṇa musalaṃ prakṣālya| abhimantya| mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ guruḥ ulūkhale niśācūrṇaṃ nikṣipya| musalaṃ ādāya devadāsīṣu maṅgalaṃ paṭhatsu niśācūrṇaṃ yathāsūkṣmataraṃ bhavettathā musalena kṛtvā| tadādāya| veṣṭitavāsasi kumbhe nikṣipya| sakūrcamallaka vastraṃ kumbhaṃ sthaṇḍilapīṭhe saṃsthāpya| mūlamantreṇa gandhādibhiḥabhyarcya| kumbhaṃ uddhṛtya| taiḥ cūrṇaiḥ śrīsūktena devamabhiṣicya| mūrtipaiḥ saha guruḥ devaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā| aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya| puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīrya| stotraiḥ stutvā| sarvālaṅkārayutaṃ utsavaṃ kuryāt| saptame divase rathaṃ puṇyāhajalena prokṣya| śikhare brahmāṇaṃ, ayane haṃsaṃ, dvitīyatale anantaṃ, upakaṃṇṭhe vāsudevaṃ,prathamatale takṣakaṃ, mahāpīṭhe garuḍaṃ, madhyapīṭhe indrādīn ca,cakreṣu vāyuṃ, rathe vainateyaṃ ca āvāhya abhyarcya| haviḥ nivedya| indrādikumudādibhyaḥ baliṃ datvā| devaṃ rathaṃ āropya| pūrvavat utsavaṃ kuryāt| tadanu devasya prātaḥ utsavaṃ kṛtvā| aparāhne devasya jaladroṇyāṃ avagāhanaṃ kuryāt|jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā sarasi sopānadeśe sauvarṇaṃ dhānyarāśau nidhāya| gandhodakena āpūrya| paritaḥ akṣatāni vikīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| paristīrya, tajjalaṃ śoṣaṇādīni kṛtvā| tatragaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya| jalaṃ abliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ abhimantya| devaṃ prārthayet| bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala| asminnahani kartavyā jalakrīḍā tvayā vibho| śuddhaye sarvalokānāṃ devānāṃ prītaye vibho| yātrā tadarthaṃ kartavyā madanugrahakāmyayā| iti vijñāpya| devaṃ praṇamya| mantrāsanādisnānāṃtaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| vādyaghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu vāruṇasūktādyabliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ tatra devaṃ avagāhya| tadanu yānaṃ āropya anyaṃ maṇṭapaṃ ānīya| tatrāpi devaṃ havirantaṃ abhyarcayet| yadvā aṣṭame ahani vā prātarutsavaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu mṛgayākarma,tadanu jaladroṇyavagāhanaṃ vā kuryāt| tasmin dine devaṃ mṛgayānuguṇāyudhālaṅkāra sannāhaiḥ saha gaje vā kṛtrimāśve vā āropya| devībhyāṃ saha vinā vā hastyādibhiḥ sainyaiḥ saha grāmasīmādīn prādakṣiṇyena nītvā| devaṃ udyānamaṇḍapaṃ prāpayya| tatra madhye sauvarṇaviṣṭare viniveśya| snānapūrvaṃ abhyarcya| anyasmin āsane viniveśya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya|yānaṃ āropya| tadrātrau mandirāntarbhuvaṃ nītvā| tadanu nityotsavaṃ kṛtvā| apararātribhāge tīrthārthaṃ aṅkurārpaṇaṃ kariṣye, iti saṅkalpya| arāvāpanaṃ yathā vidhi kṛtvā|devaṃ saṃpūjya| imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| tīrthayātrā tvayā deva śvaḥ kartavyā sureśvara| tatra pratisarāraṃbhaṃ tvamanujñātumarhasi| iti vijñāpya| mūlāt tīrthabimbe samāvāhya| tīrthabimbe pratisaraṃ tadabhāve nityotsavabimbe tasyāpi abhāve snānārcāyāṃ, tadabhāve ca utsavabimbe vā baddhvā| dhānyarāśau pūrvavat yathāvidhi adhivāsya| tataḥ prātaḥ utsavaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu śāyitaṃ biṃbamutthāpya,snānamaṇḍape snānapīṭhikāyāṃ taṃ niveśya| yāgamaṇḍapa bhūmiṣu sthāpitān kumbhān ādāya| dhāmaprādakṣiṇyena vedaghoṣaiḥ saha nītvā| tīrthabimbasya sannidhau dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya| devaṃ mantrāsanapūrvakaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya| tadanu sumuhūrte guruḥ sthāpitaiḥ kumbhaiḥ mūlamantreṇa pūrvādi madhyakumbhāntaiḥ vedaghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu abhiṣicya| vastrādi dīpāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| ekaberavidhāne tu sarvaṃ etat mūlabiṃbe kṛtvā| tadanu pūrvavat devasya cūrṇasnānaṃ yathāvidhi kṛtvā| devaṃ stutvā| pradakṣiṇīkṛtya| aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīrya| tadanu kalyāṇakautukaṃ yānaṃ āropya| tīrthabiṃbapurassaraṃ cakreṇa saha chatradhvajacāmara dīpavādyaghoṣa sahitaṃ samudraṃ nadīṃ taṭākaṃ vā prāpayya| tatra tīre prapāyāṃ viṣṭare viniveśya| agrataḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ, saptadaśa, yadvā kalaśān nava yathāvidhi tattaddravyayutān saṃsthāpya| saṃpūjya|nadyādijalānāṃ śoṣaṇādikṛtvā| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya| tatra gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya nivedya| tīrthabimbaṃ mantrāsanapūrvakaṃ saṃpūjya|kalaśaḥ yathāvidhi saṃsnāpya| cakraṃ śiṣṭavāriṇā ca, tīrthabiṃbaṃ samānītaṃ kalyāṇakautukaṃ kūrcena nadyādijalena prokṣya| kalyāṇakautukasannidhau tadbiṃbaṃ guruḥ śirasi kṛtvā| cakraṃ vā tadabhāve kūrcaṃ vā tathā kṛtvā| cakramantraṃ uccaran jale nimajjet| tataḥ guruḥ tadānīmeva biṃbānāṃ svasya ca rakṣāsūtrāṇi visṛjya| jale kṣiptvā| tadanu maṇḍape devaṃ ānīya yathāpuraṃ pūjayitvā yānaṃ āropya, ālayābhyantaraṃ prāpayet| tadrātrau devaṃ maṇḍape nītvā yathāvidhi abhyarcya, prabhūtaṃ nivedya| bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgata vatsala| dhvajārthāṅkuramārabhya utsavā’vabhṛtāntimam| yanmayānuṣṭitaṃ karma tava suprītaye vibho| tathānyaiḥ madanujñātaiḥ deśikaiścāpi yatkṛtam| sādhakaiśca tathānyaiśca vividhaiḥ paricārakaiḥ| tattatsaṃpūraṇārthaṃ ca nyūnādhikyopaśāntaye| tvāmadyavāsare yaṣṭuṃ catusthāna sthitaṃ vibho| pravṛttamanujānīhi madanugrahakāṃyayā| iti deveśaṃ vijñāpya| tadanujñāṃ avāpya tataḥ prabhāte bhaktaiḥ bhāgavataiḥ sevite maṇḍapāntare kecidbhūtale cakrābjaṃ āvaraṇānvitaṃ uktavartmanā saṃkalpya| tulasyādibhiḥ nānāvarṇaiḥ prasūnaiḥ yathāvidhi citrayitvā| tatra madhyataḥ saprabhaṃ bhadrapīṭhe nidhāya| tasmin kalyāṇakautukaṃ āropya| arghyādibhiḥabhyarcya, sarvataḥdikṣu vedaghoṣeṣuvādyaghoṣeṣu ca pravartiteṣu dvādaśākṣareṇa bhagavantaṃ arcayet| oṃ dvādaśākṣara mantrasya| parameṣṭhi, sananta, sanaka, prajāpati, bhṛgu, sanatkumāra, pulastya, pulaha, kratu, marīci, atri, āṅgīrasaṛṣayaḥ| gāyatrī, bastakṣetra, prajāpati, triṣṭup, paṅkti, bṛhati, virāḍ, baṣṭha, trivatsaka, uṣṇik, śriyaścaṃdaॉṃsi| viṣṇvādi govindāntā dvādaśa devatāḥ| cit,jīva, prakṛti, buddhi, mana,ssātvika, rājasa, tāmasa, vyomā, ‘gni, marutā,’‘pastatvāni| paramavyoma, vāyva,’gni,jala, satya, tapo, jana, maha,ssvarga, bhuva,rbhūmi,pātālāni kṣetrāṇi|sita, kṛṣṇa, dhūmra,śyāma,tāmra, sphaṭika, śaṃkha, rakta, śukla, lohita, tamaḥ, pītavarṇāḥ|dvādaśasu akṣareṣu ekaikaṃ,hariṃ dhyātvā| arghyādi bhūṣāntaiḥ navabhiḥ upacāraiḥ kalyāṇakautukaṃ abhyarcya|puṣpairapi hṛdayādyaṅgāni uddiśya ca puṣpaiḥ’phalaṃ bhavatu me puṣpaiḥ namaḥ iti avasānakaṃ ca, tataḥ śrīvatsa kaustubhādi bhūṣaṇāni uddiśya divyāyudhāni cakrādīni ca yathākramam āvaraṇasthānāṃ devatānāṃ ca, viṣṇvādimūrti daśakaṃ, keśavādi mūrtīśca uddiśya tattanmantraiśca, puruṣasūkta, nārāyaṇānuvākaiḥ,viṣṇusūktaiśca, pañcopaniṣanmantraiśca, pādayoḥpuṣpasamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā| sitādibhiḥ puṣpaiḥ evaṃ devaṃ toṣayitvā| caturvidhamannaṃ nivedya| maṇḍape tatra āgneye agniṃ upasamidhya| samidājyacarubhiḥ pāyasādi caturvidhānnaiśca, mūlamantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatavārān hutvā| tataḥ devaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| stutvā,bhūtale daṇḍavat praṇamya| kalyāṇakautukaṃ yānaṃ āropya| prathamāvaraṇaṃ prāpayya| tatra sthitvā,sevārthaṃ āgatān brahmādidevān, bhaktān, bhāgavatān anyān vaiṣṇavān ca svaṃ svaṃ ālayaṃ gantuṃ niyujya| tadāvaraṇaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya| mandirābhyantaraṃ nītvā| tasya divasasya niśi prathamayāme maṇḍape snānāsane devaṃ niveśya| utsavāntocitaṃ snapanaṃ yathāvidhi kṛtvā| maṇḍapāntaraṃ nītvā| guruḥ yāgamaṇḍapaṃ āsādya| tatra yathāvidhi homaṃ kṛtvā| śāntihomaṃ ca pūrvokta vidhānena prāyaścittārthaṃ pañcopaniṣaṇmantreṇa ājyena sahasraṃ,śataṃ vā āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ ca agniṃ visṛjya| tatra toraṇādiṣu devān maṇḍalasthaṃ ca udvāsya| dhvajastambhaṃ āsādya| khagādhipaṃ pūjayitvā| pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā| saṃhārakrameṇa kumbhe samāvāhya| tanmūlabhere niyojya| kalyāṇakautukasya sannidhāveva mahāniśi dhvajaṃ avaropya| stambhaṃ dhvajaṃ ca guruḥ svayaṃ gṛhītvā| tadanu tatra tatra āvāhitān devān api sthāne sthāne sakṛt sakṛt tūryaghoṣaiḥ saha mūkaiḥ parikaraiḥ sārdhaṃ baliṃ datvā| svasva nāmamantraiḥ udvāsya|guruḥ aṣṭākṣaraṃ japan devasya dhāmapraviśya| devaṃ vijñāpya| śakaṭādikaṃ yānaṃ āropya| makhakautukaṃ dhāmāntaḥ prāpayya saṃpūjya|tacchaktiṃ mūlabiṃbe niyojya| mūlabiṃbaṃ saṃpūjya|stutvā praṇipatya, prārthya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā | svagṛhaṃ praviśet| yajamanopi guruṃ jīvajīvātmakaiḥ dhanaiḥ yathāmanastuṣṭiṃ tathā toṣayitvā| tathaiva anyān mūrtipān paricārakān ca , guruṃ praṇamya| taṃ yānaṃ āropya| sarvālaṅkāraiḥ saha grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā|tadgṛhaṃ prāpayet| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ mahotsavavidhiḥ nāma catustriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |

pañcatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | jīrṇoddhāra vidhiḥ | atha jīrṇoddhāra vidhiḥ ucyate| svāyaṃbhuvārṣadivyamānuṣeṣu caturṣvapi ratnajeṣu aṅgahāniḥ yadi tattadaṅgaṃ punastapanīyaiḥ samādhātavyameva| na tyāgo yujyate| śailajeṣvapi tadvadeva| dārvādiṣu pañcasu hīnāṅgeṣu tāni santyajya punassṛjet|sarvātmanā sṛṣṭau aṅgamātrasamādhāne ca tacchaktiṃ kumbhe samāvāhya| yathāpuraṃ nirmāya jalādhivāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmiva kārayet| sthityāsanaśayanārūḍheṣu biṃbeṣu samādhiḥ śakyate yadi teṣāṃ tyāgaḥ na yujyate| lohajaṃ biṃbaṃtyaktaṃ drāvayitvā punaḥ sṛjet| devī jīrṇe punassṛṣṭau devyo yathāvat sthitāścet devastābhireva yojyaḥ| na anyāḥ punaḥ sṛjet|tāsu pūjane santate punaḥ udvāhaśca na kāryaḥ| prabhāpadmāsana āyudhādīnāṃ vaikalye calane vāpi asamāhita pratimāśaktiṃ mūlabiṃbe ghaṭe vā udvāsya, tāni yathāpuraṃ samādhāya yathāvidhi saṃprokṣya tāṃ śaktiṃ punaḥ bimbe samāvāhya punaḥ pūjayet|bālagehaṃ nirmāya tatra śailādiṣu jīrṇebhyaḥ śaktiṃ āvāhya pūjayet| samādhānā’nantaraṃ tataḥ punaḥ āvāhya pūjayet| tatrāpi sandhāna yogyaṃ sandheyaṃ, ayogyaṃ tu kṣitau aṃbhasi vā nikṣipet| prāsādhe śithile svaiḥ parivāraiḥ upetaṃ devaṃ bālaveśmani yathāpuraṃ pūjayet| ajīrṇe dhruvabimbe dhāmani jīrṇe sati tatsthitān devān devaparivārān mūlabimbe niveśayet| ajīrṇe dhāmani jīrṇedhruvabimbe tanniṣṭhadevatānāṃ udvāsaḥ na anyatra kartavyaḥ| ajīrṇe vā aṅga bhaṅgādi rahite dhāmādau sati na punaḥ kalpanaṃ kāryam| yadi kalpayet ātmahāniḥ bhavati| purā prāsādāt pramāṇarahita kalpitaṃ prāsādādi punaḥ kalpane lakṣaṇānvitaṃ kuryāt| bahuberaikabereṣu yathāpurameva kalpayet viparītakaraṇe mahān doṣo bhavati| bahuberaṃ pūrvaṃ devībhyāṃ rahitaṃ yadi, bhūyaḥ kalpane tābhyāṃ saha vinā vā kuryāt| amānuṣe tu biṃbādikaṃ pūrvaṃ lakṣaṇa varjitaṃ yadi jīrṇoddhārepi tathaiva, na tadanyathā| amānuṣe tu bimbānāṃ āsana śayana yānāni punaḥ uddhāre yathāpurameva|mānuṣe tu teṣāṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭau yathecchākaraṇaṃ na doṣāya| divyaṃ vimānaṃ purā yadvastu yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭau tādṛgeva, na anyathā| ārṣaṃ mānuṣaṃ sadanaṃ aiṣṭakaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā jīrṇaṃ punaḥ kalpane śailena iṣṭakayā vā kāryaṃ| klṛptānāṃ upapīṭhādīnāṃ rakṣārthaṃ bahiḥ vardhane na doṣaḥ| sālagopurapīṭhādau calite jīrṇepi śilābhiḥ dṛḍhaṃ vistīrṇaṃ anyathā vā kuryāt|nadyādi jalavegena prāsādādi nirbādheanyatra sthāne punaḥ kalpayet| prathamakalpane mūrtimantrādhikāriṇaḥ yādṛgvidhāḥ tathaiva dvitīya kalpane ca| na anyathā| dhāmādīnāṃ pūrvakalpane jīrṇoddhāre ca phalaṃ tulyameva| tatra mūrtivyatyayaṃ na kuryāt| bahuberāvayavamātrajīrṇoddhāre tu pratiṣṭhāyāmiva karmārcāṃ vedyāṃ saṃsthāpya śayyāyāṃ śāyayitvā| jalādhivāsa nayanonmīlana tatvasaṃhārotpādanāni vinā sarvakarmāṇi kuryāt| atha bālālaya pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate ācāryaḥ yajamānena saha vaiṣṇavān sakalaśāstravedāgama purāṇajñān brāhmaṇānapi svayaṃ āhūya, praṇipatya, prārthayan etān bhojayitvā| svarṇābharaṇavastragandhatāṃbūlādyaiḥ upacarya| tān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya| praṇamya, kṛtāñjaliḥsan vāsudevaṃ dhyātvā ca itthaṃ vijñāpayet| pūjābiṃbamidaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpitaṃ pūrva sūribhiḥ| pūjyamāne’ṅga vaikalya dūṣaṇaṃ cehavartate| asya jīrṇasya bimbasya coddhāraṃ kartumudyame| āgamasyavaśāt kartuṃ vyavasāyamupāsmahe| yathaiva devapūjāyāṃ viniyuktaṃ aninditam| gandhapuṣpādikaṃ paścāt nirmālyaṃ iti nindyate tathaiva jīrṇitaṃ biṃbaṃ pūjāyāmupayujyate| paścāttajjīrṇitaṃ bimbaṃ nirmālyamitinindyate| asya biṃbasyacoddhāraṃ kartumicchāmi saṃprati| bhavanto naḥ anujānantu bhavadājñāṃ karomyaham| iti vijñāpya| taiḥ anujñātaḥ san prāsādāgre dūrvābhiḥ madhuyuktābhiḥ āhutīnāṃ lakṣaṃ sahasraṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā vyāhṛtībhiḥ hutvā| pañcopaniṣanmantraiḥ śāntihomaṃ vidhāya| brāhmaṇaiḥ saha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā śāntiṃ ca, ātmasamarpaṇapūrvakaṃ guruṃ namaskṛtya| dakṣiṇāṃ datvā| lohajaṃ dārujaṃ vā biṃbaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇopetaṃ kalpayitvā| jalādhivāsādīni karmāṇimaṇḍape kṛtvā| pūrvoktapradeśe iṣṭakayā dāruṇā mṛdā vā vimānānuguṇyena ekahasta samucchrāyavatīṃ karṇikādalayutāṃ vedikāṃ āpādya| tadupari bālabimbaṃ saṃsthāpya apare’hani pratiṣṭhāpya| tatpare’hani rātrau mūlagehaṃ praviśya| snapanādibhiḥ yathākramaṃ saṃpūjya| rakṣābandhanaṃ kṛtvā| prāsādasya catasṛṣu dikṣu pūrvavat śāntihomaṃ ca vidhāya karmārcāyāḥ purataḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| lohajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā mahākumbhaṃ, tatparitaḥ kalaśāṣṭakaṃ ca vinyasya| tān sasūtravastrāpidhānakūrcān saniṣphapramāṇa dalāṣṭakayuta svarṇapadmān kṛtvā| mahākuṃbhe mūlamantreṇa mūlarmūīṃta kalaśeṣvapi indrādīn āvāhya abhyarcya| kumbhasyottaredeśe guruḥ śayīta| tadanu prabhāte snātvā ācāryaḥ bālagehaṃ samāsādya, pūjayitvā| pralayodayamārgeṇa śodhayitvā| yogapīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya ca| imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet kiyantaṃ kālametasmin kalpagehe janārdana| nivāsaṃ kuru deveśa kalpite bālamandire| adyaprabhṛti deveśa dvādaśābdāvadhi prabho| tvadanyān keśavādīn ca vāsudevonumanyate| iti prahṛṣṭena manasā devaṃ praṇamya|baddhāñjalipuṭaḥ bhūtvā imāṃ udīrayet| bhagavan devadeveśa śaṅkhacakra gadādhara| nīcālayamahaṃkartuṃ bimbaṃ cāpimanoharam| vāñchāmi tava deveśa tadanujñātumarhasi| evaṃ sayajamānaḥ ācāryaḥ prārthayan manasā śanaiḥ kāle vijñāpya| mahākumbhe pañcamantreṇa āvāhya| praṇavena viniṣkramya| prāsādaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya|bālagehaṃ ca| tasya agrataḥ mahākumbhaṃ nidhāya| brāhmaṇānāṃ anujñayā kālaṃ vijñāpya| pañcopaniṣanmantreṇa mahākumbhajalena bimbaṃ saṃsicya| tataḥ devaṃ praṇamya| saṃpūjya| prāsādakoṇeṣu baliṃ datvā,bimbaṃ alaṃkṛtya,puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| sṛṣṭi saṃhāranyāsaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya| brāhmaṇeṣu vaidikatāntrikān mantrān japatsu, soṣṇīṣaḥ alaṅkṛtaḥ guruḥ haimaṃ lāṅgalaṃ ādāya| mūlamantreṇa pīṭhabandhanaṃ mocayitvā| viṣvaksenaṃ dhyāyan bimbaṃ gehaṃ vā nirmālyavat smṛtvā| vastraiḥ ācchādya, vyāhṛtyā rajjvā baddhvā samuddhṛtya vādyaghoṣaiḥ saha ācāryaḥ kṣitau aṃbhasi vā nikṣipya| vidhivat snātvā prāsādaṃ praviśya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| samantataḥ baliṃ ca datvā| gehasthān devān udvāsya,tatra gāḥ vāsayitvā| khātvā, uddhṛtya vālukābhiḥ sampūrya| prāsādāgre rakṣāhomaṃ kṛtvā| ṛcaṃ paścimāyāṃ uttarasyāṃ sāma prācyāṃ ca yajuratharvaṇaṃ,dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi brāhmaṇān pāṭhayitvāca| evaṃ śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā| caturthe’hani bālabimbasya prāsādādeḥ vā snapanaṃ kṛtvā, tadante puṣpayāgāvasānikaṃ utsavaṃ kuryāt| yajamānaḥ gurave yathāvidhi dakṣiṇāṃ datvā| mūlagehaṃ bimbaṃ vā yathāvidhi samāpya| pratiṣṭhāṃ ca yathā vidhi kuryāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ jīrṇoddhāravidhiḥ nāma pañcatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
