ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | saṃprokṣaṇa vidhiḥ | saṃprokṣaṇa vidhiḥ ucyate | prāsādaṃ cāṅgabhaṅgādi sandhāne nūtane śubhe| pratimāyāṃ ca pīṭhe ca prabhāyāṃ cāyudheṣu ca| ārādhane ca vicchinne bhūgupte kamalāsana| rodane svedane caiva kaṃpane patanepi ca| valmīkādisamutpattau varṣavātādi dūṣite kuṇḍagolaka saṃsparśe vedavikrayakārakaiḥ| sparśane pratilomādyaiḥ nityāśauca vigarhitaiḥ| pratilomā’nulomādyaiḥ sūtaiśca rathakārakaiḥ| vaikhānasaiśca saṃspṛṣṭe bhārgavāgamapūjakaiḥ| śaivādibhiśca pāṣaṇḍaiḥbrahmahatyādi dūṣitaiḥ| kṣayyapasmārikuṣṭādyaiḥ kṛcchribhiḥ mūlarogibhiḥ| udakyādibhiranyaiśca śilpibhiḥ sparśadūṣite| viṇmūtrarudhiropeyasparśa duṣṭe ca mandire janane maraṇe caiva śvasṛgālakharādibhiḥ| spṛṣṭe ca bimbe tantrāṇāṃ saṅkare samupasthite evamādiṣu cānyeṣu saṃprokṣaṇa vidhiḥ bhavet| dhāmādikamasaṃprokṣya pratimādikamāpyatha| arcane rāṣṭramadhipaḥ prajāśca sadanaṃ hareḥ| śūnyaṃ syādiriṇaprāyaṃ upadravasamākulam| durbhikṣavyādhikalahamṛtiprāyāssyu rītayaḥ| tasmāt saṃprokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dhāmādīnāṃ yathāvidhi| ācāryaḥ tadarthaṃ mṛtsaṃgrahaṇapūrvakaṃ aṅkurārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā|parehni bimba prāsāda pīṭhāni svacchodakaiḥ śodhayitvā| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | ‘viṣṇornukaṃ ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ iti dvābhyāṃ abliṅgaiḥ mantraiśca saṃkṣālya| uttamādiṣu snapaneṣu yathāvidhi ekatareṇa puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ saṃsnāpya| yāgamaṇḍapaṃ alaṅkṛtya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā dvāratoraṇa kumbhādīn abhyarcya| maṇḍapamadhye vedikāṃ kṛtvā| viṃśatibhāraiḥ vrīhibhiḥtadardhena taṇḍulena tadardhena tilena antarāntarā vastrācchādanasahitaṃ pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā | tanmadhye padmaṃ ālikhya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|tatra mahākumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya| sūtravastrādiyutaṃ kṛtvā| pratimāṃ ekaniṣpha pramāṇasvarṇena ca navaratnāni ca nikṣipya| astramantreṇa pidhāya| taddakṣiṇataḥ karakaṃ ca tathāsaṃsthāpya|tatparitaḥ kumbhāṣṭakaṃ ca taduttare yathāvidhi maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā| tasmin maṇḍale vyāghracarmādi upakaraṇādibhiḥ pūrvavat śayyāṃ kṛtvā vitānādyairalaṅkṛtya|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| tatra deveśaṃ śāyayitvā|kumbhe paramātmānaṃ, karake sudarśanaṃ ca, upakumbhāṣṭake viṣṇvādīn ca āvāhya| abhyarcya| naivedyāntaṃ saṃpūjya| kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vā agniṃ upasamidhya | yathāvidhi samidājya carubhiḥ mūlena ca tattanmantraiḥ mūrtihomaṃ ca kṛtvā | puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ rakṣābandhanaṃ ca vidhāya |tataḥ prabhāte śāyitaṃ bimbaṃ utthāpya | sthāpitakumbhān ādāya|mūrtipaiḥ sākaṃ savedavādyaghoṣaṃ dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya| devasyapurataḥ dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| kūrcena kumbhatoyaṃ ādāya| mūlamantreṇa, pañcopaniṣadā, abliṅgaiḥ,itaraiḥśāṃtimantraiśca devaṃ saṃprokṣya|arghyādimahāhaviḥ naivedyāntaṃ yathāvidhi pūjayet| yajamānaḥ ācāryamūrtipa paricārakāṇāṃ yathārha dakṣiṇāṃ datvā,brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā,tebhyepi dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ saṃprokṣaṇa vidhiḥnāma ṣaṭ triṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
<37 >
saptatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ | pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ | atha tāvat pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ ucyate | nityanaimittika kāmyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyūnātirekadoṣa śāntyarthaṃ pūrṇāhutivat pavitrotsavaḥ kāryaḥ | śrāvaṇāṣāḍhabhādrapadāśvayujeṣu māseṣu site pakṣe dvādaśīśamī pratipatpaurṇamāsī pañcamyekādaśī trayodaśī dvitīyāsu tithiṣu puṣya rohiṇī revatī bharaṇī svātī hasta punarvasvādiṣu ṛkṣeṣu pavitrotsavaṃ kuryāt| tantūn brāhmaṇakanyābhiḥ nirmitān doṣarahitān kārpāsān vā kauśeyān vā krītān vā samānīya| maudgādicūrṇaiḥ śuddhavāribhiḥ saṃkṣālya|ātape śoṣayitvā|tān triguṇīkṛtya| tādṛśān punaḥ tathā kṛtvā| tāvatopi caturguṇān,yadvā triguṇān vā cāturguṇyaṃ nītvā| triguṇān triguṇīkṛtya|tādṛśān punaḥ tathākṛtvā| tāvatopi caturguṇān, yadvā triguṇān vā cāturguṇyaṃ nītvā| triguṇān triguṇīkṛtya vā, athavā tān ekatāṃ nītvā| bhūmiṃ gomayena anulipya| tatra yajñavṛkṣasaṃbhūtaṃ śaṅkudvayaṃ yathoktamānānusāreṇa saṃsthāpya| ācāryānujñayā,bhagavadbhaktāḥ snātāḥ tannirmāṇanipuṇāḥ prāṅmukhāḥ tatra tantūn āropya| yathā bhūṣaṇārhāṇi tathā pavitrāṇi kuryuḥ| mūlaberādi berāṇāṃ ādyaṃ adhivāsārthaṃpavitraṃ nābhyavadhimānaṃ aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ dvātriṃśatgranthabhiḥ yutaṃ ca, maṇḍalakumbhakuṇḍānāṃ padmagalamekhalāmānāni tādṛśāni ca nirmāya| cakrābjasya padmanābhyaranemibāhya pavitrāṇi catuśśatatraya dviśataikaśata catuśśataiḥtantubhiḥ krameṇa saptaviṃśatidviguṇa caturguṇa pañcaguṇaiḥ granthibhiśca| mahākumbhasya aṣṭottaraśata tantuyutaṃ, saptaviṃśati granthiyutaṃ, karakasya ca ekāśīti tantubhiḥ viṃśatigranthibhiśca yutaṃ pavitraṃ nirmāya| berāṇāṃ tu śrīvatsakaustubhavanamālā kirīṭāhvayāni nābhihṛdaya jaṅghā kirīṭamānāni krameṇa aṣṭottaraśatāśītyaṣṭottara catuśśata tantubhiḥdvātriṃśatpañcaviṃśat tāvadbhiḥ granthibhiśca yutāni pavitrāṇi ca| uttamādi pavitrāṇi tu jānūrunābhi maryādāni catuśśata triśata śatadvayatantubhiḥaṣṭottara śatā śīti ṣaṣṭigranthiyutāni ca, hārārthaṃ triśatatantubhiḥ saptaviṃśatigranthiyutaṃ ca,śatadvaya tantubhiḥ dvātriṃśatgranthiyutaṃ nābhimaryādaṃ pavitraṃ ca aṣṭottarasahasra tantubhiḥ anekagranthiyutaṃ caraṇamaryādaṃ pavitraṃ ca sahajapīṭhasya tanmaryādaṃ aṣṭottaraśatatantubhiḥ pañcaviṃśatigranthibhiśca yutaṃ, prabhāpavitraṃ tattulyatantumaryādaṃ anekagranthiyutaṃ ca pavitraṃ evaṃ sarveṣāṃ svatantra bimbānāṃ paratantreṣu bimbeṣu tu uttamāditrayameva|śriyādīnāṃ devīnāṃ ca evameva aṣṭottaraśatasūtraiḥ bahugranthibhiśca yutāni ca,agnikuṇḍasya pratimekhalaṃ saptaviṃśati pañcaviṃśadvāviṃśakaiḥ sūtraiḥ tanmānagranthibhiśca mekhalāmaryādāni pavitrāṇi ca, sruksruvādipātrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśati sūtraiḥ bahubhiḥ granthibhiḥ tanmaryādāni ca, arghyapādyādipātra dhūpapātra ghaṇṭākṣamālādiṣu sarvatra aṣṭottaraśata tantubhiḥ yathepsita granthibhiḥ dvādaśāṅgulamānena yutāni ca, seneśa garuḍa digdevatādruhiṇa durgā vināyaka rudrādi parivāreṣu aṣṭottaraśata tantubhiḥ dvātriṃśatgranthibhiśca yutāni hastamānāni ca, caṇḍādīnāṃ saptaviṃśatisūtraiḥ tāvadbhiḥ granthibhiḥtanmānena ca| kumbhatoraṇādiṣu ca tathā, balipīṭhasya karṇikāmānaṃ tādṛśaṃ ca,ācāryāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca aṣṭottaraśata tantubhiśca mūrtipānāṃ pūjakānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ekāśītisūtraiḥ nābhimaryādāni ca, rājñaḥ tu aṣṭottaraśatasūtraiḥ bahugranthibhiḥ tanmānena ca, tadupajīvināṃ ekāśītisūtraiḥ vaiśyādīnāṃ cartuīṃvaśatitantubhiśca teṣāṃ upavītavadeva pavitrāṇi nirmāya| maṇimuktāpravālādiratnaiḥ svarṇādilohaiśca pūrayitvā| granthīn śaṅkhākārān dhātrīphalasadṛśān vā muktaphalasamān vā, badhvā| tadantarālāni kastūrikākuṅkuma karpūracandanāvaśyāya kardamaiḥ ālipya| yadvā granthīnāṃ pūraṇaṃmallikādyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ vā kṛtvā| niśācarcābhiḥ anurañjya ca|evaṃ pavitrāṇi nirmāya|pūrvavat maṇḍapaṃ sa madhyavedikā kuṇḍaṃ kalpayitvā| toraṇavitāna darbhamālādyaiḥ alaṅkṛtya| tatra yāgopakaraṇānisarvāṇi saṃpādya| tasmin saptāhe pañcāhe tṛtīye ahani sadyaḥ vā saṅkalpapūrvakaṃ vidhivat aṅkurāvāpanaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu ācāryaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ upoṣitaḥ daśamyāṃ niśāmukhe mūrtipaiḥ yajamānena ca saha garbhagehaṃ praviśya| devaṃ arghyādibhiḥ yathāvidhi pūjayitvā| taiḥ sākaṃ devaṃ praṇamya|prāñjaliḥsan imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| nyūnātirekaśāntyarthaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ param| arcanaṃ bhagavan sarvaduritotsāraṇakṣamam| saṃpadāṃ cāpi sarvāsāṃ utpādanamanuttamam| kriyate tadavighnena yathā syāt karmacoditam| tathā anujñāpayāmi tvāṃ anujānī hi karma tat| iti devaṃ vijñāpya|mandirāt maṇḍapaṃ praviśya| tatra darbhān prāgagrān āstīrya| teṣu prāgānanaḥ upoṣitaḥ upaviśya| samāhitamanāḥ japadhyānaparaḥ rātriṃ jāgareṇa nītvā| aparedyuḥ niśīthinyāṃ adhivāsanakarma vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā kuryāt| ekabere tu mūlabimbe snapanānantaraṃ kautukaṃ, bahubere tu kalyāṇakautukaṃ baddhvā| tataḥ nirgatyamaṇḍape puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ dvāratoraṇa pūjanaṃ vidhāya| digvidikṣu caturvedavidaḥ viprān anyān ca sthāpayitvā| tūryaghoṣeṣu maṅgaleṣu ca sarvatra pravartiteṣu tadanu ācāryaḥpavitrapātrāṇi ādāya| maṇḍape dhānyarāśau prāgudagbhuvi saṃsthāpya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| śoṣaṇādibhiḥ pavitrāṇi saṃśodhya| gandhadravyaiḥ dhūpayitvā| kastūrikādi kardamaiḥālipya| puṣpāṇi vikīrya| tāni pavitrapāṇiḥ navavāsasā saṃveṣṭya| cakramudrāṃ pradarśya| astramantreṇa saṃpūjya| maṇḍape aiśānīdiśaṃ ārabhya sūtraiḥ astramantreṇa saṃveṣṭya| maṇḍapasya upari cakraṃ ca bhūmau padmaṃ dvāreṣu gadāṃ ca dhyātvā| tatra digvidikṣu māṣodanena baliṃ datvā| bahubere tu kalyāṇakautukaṃ bahiḥ snānāsane sthāpayitvā| vidhivat saṃsnāpya| upavītāntaṃ upacarya vedikāyāṃ cakrābjaṃ vartayitvā|samabhyarcya kalyaṇakautukaṃ cakrābje saṃsthāpya| haviḥ nivedya| maṇḍape dhānyarāśau sakarakaṃ sopakumbhāṣṭakaṃ mahākumbhaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ saṃsthāpya| teṣu madhyama kumbhe mūlarmūīṃta, karake sudarśanaṃ, pūrvādyāśāgateṣu vāsudevādīn koṇastheṣu puruṣādīn ca pīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya| āvāhya abhyarcya| saṃpūjya| kuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| yathāvidhi samidājya carubhiḥ adhivāsa homaṃ kṛtvā| saṃpātaṃ saṃgṛhya| pavitrapātreṣu sparśamantreṇa secayitvā| ekabere tu kalyāṇakautukaṃ vinā mūlabiṃbe snapanādikaṃ kṛtvā| pūrvaṃ pavitrāṇi āropya| bahubere tu pūrvaṃ kalyāṇakautukaṃ kumbhakarakāgni cakrābjamaṇḍaleṣu ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti pavitrāṇi āropya| sarvamaṅgalaiḥ saha mūlamandiraṃ praviśya| mūlabimbaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| pūrvoktamantreṇa pavitrāṇi āropya| sarvārcāsu ca tathā kṛtvā| prāsādaṃ ca veṣṭayitvā| vedaghoṣaiḥ vādyaghoṣaiḥsaha tatraiva tāṃ rātriṃ jāgareṇa nītvā| aparedyuḥ maṇḍalasthaṃ devaṃ snānāsane samāropya| saṃsnāpya| alaṅkṛtya| śodhite maṇḍape pūrvavat cakrābjaṃ vartayitvā| dvārādiyajanaṃ kṛtvā| cakrapaṅkajaṃ abhyarcya| tasmin kalyāṇabimbaṃ pūrvavat saṃsthāpya| arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| kumbhādikaṃ ca saṃpūjya|caturvidhamannaṃ nivedya| agnau pāyasādicaturvidhaiḥ annaiḥ puruṣasūktena ca vrīhi veṇu tila lāja puṣpa agaru ghṛtasamidbhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottara śataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| ācāryaḥ sumuhūrte pavitrāṇi ādāya cakrābjaṃ sāṅgaṃ pṛthak ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti bhūṣayitvā tadanu kumbhakaraka kuṇḍāgnitoraṇa dvārakumbhādīnāṃ pātrāṇāṃ ca pavitrāṇi āropya|tataḥ maṇḍalasthaṃ devaṃ ca tadanu pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| sarvamaṅgala saṃvṛtaṃ mandiraṃ antaḥ praviśya| mūlabimbe snapanādinā pūjite haviḥ nivedya| tatrastha devānāṃ śriyādīnāṃ ca tathā kṛtvā| mūlaberaṃ samārabhya pūrvoktamantreṇa pavitraiḥ bhūṣayitvā| svatantrāṇāṃ asvatantrāṇāṃ ca bimbānāṃ evaṃ kṛtvā|tadanu caṇḍādi balipīṭhāntaṃ ca,brahmādi devatānāṃ tārkṣyaseneśayoḥ anyeṣāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ viṣṇugāyatryā ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti vā aṣṭākṣareṇa dvādaśārṇena vā pavitrāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ yajamānena ca saha mandiraṃ antaḥ praviśya| syāñjaliṃ ratnaiḥ hemapuṣpaiḥ kevalaiḥ vā prasūnaiḥ āpūrya| devaṃ stotraiḥ stutvā| añjalisthāni devapādamūle vikīrya| manuṣyārthaṃ kṛtāni pavitrāṇi kṣaumādīni puṣpavat devapādayoḥ vinyasya| devaṃ vijñāpya| svayaṃ ātmanaḥ kṛtaṃ kṣaumādipavitraṃ ca pūrvaṃ gṛhītvā|tadanu pūjakamukhyānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ sahakāriṇāṃ anyeṣāṃ rājñāṃ tadupajīvināṃ vaiśyādīnāṃ ca pavitrāṇi vitīrya| devasya ānanaṃ avalokya| pādau spṛṣṭvā|janāntike nyūnātireka śāntyarthaṃ imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| bhagavan devadeveśa śaṅkha cakra gadādhara| saṃvatsarāpacārāṇāṃ pūraṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā| ārādhanaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā| nāhaṃ svatantraḥ kiñcicca karomi vihitaṃ hitaṃ| kintu tvatpreritaḥ sarvaṃ karomi na vaśaḥ svayam| tat kṣantavyaṃ aśeṣeṇa kriyālopādi anuṣṭitam| iti vijñāpya| aparāhne devaṃ yānādikaṃ āropya|alaṅkṛtya|grāma pradakṣiṇa pūrvakaṃ sarvopacāraiḥ saha mahotsavaṃ kuryāt|pratyahaṃ pavitrāṇi pūjākāle prokṣya āropayet|evaṃ divasān caturdaśa vā ekaviṃśatiḥ sapta vā trirātraṃ ekarātraṃ vā nityameva dvārayajanādi sahitaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā| samāptidivase tattaddevatāśca udvāsya| pauruṣeṇa sūktena rathantareṇa vā trisuparṇena mūlamantreṇa vā pavitrāṇi avaropya|devasyasnapana karma kṛtvā| saṃpūjya|pūrvaṃ gurave tadanu bhaktānāṃ pavitrāṇi dāpayet| yajamāno’pi guruṃ jīvājīvatmakaiḥ dhanaiḥ toṣayitvā| praṇamya| taṃ yānaṃ āropya|sarvamaṅgala sahitaṃ tanmandiraṃ nayet| iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇa mahotsava vidhiḥ nāma saptatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptoyaṃ kriyākairava candrikā |
